local33-u7fff517add36a8c05f-1.text: OF THE ORGANIZATION OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT IN THE UNIFIED SYSTEM

local33-uf2921da99c053152b2-1.text: 1. Local self-government is a form of citizens’ self-organization recognized and guaranteed by the Constitution of the Russian Federation, for the purpose of the people exercising their power to independently resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life (matters of local significance), within the powers provided for, in accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, by this Federal Law, other federal laws and, in cases established by federal laws, laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.

local33-ub8406d6637fef01586-1.text: 2. Citizens exercise local self-government directly through forms of direct expression of their will, and also through local self-government bodies.

local33-uada4a00306c2ac335d-1.text: 3. Local self-government is exercised throughout the territory of the Russian Federation.

local33-ue9aa80351de4c09611-1.text: 4. In accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, local self-government bodies form part of the unified system of public authority in the Russian Federation.

local33-u8b0529e3556018ca0c-1.text: 5. The President of the Russian Federation ensures the coordinated functioning and interaction of bodies forming part of the unified system of public authority in the Russian Federation.

local33-u94eb6e62e7e811dc26-1.text: 6. Local self-government bodies do not form part of the system of state authorities.

local33-uc4e9324d15ee095783-1.text: 7. Public authorities participate in addressing the tasks of local self-government in accordance with this Federal Law and other federal laws.

local33-u7a0880ca2b5ddb75a7-1.text: 8. Openness in the activities of local self-government bodies is guaranteed, including by providing access to information about the activities of local self-government bodies.

local33-u54b4cbb049d2b61e17-1.text: Article 2. Citizens’ rights to exercise local self-government
local33-u54b4cbb049d2b61e17-1.locator: Article 2. Citizens’ rights to exercise local self-government

local33-u7c05a90c6e2d0488f9-1.text: 1. Citizens have equal rights to exercise local self-government irrespective of sex, race, ethnicity, language, origin, property status and official position, attitude to religion, convictions or membership in public associations.
local33-u7c05a90c6e2d0488f9-1.locator: Article 2. Citizens’ rights to exercise local self-government

local33-u6a71b9f158dbcaac47-1.text: 2. Public authorities, in accordance with this Federal Law and other federal laws, ensure citizens’ rights to exercise local self-government established by the Constitution of the Russian Federation and this Federal Law.
local33-u6a71b9f158dbcaac47-1.locator: Article 2. Citizens’ rights to exercise local self-government

local33-u7c0f011c27373404b9-1.text: Article 3. Legal basis of local self-government
local33-u7c0f011c27373404b9-1.locator: Article 3. Legal basis of local self-government

local33-u5cf2ee4094e426405d-1.text: The legal basis of local self-government consists of the Constitution of the Russian Federation, universally recognized principles and rules of international law, international treaties of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, this Federal Law, other federal laws, other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation issued in accordance with them (decrees and executive orders of the President of the Russian Federation, resolutions of the Government of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts of federal executive authorities), constitutions (charters), laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, municipal charters, decisions adopted at local referendums and citizens’ assemblies, and other municipal legal acts.
local33-u5cf2ee4094e426405d-1.locator: Article 3. Legal basis of local self-government

local33-ucb3ec4a60747b1617a-1.text: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government
local33-ucb3ec4a60747b1617a-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government

local33-ud339d8b2eb400f5313-1.text: 1. Local self-government is independent within the limits of its powers.
local33-ud339d8b2eb400f5313-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government

local33-ub5071ceb88665be42b-1.text: 2. A local self-government body or a person holding a municipal office in one municipality may not be subordinate to a local self-government body or a person holding a municipal office in another municipality.
local33-ub5071ceb88665be42b-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government

local33-ubeb8876c7767d2235a-1.text: 3. The establishment, formation and activities of local self-government bodies, their powers and liability, and the procedure for interaction among them and with other bodies forming part of the unified system of public authority in the Russian Federation are based on the Constitution of the Russian Federation and are regulated by federal constitutional laws, this Federal Law, other federal laws, and also constitutions (charters), laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, municipal charters and other municipal legal acts.
local33-ubeb8876c7767d2235a-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government

local33-u0461f0958147b3f297-1.text: 4. Municipal charters and other municipal legal acts may, in accordance with laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, provide for procedures for remote interaction between bodies forming part of the unified system of public authority in that constituent entity of the Russian Federation, and for remote participation in meetings of the representative body of the municipality.
local33-u0461f0958147b3f297-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government

local33-u3f6a3246d86b2837e3-1.text: 5. Federal laws adopted in accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation and this Federal Law, other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation issued in accordance with them (decrees and executive orders of the President of the Russian Federation, resolutions and executive orders of the Government of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts of federal executive authorities), constitutions (charters), laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, municipal charters, decisions adopted at local referendums and citizens’ assemblies, and other municipal legal acts must, when regulating the organization of local self-government, take into account the socioeconomic, natural and climatic, territorial and other characteristics of the locality, as well as historical, cultural, ethnic and other local traditions, and ensure that tasks are addressed in the interests of the population residing in the relevant territory.
local33-u3f6a3246d86b2837e3-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government

local33-uf7ad564a17397c5127-1.text: 6. If federal laws and/or other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation regulating the organization of local self-government conflict with the Constitution of the Russian Federation or this Federal Law, the Constitution of the Russian Federation and this Federal Law shall apply.
local33-uf7ad564a17397c5127-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government

local33-u217fca9d3421ff5cfa-1.text: 7. If a constitution (charter), law or other regulatory legal act of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation regulating the organization of local self-government and establishing the rights, duties and liability of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials conflicts with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, this Federal Law or other federal laws, the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, this Federal Law and other federal laws shall apply.
local33-u217fca9d3421ff5cfa-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government

local33-u1624cd091ae1c78b72-1.text: 8. Expenditure obligations arising in connection with local self-government bodies exercising powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life are met from local budget funds (excluding subventions provided to local budgets from the federal budget and the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation). In the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and by regulatory legal acts of the representative body of the municipality adopted in accordance with them and local budgets, these expenditure obligations may additionally be financed from the federal budget, federal state extrabudgetary funds and the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
local33-u1624cd091ae1c78b72-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government

local33-uf446741d8a166ed39e-1.text: 9. Municipalities may not be required to finance expenses arising from the exercise of powers by state authorities and/or local self-government bodies of other municipalities.
local33-uf446741d8a166ed39e-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government

local33-ub134a747b2e7864564-1.text: 10. The division of powers among levels of public authority shall be supported by corresponding financial means and material resources.
local33-ub134a747b2e7864564-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government

local33-u0eeb8959ea4bb1e3fb-1.text: 11. A municipality is not an administrative-territorial unit. However, the boundaries of a municipality and an administrative-territorial unit may coincide.
local33-u0eeb8959ea4bb1e3fb-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government

local33-uf31177867d24ced921-1.text: 12. The general principles of the organization of local self-government established by this Federal Law may be changed only by amending this Federal Law.
local33-uf31177867d24ced921-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government

local33-u9491d24c1ed74a3189-1.text: Article 5. Powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government
local33-u9491d24c1ed74a3189-1.locator: Article 5. Powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government

local33-ud753ec63db94696200-1.text: The powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government include:
local33-ud753ec63db94696200-1.locator: Article 5. Powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government

local33-uedd5219cb571341aba-1.text: 1) determining the general principles of the organization of local self-government in the Russian Federation established by this Federal Law;
local33-uedd5219cb571341aba-1.locator: Article 5. Powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government

local33-uf1f75a2ea8ca75fee7-1.text: 2) legal regulation, in matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation and within the powers of the Russian Federation in matters within the joint jurisdiction of the Russian Federation and its constituent entities, of the rights, duties and liability of federal state authorities and their officials, and of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their officials, in the field of local self-government;
local33-uf1f75a2ea8ca75fee7-1.locator: Article 5. Powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government

local33-u2a16e416daa6ea0dd2-1.text: 3) legal regulation of the rights, duties and liability of citizens, local self-government bodies and local self-government officials in the field of local self-government;
local33-u2a16e416daa6ea0dd2-1.locator: Article 5. Powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government

local33-ub5219cdc2fafde7554-1.text: 4) legal regulation of the rights, duties and liability of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials when exercising individual state powers vested in local self-government bodies by federal laws in accordance with the procedure established by this Federal Law;
local33-ub5219cdc2fafde7554-1.locator: Article 5. Powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government

local33-ua50537a34d8d0e6a59-1.text: 5) legal regulation of the specific features of the organization of local self-government in the territories of cities of federal significance, administrative centers (capitals) of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and other territories.
local33-ua50537a34d8d0e6a59-1.locator: Article 5. Powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government

local33-ua335352fb4e6aa4338-1.text: Article 6. Powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of local self-government
local33-ua335352fb4e6aa4338-1.locator: Article 6. Powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of local self-government

local33-u69dec5797b50904ca1-1.text: The powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of local self-government include:
local33-u69dec5797b50904ca1-1.locator: Article 6. Powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of local self-government

local33-u4b81e6f861e39cba0a-1.text: 1) legal regulation of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by this Federal Law;
local33-u4b81e6f861e39cba0a-1.locator: Article 6. Powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of local self-government

local33-ua2712dfac69c67f4ad-1.text: 2) legal regulation of the rights, duties and liability of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their officials in the field of local self-government in the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by federal laws;
local33-ua2712dfac69c67f4ad-1.locator: Article 6. Powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of local self-government

local33-uc4b5b09b49481cec34-1.text: 3) legal regulation of the rights, duties and liability of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials in matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and also within the powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in matters within the joint jurisdiction of the Russian Federation and its constituent entities;
local33-uc4b5b09b49481cec34-1.locator: Article 6. Powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of local self-government

local33-u3c1a761626d60ca85d-1.text: 4) legal regulation of the rights, duties and liability of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials when exercising individual state powers vested in local self-government bodies by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in accordance with the procedure established by this Federal Law.
local33-u3c1a761626d60ca85d-1.locator: Article 6. Powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of local self-government

local33-u5d8059a6eb2e7b4d2c-1.text: 1. The name of a municipality is determined by its charter.

local33-u605bcfd91375bcc1a1-1.text: 2. The name of a municipality must indicate its type and the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in which the municipality is located.

local33-uba93fcb882fb4ef7de-1.text: 3. If the administrative center of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is located in the territory of a municipality, the name of that municipality may omit the name of that constituent entity of the Russian Federation.

local33-ufc585e213597c78275-1.text: 4. Other elements of a municipality’s name may be determined by its charter, taking into account historical and other local traditions and the possession of honorary titles of the USSR and the Russian Federation.

local33-u816d3ad9c7e79fa8bc-1.text: 5. A municipal charter may provide for use of an abbreviated form of the municipality’s name in its official symbols, in the names of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials, and in other cases, on an equal basis with the name of that municipality determined by its charter in accordance with parts 2–4 of this Article.

local33-uc0ba17d712cb096a82-1.text: 6. The name of a municipality must be entered in the State Register of Municipalities of the Russian Federation, which is maintained by the authorized federal executive authority in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.

local33-u0bfa09dc4c05c5f182-1.text: 1. Municipalities may, in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation and heraldic rules, establish official symbols reflecting historical, cultural, ethnic and other local traditions and characteristics.

local33-uf5239b6868d922a33c-1.text: 2. Official symbols of municipalities are subject to state registration in accordance with the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation.

local33-u2e38f4c11674244b1e-1.text: 3. Official symbols of municipalities and the procedure for their official use are established by municipal charters and/or regulatory legal acts of municipal representative bodies.

local33-u271a95eea5d0c5fadc-1.text: 4. Taking into account historical and other local traditions and the possession of honorary titles of the USSR and the Russian Federation, individual settlements forming part of a municipality may, in accordance with the municipal charter, have official settlement symbols.

local33-udf7e9a84c578233999-1.text: Chapter 2. Territorial foundations of the organization of local self-government
local33-udf7e9a84c578233999-1.locator: Chapter 2. Territorial foundations of the organization of local self-government

local33-ue86b184cfa1ad26e5b-1.text: 1. A municipality is a public-law entity established in a territory with a permanently resident population, within whose boundaries local self-government is exercised by the population directly and/or through local self-government bodies.

local33-u5fe35dee664ae3bb22-1.text: 2. Local self-government is exercised in the following types of municipalities:

local33-u56fea82f46319a25b5-1.text: 3) intracity municipality of a city of federal significance.

local33-u6e115dcab1a0ad55bc-1.text: 3. An urban okrug is a municipality whose territory includes one or more cities and/or other urban settlements that are not themselves municipalities and in which at least two thirds of the urban okrug’s population reside. An urban okrug may also include the territories of rural settlements that are not themselves municipalities and territories intended for the development of the urban okrug’s social, transport and other infrastructure. The combined area of the territories of rural settlements and territories intended for the development of the urban okrug’s social, transport and other infrastructure included in the urban okrug may not be two or more times the area of the territories of cities and/or other urban settlements included in the urban okrug. The population density in an urban okrug must be at least five times the average population density in the Russian Federation.

local33-u33f22504573ca90ed9-1.text: 4. A municipal okrug is a municipality whose territory includes one or more rural settlements that are not themselves municipalities. A municipal okrug may also include the territories of urban settlements that are not themselves municipalities and territories intended for the development of the municipal okrug’s social, transport and other infrastructure. The combined area of the territories of rural settlements and territories intended for the development of the municipal okrug’s social, transport and other infrastructure included in the municipal okrug must be at least twice the area of the urban settlements included in the municipal okrug.

local33-u22a041244eb02a45ee-1.text: 5. An intracity municipality of a city of federal significance is a municipality located in the territory of a city of federal significance.

local33-u6a3389c497fc2fec0b-1.text: 6. The type of a municipality is determined by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the requirements of this Article.

local33-uec8fb7e832f3e54c9b-1.text: 7. In constituent entities of the Russian Federation having socioeconomic, historical, ethnic and other particular features, the organization of local self-government may be regulated taking into account special arrangements that allow the territorial organization of local self-government established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation as of the date this Federal Law enters into force to be retained, with local self-government exercised in the types of municipalities specified in points 1 and 2 of part 2 of this Article and/or in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government (settlement municipalities (rural and urban) and municipal raions).

local33-uc6d18d5a6785f015ef-1.text: Article 10. Principles of the territorial organization of local self-government
local33-uc6d18d5a6785f015ef-1.locator: Article 10. Principles of the territorial organization of local self-government

local33-u360f5481ccef158a72-1.text: 1. The territory of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is divided among municipal and urban okrugs, and, in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance, among intracity municipalities of the city of federal significance.
local33-u360f5481ccef158a72-1.locator: Article 10. Principles of the territorial organization of local self-government

local33-ud6c19799e7ce98d90f-1.text: 2. The territory of a municipality must lie wholly within the territory of a single constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-ud6c19799e7ce98d90f-1.locator: Article 10. Principles of the territorial organization of local self-government

local33-ua080d166bc3ab024f1-1.text: 3. The territories of municipalities are determined taking into account historical and other local traditions.
local33-ua080d166bc3ab024f1-1.locator: Article 10. Principles of the territorial organization of local self-government

local33-u5276029defa3f11d4f-1.text: 4. The territory of a municipality includes land irrespective of its form of ownership or designated use.
local33-u5276029defa3f11d4f-1.locator: Article 10. Principles of the territorial organization of local self-government

local33-ucfecb2f8197c79b03a-1.text: 5. Laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation establishing and changing municipal boundaries must contain a list of the settlements included in the territories of those municipalities.
local33-ucfecb2f8197c79b03a-1.locator: Article 10. Principles of the territorial organization of local self-government

local33-u619c69a4434ca175a5-1.text: 6. The territory of a settlement must be wholly included in the territory of a municipality.
local33-u619c69a4434ca175a5-1.locator: Article 10. Principles of the territorial organization of local self-government

local33-u8ee2fc3c5cac3564e9-1.text: 7. The territory of a municipality may not form part of the territory of another municipality.
local33-u8ee2fc3c5cac3564e9-1.locator: Article 10. Principles of the territorial organization of local self-government

local33-u2462347a4bc4f0c4b7-1.text: 8. A city or settlement located in an urban okrug that shares a boundary with a municipal okrug may be regarded as the administrative center of that municipal okrug.
local33-u2462347a4bc4f0c4b7-1.locator: Article 10. Principles of the territorial organization of local self-government

local33-u035f7cf65f2675cc52-1.text: 9. Municipal boundaries are generally established taking into account transport accessibility that enables residents of all settlements within them to travel to their administrative centers and back within a working day. Under laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, these requirements may be inapplicable to municipalities in areas with low population density and in remote and hard-to-reach localities.
local33-u035f7cf65f2675cc52-1.locator: Article 10. Principles of the territorial organization of local self-government

local33-u4efb6ae87e02b119e7-1.text: 10. Areas with low population density comprise the territories of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and of individual municipalities within constituent entities of the Russian Federation where population density is less than one third of the average population density in the Russian Federation.
local33-u4efb6ae87e02b119e7-1.locator: Article 10. Principles of the territorial organization of local self-government

local33-uff201f66aa7b88a09d-1.text: 11. In constituent entities of the Russian Federation where traditional forms of transhumant livestock farming have historically developed, the territories and boundaries of municipalities are established taking into account the legislation of the constituent entity regulating the procedure for determining territories and using land for transhumant livestock farming, and the patterns of population settlement in those territories.
local33-uff201f66aa7b88a09d-1.locator: Article 10. Principles of the territorial organization of local self-government

local33-u8f1de4ab6bf9e9dce2-1.text: 1. The boundaries of municipal territories are established and changed by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in accordance with the requirements of this Federal Law.

local33-u46f059b1269d1dc9b1-1.text: 2. The boundaries of a municipality are changed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation at the initiative of the population, local self-government bodies, state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or federal state authorities, in accordance with this Federal Law.

local33-ude61cc99189765440b-1.text: 3. The population’s initiative to change municipal boundaries is exercised in accordance with the procedure established by a federal law and a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with it for proposing a local referendum.

local33-u325f5a54070cc24f02-1.text: 4. An initiative of local self-government bodies or state authorities to change municipal boundaries is formalized by decisions of the relevant local self-government bodies or state authorities.

local33-u66ba3db553f492b11c-1.text: 5. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation changing municipal boundaries must not enter into force during an election campaign for a local self-government body of that municipality or during a local referendum campaign.

local33-u4e94f737d9771ee927-1.text: 6. Municipal boundaries are changed with the consent of the populations of the municipalities, expressed by the representative bodies of the respective municipalities.

local33-u40de58b7d89ebad682-1.text: 1. The transformation of municipalities means the merger of municipalities, the division of municipalities or a change in the type of a municipality.

local33-ufa6990818024eea0ce-1.text: 2. Municipalities are transformed by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation at the initiative of the population, local self-government bodies, state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation or federal state authorities, in accordance with this Federal Law.

local33-ua41c83fcf9c1ae1490-1.text: 3. The population’s initiative to transform a municipality is exercised in accordance with the procedure established by a federal law and a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with it for proposing a local referendum.

local33-u8c5257afb657bedc36-1.text: 4. An initiative of local self-government bodies or state authorities to transform a municipality is formalized by decisions of the relevant local self-government bodies or state authorities.

local33-ua0e3053192a49345d6-1.text: 5. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation transforming a municipality must not enter into force during an election campaign for a local self-government body of that municipality or during a local referendum campaign.

local33-ud38f80d624f334cd7e-1.text: 6. Municipalities are merged with the consent of the population, expressed by the representative bodies of each of the merging municipalities. Each of the merged municipalities loses its status as a municipality.

local33-u031adfe598cc7683d4-1.text: 7. A municipality is divided so as to create two or more municipalities taking into account the opinion of the population, expressed by the representative body of the municipality concerned.

local33-uefb6ea3ab342f0eb8f-1.text: 8. A municipality’s type is changed from an urban okrug to a municipal okrug if the urban okrug ceases to meet the requirements concerning the proportion of the population residing in cities and/or other urban settlements and the area of the urban okrug, or the population density in the urban okrug, provided for in part 3 of Article 9 of this Federal Law.

local33-u923d910c9c6c0274a8-1.text: 9. A municipality’s type is changed from a municipal okrug to an urban okrug if the municipal okrug ceases to meet the requirement concerning the area of the municipal okrug provided for in part 4 of Article 9 of this Federal Law, provided that it meets the requirements concerning the proportion of the population residing in cities and/or other urban settlements, territorial area and population density provided for in part 3 of Article 9 of this Federal Law.

local33-u74ad1a7992af0b4491-1.text: 10. The transformation of municipalities entails the creation of newly formed municipalities in the cases provided for in parts 6 and 7 of this Article.

local33-ub10be43e71012e9655-1.text: Chapter 3. Organizational foundations of local self-government
local33-ub10be43e71012e9655-1.locator: Chapter 3. Organizational foundations of local self-government

local33-u8b07ceb9afc3e32816-1.text: 1. Local self-government bodies mean bodies elected directly by the population or established by the representative body of a municipality and vested with their own powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life.

local33-u1826ce173e08edea71-1.text: 2. Local self-government bodies are formed by citizens directly in municipal elections or indirectly through deputies elected in municipal elections.

local33-ub04a10111e80b05bae-1.text: 3. The head of a municipality, the head of the local administration and other local self-government officials may, in accordance with the municipal charter, acquire and exercise property and other rights and duties and appear in court on behalf of the municipality without a power of attorney.

local33-uda2c2fa59d0ca5b18e-1.text: 4. Local self-government bodies vested with the rights of a legal entity in accordance with this Federal Law and the municipal charter are municipal treasury-funded institutions established to perform administrative functions and are subject to state registration as legal entities in accordance with federal law. The representative body of a municipality and the local administration, as legal entities, operate in accordance with the provisions of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation on treasury-funded institutions.

local33-ue8e011e5ce5fb5ce05-1.text: 5. The grounds for state registration of local self-government bodies as legal entities are the municipal charter and a decision to establish the relevant local self-government body with the rights of a legal entity.

local33-u33ef38a757c05874e8-1.text: 6. In the absence of a municipal charter, the grounds for state registration of local self-government bodies as legal entities are:

local33-uda5f1cbf4a25b5878f-1.text: 1) for the representative body of a municipality, the minutes of a meeting of that representative body containing a decision to vest it with the rights of a legal entity;

local33-u4a048cc930b6c5b52e-1.text: 2) for other local self-government bodies, a decision of the representative body of the municipality to establish the relevant local self-government body with the rights of a legal entity.

local33-u71f18d2ba26f0f8451-1.text: 7. The grounds for state registration of bodies of the local administration as legal entities are a decision of the representative body of the municipality to establish the relevant body in the form of a municipal treasury-funded institution and that representative body’s approval of regulations governing it, upon submission by the head of the local administration.

local33-u04216a496fdceafb8e-1.text: 8. Organizational and logistical support for the activities of local self-government bodies is funded exclusively from the own revenues of the budgets of the respective municipalities, except in the cases provided for by this Federal Law.

local33-ued242632d65e93b26c-1.text: 9. Local self-government bodies and local self-government officials bear liability provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation, including where they violate the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws, the constitution (charter) or laws of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or the municipal charter, and where those bodies and officials improperly exercise individual state powers delegated to them.

local33-u385de42fe47c652ac7-1.text: 10. Elections to local self-government bodies of a newly formed municipality are held within the time limits provided for by the legislation on elections and referendums, unless otherwise provided by federal constitutional laws.

local33-u4e0da797f76bc68c67-1.text: 11. Until the local self-government bodies of a newly formed municipality are formed, powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life in that newly formed municipality are exercised in the relevant territories by the local self-government bodies that exercised powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life in those territories on the day the newly formed municipality was created.

local33-u97ec2c09f971e1b5f4-1.text: 12. Municipal legal acts adopted by local self-government bodies that, on the day a newly formed municipality was created, exercised powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life in the relevant territories remain in force insofar as they do not conflict with federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, constitutions (charters), laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, or municipal legal acts of the local self-government bodies of the newly formed municipality.

local33-ue85b6e2b601259d753-1.text: 13. In accordance with their competence, the local self-government bodies of a newly formed municipality are the legal successors of the local self-government bodies that, on the day the newly formed municipality was created, exercised powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life in the relevant territory, in relations with state authorities of the Russian Federation, state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, local self-government bodies, individuals and legal entities. Matters of legal succession must be regulated by municipal legal acts of the newly formed municipality.

local33-uc96f2a9d34acfa3264-1.text: 14. Until municipal legal acts of the newly formed municipality regulate matters of legal succession in respect of bodies of local administrations, municipal institutions, enterprises and organizations previously established by or with the participation of the local self-government bodies that, on the day the newly formed municipality was created, exercised powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life in the relevant territory, those bodies of local administrations, municipal institutions, enterprises and organizations continue their activities while retaining their previous organizational and legal form.

local33-u3df4250bac692383c5-1.text: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies
local33-u3df4250bac692383c5-1.locator: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies

local33-u364caa76eb948646c5-1.text: 1. The structure of local self-government bodies consists of the representative body of the municipality, the head of the municipality, the local administration (the municipality’s executive and administrative body), the municipality’s control and accounts body, and other bodies provided for by the municipal charter and having their own powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life.
local33-u364caa76eb948646c5-1.locator: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies

local33-ua5b65a58004057e6d6-1.text: 2. The structure of local self-government bodies must include the representative body of the municipality, the head of the municipality and the local administration.
local33-ua5b65a58004057e6d6-1.locator: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies

local33-ubc0bf1e6138568968a-1.text: 3. The procedure for formation, powers, terms of office, reporting accountability and oversight of local self-government bodies are determined by the municipal charter in accordance with this Federal Law.
local33-ubc0bf1e6138568968a-1.locator: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies

local33-u9df53727c41c3d0fed-1.text: 4. In the cases provided for by this Federal Law, the procedure for formation, powers, terms of office, reporting accountability and oversight of local self-government bodies, as well as other matters concerning their organization and activities, are determined by the municipal charter in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, taking into account the requirements of this Federal Law.
local33-u9df53727c41c3d0fed-1.locator: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies

local33-u3703617c560f609633-1.text: 5. The names of the representative body of a municipality, the head of a municipality and the local administration are established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, taking into account historical and other local traditions.
local33-u3703617c560f609633-1.locator: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies

local33-uae8d4cb3549a31e0bd-1.text: 6. State authorities and their officials may participate in the formation of local self-government bodies and in the appointment and removal of local self-government officials in the cases and in accordance with the procedure provided for by this Federal Law.
local33-uae8d4cb3549a31e0bd-1.locator: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies

local33-u104e99e66fa1acdde6-1.text: 7. A decision of the representative body of a municipality to change the structure of local self-government bodies enters into force no earlier than the expiry of the term of office of the representative body that adopted the decision, except in the cases provided for by this Federal Law.
local33-u104e99e66fa1acdde6-1.locator: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies

local33-ud2eaa9b47b2134f0cd-1.text: 8. Where a newly formed municipality is created by transforming an existing municipality, the structure of its local self-government bodies is determined by the representative body of the municipality after its election and is set out in the municipal charter.
local33-ud2eaa9b47b2134f0cd-1.locator: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies

local33-ub75d46d35fd439084b-1.text: 9. The number of deputies in the first convocation of the representative body of a newly formed municipality and the procedure for electing its first head are established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, taking into account the provisions of this Federal Law.
local33-ub75d46d35fd439084b-1.locator: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies

local33-uf6ab2719c4c24e650b-1.text: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
local33-uf6ab2719c4c24e650b-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-ue536c450963e21d989-1.text: 1. The representative body of a municipality consists of deputies elected in municipal elections.
local33-ue536c450963e21d989-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-u5fce23408a2ea8b8f8-1.text: 2. A newly elected representative body of a municipality convenes its first meeting within the period established by the municipal charter, which may not exceed 30 days from the date on which a legally competent composition of the representative body was elected.
local33-u5fce23408a2ea8b8f8-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-ue5fe7fb93427c233ff-1.text: 3. A representative body of a municipality is considered to have been elected with a legally competent composition if at least two thirds of the established number of deputies have been elected.
local33-ue5fe7fb93427c233ff-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-u34add2abf7e3b60b43-1.text: 4. The quorum for a meeting of the representative body of a municipality is determined by the municipal charter. A meeting of the representative body may not be considered quorate if fewer than 50 percent of the elected deputies are present.
local33-u34add2abf7e3b60b43-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-uc21257e2c6c444dbdc-1.text: 5. Meetings of the representative body of a municipality are held at least once every three months.
local33-uc21257e2c6c444dbdc-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-uf5718cae3e9d3fa3fa-1.text: 6. The number of deputies in the representative body of an urban okrug or municipal okrug is determined by the municipal charter and may not be fewer than:
local33-uf5718cae3e9d3fa3fa-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-u077ecd94ec0b56af40-1.text: 1) 7 deputies where the population is fewer than 1000 people;
local33-u077ecd94ec0b56af40-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-ud5bd33c7b415c12faf-1.text: 2) 10 deputies where the population is from 1000 to 10 000 people;
local33-ud5bd33c7b415c12faf-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-ued6bf06fd6e1aad280-1.text: 3) 15 deputies where the population is from 10 000 to 30 000 people;
local33-ued6bf06fd6e1aad280-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-u165d4551f1f608122d-1.text: 4) 20 deputies where the population is from 30 000 to 100 000 people;
local33-u165d4551f1f608122d-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-ua184082425f3cdbf36-1.text: 5) 25 deputies where the population is from 100 000 to 500 000 people;
local33-ua184082425f3cdbf36-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-u3209a889c0b07139f6-1.text: 6) 35 deputies where the population exceeds 500 000 people.
local33-u3209a889c0b07139f6-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-ud77823352a00fb4b2f-1.text: 7. The representative body of an urban okrug or municipal okrug has the rights of a legal entity.
local33-ud77823352a00fb4b2f-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-udd74c41b88a3c71176-1.text: 8. The activities of the representative body of a municipality are organized, in accordance with the municipal charter, by the chair of that representative body, elected by it from among its members.
local33-udd74c41b88a3c71176-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-u28c9578824327b371e-1.text: 9. Expenditure on supporting the activities of the representative body of a municipality is provided for in the local budget separately from other expenditure, in accordance with the expenditure classification of the budgets of the Russian Federation.
local33-u28c9578824327b371e-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-u01ed73b5903a92f5b2-1.text: 10. The representative body of a municipality or individual deputies (groups of deputies) may not, in any form, manage and/or dispose of local budget funds in the course of budget execution, except for local budget funds allocated to support the activities of the representative body and deputies.
local33-u01ed73b5903a92f5b2-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-ue2b45aac3af6b4a1ed-1.text: 11. The settlement in which the representative body of a municipality is located, taking into account local traditions and the existing social infrastructure and in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, is the administrative center of that municipality.
local33-ue2b45aac3af6b4a1ed-1.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality

local33-uf30aacb498a25b993c-1.text: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality
local33-uf30aacb498a25b993c-1.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-ue4f4714fa831ff4998-1.text: 1. The following fall within the exclusive competence of the representative body of a municipality:
local33-ue4f4714fa831ff4998-1.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-ua7f454d6886f512e1a-1.text: 1) adoption of the municipal charter and amendments and additions to it;
local33-ua7f454d6886f512e1a-1.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-ub40892113131f9b465-1.text: 2) approval of the local budget and the report on its execution;
local33-ub40892113131f9b465-1.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-ua7e21930290774d2b1-1.text: 3) establishment, introduction and termination of previously introduced local taxes and fees in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on taxes and fees;
local33-ua7e21930290774d2b1-1.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u15c0c74695700f23ce-1.text: 4) approval of the municipality’s socioeconomic development strategy;
local33-u15c0c74695700f23ce-1.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u4e96b81a1cdbe6a956-1.text: 5) determination of the procedure for managing and disposing of municipally owned property;
local33-u4e96b81a1cdbe6a956-1.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u080656ad963dba4313-1.text: 6) determination of the procedure for taking decisions on the establishment, reorganization and liquidation of municipal enterprises, and on setting tariffs for services provided and work performed by municipal enterprises and institutions, except in the cases provided for by federal laws;
local33-u080656ad963dba4313-1.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-ud5b750b10dfa666eab-1.text: 7) determination of the procedure for logistical and organizational support for the activities of local self-government bodies;
local33-ud5b750b10dfa666eab-1.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-ua485e8eb24fc677816-1.text: 8) oversight of the exercise by local self-government bodies and local self-government officials of powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life;
local33-ua485e8eb24fc677816-1.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u0216e344d6284f2e81-1.text: 9) adoption of a decision to remove the head of the municipality from office in the cases provided for by this Federal Law;
local33-u0216e344d6284f2e81-1.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-ub1c23bebcf90ca49e1-1.text: 10) approval of rules for the improvement and upkeep of the municipality’s territory;
local33-ub1c23bebcf90ca49e1-1.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u8963d77ab393a59ca8-1.text: 11) hearing annual reports of the head of the municipality and the head of the local administration on the results of their activities, the activities of the local administration and other local self-government bodies subordinate to the head of the municipality, including the resolution of matters raised by the representative body of the municipality.
local33-u8963d77ab393a59ca8-1.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u91e0788b1b912a2224-1.text: 2. Other powers of municipal representative bodies are determined by federal laws and by constitutions (charters) and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and municipal charters adopted in accordance with them.
local33-u91e0788b1b912a2224-1.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-ufad872ca6ee939984b-1.text: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
local33-ufad872ca6ee939984b-1.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-ue6bb097230c3956f51-1.text: 1. The powers of the representative body of a municipality terminate early in the following cases:
local33-ue6bb097230c3956f51-1.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-uff1adca64e60211b05-1.text: 1) entry into force of a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation on its dissolution;
local33-uff1adca64e60211b05-1.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u81e98d101afaddab85-1.text: 2) adoption by that body, in accordance with the procedure determined by the municipal charter, of a decision to dissolve itself;
local33-u81e98d101afaddab85-1.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-uc77432ba9f438550f9-1.text: 3) entry into force of a decision of the supreme court of the republic, the court of the krai or oblast, or the court of the city of federal significance, autonomous oblast or autonomous okrug, as applicable, finding that the current composition of deputies of the municipal representative body is not legally competent, including because deputies have resigned their mandates;
local33-uc77432ba9f438550f9-1.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u4431c696c320e6b3c7-1.text: 4) transformation of the municipality in accordance with parts 6 and 7 of Article 12 of this Federal Law;
local33-u4431c696c320e6b3c7-1.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u87d3e7564a3d8421e6-1.text: 5) an increase of more than 25 percent in the number of voters in the municipality;
local33-u87d3e7564a3d8421e6-1.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u04f9a9d3acd508894a-1.text: 6) failure to meet the deadline for issuing a municipal legal act necessary to implement a decision adopted through the population’s direct expression of will.
local33-u04f9a9d3acd508894a-1.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u8a987ce75c3d0dac09-1.text: 2. If a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation dissolving the representative body of a municipality enters into force, its powers terminate early from the date on which that law enters into force.
local33-u8a987ce75c3d0dac09-1.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u392bb13ae3ecf9ec0c-1.text: 3. The highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation submits to the legislative body of that constituent entity a draft law on dissolution of the representative body of the municipality within three months after the entry into force of a court decision establishing:
local33-u392bb13ae3ecf9ec0c-1.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-ub0113499d82cb8586d-1.text: 1) that the representative body of the municipality adopted a regulatory legal act conflicting with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws, the constitution (charter) or laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or the municipal charter, provided that the representative body failed, within three months after the court decision entered into force or within another period specified in the court decision, to take measures within its powers to implement the court decision, including repealing the relevant regulatory legal act;
local33-ub0113499d82cb8586d-1.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u31ca62afc93403334e-1.text: 2) that the representative body of the municipality, elected with a legally competent composition, failed to hold a meeting for three consecutive months;
local33-u31ca62afc93403334e-1.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u2c6e76dda0d55e773d-1.text: 3) that the newly elected representative body of the municipality, having a legally competent composition, failed to hold a meeting for three consecutive months from the date of its election.
local33-u2c6e76dda0d55e773d-1.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-uaddd0fe4f4f9f9b58f-1.text: 4. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation dissolving the representative body of a municipality may be challenged in court within 10 days after its entry into force.
local33-uaddd0fe4f4f9f9b58f-1.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-uf1dc10bd2039899db0-1.text: 5. Deputies of the representative body of a municipality dissolved on the grounds specified in points 2 and 3 of part 3 of this Article may, within 10 days after the entry into force of the law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation dissolving that body, apply to a court to establish that they were not at fault for the representative body’s failure to hold a quorate meeting for three consecutive months.
local33-uf1dc10bd2039899db0-1.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-ud19a942e4c91690fa0-1.text: 6. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality entails early termination of the mandates of its deputies.
local33-ud19a942e4c91690fa0-1.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-uec6cbf71862bce13ec-1.text: 7. If the powers of the representative body of a municipality terminate early, early elections to that representative body are held within the time limits established by federal law.
local33-uec6cbf71862bce13ec-1.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u856d5fef7c41e4a588-1.text: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality
local33-u856d5fef7c41e4a588-1.locator: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality

local33-u7598812a62688c2daf-1.text: 1. Deputies of a municipal representative body elected as part of lists of candidates nominated by political parties (their regional branches or other structural subdivisions) belong to deputy associations (factions) (hereinafter, factions), except in the case provided for in part 3 of this Article. A faction includes all deputies (the deputy) elected as part of the relevant list of candidates. A faction may also include deputies elected in single-member or multi-member constituencies and deputies (a deputy) elected as part of a list of candidates of a political party (its regional branch or other structural subdivision) referred to in part 3 of this Article.
local33-u7598812a62688c2daf-1.locator: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality

local33-u0aca34cee5dc682009-1.text: 2. The procedure governing the activities of factions is established by the rules of procedure or another act of the representative body of the municipality.
local33-u0aca34cee5dc682009-1.locator: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality

local33-uddc887c6a955ebc3bd-1.text: 3. If a political party ceases to operate because of its liquidation or reorganization, the activities of its faction in the municipal representative body and the deputies’ membership in that faction cease on the date the corresponding entry is made in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities.
local33-uddc887c6a955ebc3bd-1.locator: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality

local33-u3a62fc4ffbfe770bf5-1.text: 4. A deputy elected as part of a list of candidates nominated by a political party (its regional branch or other structural subdivision) may not leave the faction to which the deputy belongs under part 1 of this Article. Such a deputy may be a member only of the political party on whose list of candidates the deputy was elected.
local33-u3a62fc4ffbfe770bf5-1.locator: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality

local33-u7f818907112c089a3c-1.text: 5. A deputy elected in a single-member or multi-member constituency who belongs to a faction, or a deputy elected as part of a list of candidates of a political party referred to in part 3 of this Article who belongs to a faction, may be a member only of the political party whose faction the deputy belongs to.
local33-u7f818907112c089a3c-1.locator: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality

local33-ue8ec7d06b6934333ec-1.text: 6. A deputy elected as part of a list of candidates of a political party referred to in part 3 of this Article who joins a political party having a faction in the municipal representative body shall join that faction and may not leave it.
local33-ue8ec7d06b6934333ec-1.locator: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality

local33-uf0f563024fad9f25c1-1.text: 7. Failure to comply with the requirements provided for in parts 4–6 of this Article entails early termination of the deputy’s mandate.
local33-uf0f563024fad9f25c1-1.locator: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality

local33-u3b0489517f3492d798-1.text: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
local33-u3b0489517f3492d798-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u57f27460db8bd07b93-1.text: 1. The head of a municipality is its highest official and is vested by the municipal charter, in accordance with this Article, with their own powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life.
local33-u57f27460db8bd07b93-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u3ff683c4edf90c6e60-1.text: 2. In accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the municipal charter, the head of a municipality is elected:
local33-u3ff683c4edf90c6e60-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ue8b4cf0333a3d14f8c-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ubc866290a57eb54c2e-1.text: 2) by the representative body of the municipality from among its members;
local33-ubc866290a57eb54c2e-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u97ccbbefe1f771b60a-1.text: 3) by the representative body of the municipality from among candidates presented by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
local33-u97ccbbefe1f771b60a-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-udf3c5a2456f612a163-1.text: 4) by the representative body of the municipality from among candidates presented by a competition commission on the basis of a competitive selection procedure.
local33-udf3c5a2456f612a163-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ua313954c09e07dbfa7-1.text: 3. In accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the municipal charter, the head of a municipality may head the local administration.
local33-ua313954c09e07dbfa7-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ua30204337e9ba9d25e-1.text: 4. Where the representative body of a municipality elects the head of the municipality from among its members, the mandate of the deputy elected as head of that municipality terminates.
local33-ua30204337e9ba9d25e-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ua8b7b1011c975f2a9d-1.text: 5. The election of the head of a municipality by its representative body from among its members is generally held at the first meeting of the new convocation of the municipal representative body.
local33-ua8b7b1011c975f2a9d-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ueb82cb634d3312ffd3-1.text: 6. If a candidate for the office of head of a municipality fails to obtain the number of votes required for the representative body to adopt a decision electing the head from among its members, the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall, within 10 days, appoint a person to temporarily exercise the powers of the head of the municipality from among persons who, on the date of appointment, are not subject to restrictions on the right to stand for election under the legislation on basic guarantees of electoral rights and the right of citizens of the Russian Federation to participate in a referendum.
local33-ueb82cb634d3312ffd3-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-uababd4aaebd7aacf3a-1.text: 7. For a vote by the representative body of a municipality to elect the head from among candidates presented by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, that highest official shall present at least two candidates to the representative body.
local33-uababd4aaebd7aacf3a-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u9ccea57c3a0d866f65-1.text: 8. The procedure for the preliminary consideration of candidates for the office of head of a municipality by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and for presenting them to the representative body of the municipality is established by a law of that constituent entity. Proposals of candidates for the office of head of a municipality may be submitted to the highest official of the constituent entity by political parties whose federal lists of candidates were admitted to the allocation of deputy mandates on the basis of the officially published results of the most recent preceding elections of deputies of the State Duma of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation; political parties whose lists of candidates were admitted to the allocation of deputy mandates in the legislative body of the constituent entity in office on the date those proposals are submitted to the highest official; the council of municipalities of the relevant constituent entity; the civic chamber of that constituent entity; and the Association “All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government”. In accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, other organizations may submit proposals of candidates for the office of head of a municipality to the highest official of that constituent entity.
local33-u9ccea57c3a0d866f65-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u5e689e89a3fa46874b-1.text: 9. A candidate for the office of head of a municipality may be a citizen who, on the date candidates for that office are presented to the representative body of the municipality, is not subject to restrictions on the right to stand for election under the legislation on basic guarantees of electoral rights and the right of citizens of the Russian Federation to participate in a referendum.
local33-u5e689e89a3fa46874b-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ufe508b4766d676e064-1.text: 10. The procedure for conducting a competition to select candidates for the office of head of a municipality is established by the representative body of the municipality. The procedure must provide for publication of the competition conditions and information about its date, time and place no later than 20 days before the competition date. The total number of members of the competition commission in a municipality is established by the representative body of the municipality. Half of the commission’s members are appointed by the representative body of the municipality concerned, and the other half by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-ufe508b4766d676e064-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u94729a1e0f8c218185-1.text: 11. The competition conditions may provide for requirements concerning professional education and/or professional knowledge and skills that are preferable for the head of the municipality to exercise powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life. A law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may establish requirements, to be taken into account in the competition conditions, concerning the level of professional education and/or professional knowledge and skills that are preferable for the head of the municipality to exercise individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies.
local33-u94729a1e0f8c218185-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u4702c65ffd4fea2f9a-1.text: 12. For a vote by the representative body of a municipality to elect the head from among candidates presented by the competition commission on the basis of the competition results, at least two candidates registered by the competition commission shall be presented to the representative body.
local33-u4702c65ffd4fea2f9a-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u3568ab6b3ef43c4f5d-1.text: 13. If a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation changing the procedure for electing the head of a municipality is adopted, the charter of the municipality concerned must be brought into conformity with that law within three months after the law enters into force.
local33-u3568ab6b3ef43c4f5d-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u1e7956400753409074-1.text: 14. If a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation changing the procedure for electing the head of a municipality is adopted, that procedure applies after the expiry of the terms of office of the heads of municipalities elected before the date on which that law enters into force.
local33-u1e7956400753409074-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ub7b2761d82ebcd8810-1.text: 15. If a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation providing for the head of a municipality to be elected by the representative body of that municipality is adopted, elections of the head of that municipality shall not be called or held if that law entered into force before the date from which the representative body would have been entitled to decide to call elections of the head in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on elections and referendums.
local33-ub7b2761d82ebcd8810-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u0ae19be093e3bc8f85-1.text: 16. The head of a municipality may not exercise the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality.
local33-u0ae19be093e3bc8f85-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u49847954e5fcd5f80a-1.text: 17. The head of a municipality must observe the restrictions and prohibitions and perform the duties established for persons holding municipal offices by Article 28 of this Federal Law.
local33-u49847954e5fcd5f80a-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u7ab5a0156e00e11f61-1.text: 18. The head of a municipality is subject to oversight by, and accountable to, the population and the representative body of the municipality.
local33-u7ab5a0156e00e11f61-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u6cb39c4622ec51e4dc-1.text: 19. The head of a municipality submits annual reports to the representative body on the results of their activities and, where the head also heads the local administration, on the results of the activities of the local administration and other subordinate local self-government bodies, including the resolution of matters raised by the representative body of the municipality.
local33-u6cb39c4622ec51e4dc-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-uf3c3f07cd46cbad6b7-1.text: 20. In accordance with the principle of unity of the system of public authority, the head of a municipality simultaneously holds a state office of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and a municipal office.
local33-uf3c3f07cd46cbad6b7-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u869d411420d6a158d7-1.text: 21. If the head of a municipality cannot exercise their powers because of their health or other circumstances temporarily preventing the exercise of those powers (in particular, leave or an official business trip), the powers are temporarily exercised by a local self-government official designated in accordance with the municipal charter.
local33-u869d411420d6a158d7-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ubafb8e340c2f24ea8b-1.text: 22. In the cases provided for in part 6 of this Article and part 16 of Article 21 of this Federal Law, the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation appoints a person to temporarily exercise the powers of the head of a municipality until the day the head of the municipality is elected in accordance with the established procedure and takes office.
local33-ubafb8e340c2f24ea8b-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u279697ca3f292a0757-1.text: 23. A person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality has the rights and duties of the head of the municipality.
local33-u279697ca3f292a0757-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u55cdbe78fa9a06e9ee-1.text: 24. The scope of the powers of a person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality may be limited by the municipal charter and/or by the regulatory legal act of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation appointing that person (in the cases provided for in part 6 of this Article and part 16 of Article 21 of this Federal Law).
local33-u55cdbe78fa9a06e9ee-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-uc5b997159dd9ac2f7c-1.text: 25. A person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality, appointed by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the cases provided for in part 6 of this Article and part 16 of Article 21 of this Federal Law, is subject to the duties, restrictions and prohibitions established for the head of a municipality for the purposes of combating corruption by this Federal Law, other federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
local33-uc5b997159dd9ac2f7c-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u92a5760a7e2c90df25-1.text: 26. A person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality, appointed by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the cases provided for in part 6 of this Article and part 16 of Article 21 of this Federal Law, submits, in accordance with the procedure established for the head of a municipality, information on their income, property and property-related obligations, and information on the income, property and property-related obligations of their spouse and minor children.
local33-u92a5760a7e2c90df25-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ua99eab006ad69dd57c-1.text: 27. A person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality, appointed by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the cases provided for in part 6 of this Article and part 16 of Article 21 of this Federal Law, additionally submits the information specified in part 26 of this Article within 15 days after appointment. The information submitted shall cover income received from all sources during the calendar year preceding the year of appointment, and property and property-related obligations as of the date of appointment.
local33-ua99eab006ad69dd57c-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u2a5ea6c5fefd600c56-1.text: 28. Violation of the requirements established by parts 25–27 of this Article is a ground for early termination of the powers of a person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality who is appointed by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the cases provided for in part 6 of this Article and part 16 of Article 21 of this Federal Law.
local33-u2a5ea6c5fefd600c56-1.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u7d2a2133edd3981683-1.text: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality
local33-u7d2a2133edd3981683-1.locator: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u12358d730bd5c8fe7b-1.text: 1. The following fall within the exclusive competence of the head of a municipality:
local33-u12358d730bd5c8fe7b-1.locator: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ubbd4a54f38924b33a9-1.text: 1) representing the municipality in relations with local self-government bodies of other municipalities, state authorities, citizens and organizations;
local33-ubbd4a54f38924b33a9-1.locator: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u7f3f717b3babb1f984-1.text: 2) signing and promulgating, in accordance with the procedure established by the municipal charter, regulatory legal acts adopted by the representative body of the municipality;
local33-u7f3f717b3babb1f984-1.locator: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality

local33-uc13367a0d5e1ad2dcc-1.text: 3) issuing legal acts within the limits of their powers;
local33-uc13367a0d5e1ad2dcc-1.locator: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u88d21112fa47835a32-1.text: 4) the right to demand that an extraordinary meeting of the representative body of the municipality be convened.
local33-u88d21112fa47835a32-1.locator: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u4857f70dd1754410ce-1.text: 2. The head of a municipality who heads the local administration ensures the exercise by local self-government bodies of powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life and individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-u4857f70dd1754410ce-1.locator: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u0956e101bf8be44ce7-1.text: 3. Other powers of heads of municipalities are determined by federal laws and by constitutions (charters) and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and municipal charters adopted in accordance with them.
local33-u0956e101bf8be44ce7-1.locator: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u20bb9a77fe0c8e55cc-1.text: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
local33-u20bb9a77fe0c8e55cc-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u0ee1bb515187610588-1.text: 1. The powers of the head of a municipality terminate early in the cases provided for in part 1 of Article 30 of this Federal Law and also in the following cases:
local33-u0ee1bb515187610588-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u4e81609c07743d23e8-1.text: 1) loss of the confidence of the President of the Russian Federation;
local33-u4e81609c07743d23e8-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ubd0ac18e1fa0b78c24-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u66ce0b3c34cb7f4436-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-udb2abd568be7fcf225-1.text: 4) a lasting inability, established by a court, to exercise the powers of head of the municipality on grounds of health;
local33-udb2abd568be7fcf225-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u8fa9c4212cb424e9b9-1.text: 5) transformation of the municipality in accordance with parts 6 and 7 of Article 12 of this Federal Law;
local33-u8fa9c4212cb424e9b9-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u8982e2e076428fefe7-1.text: 6) an increase of more than 25 percent in the number of voters in the municipality;
