local33-u8982e2e076428fefe7-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-uc3027e7102d6b8323f-1.text: 7) failure to meet the deadline for issuing a municipal legal act necessary to implement a decision adopted through the population’s direct expression of will.
local33-uc3027e7102d6b8323f-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-uf37909c51d89ce4587-1.text: 2. The representative body of a municipality may, in accordance with this Federal Law, remove the head of the municipality from office at the initiative of deputies of the representative body or at the initiative of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-uf37909c51d89ce4587-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-uf87df55256ce98feec-1.text: 3. The grounds for removal of the head of a municipality from office are:
local33-uf87df55256ce98feec-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u27787d72bfa7c2427e-1.text: 1) decisions or actions (inaction) of the head of the municipality resulting in the consequences provided for in points 2 and 3 of part 1 of Article 38 of this Federal Law;
local33-u27787d72bfa7c2427e-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-uebe8aca70d1782f6d4-1.text: 2) failure for three or more months to perform duties to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life, to exercise powers provided for by this Federal Law, other federal laws and the municipal charter, and/or to ensure that local self-government bodies exercise individual state powers delegated to them by federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
local33-uebe8aca70d1782f6d4-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u84822b69dce09fffa3-1.text: 3) an unsatisfactory assessment of the head of the municipality’s activities by the representative body, given twice consecutively on the basis of the head’s annual report to that body;
local33-u84822b69dce09fffa3-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u4f888d1888c57cad66-1.text: 4) failure to observe restrictions and prohibitions or to perform duties established for persons holding municipal offices in accordance with part 5 of Article 28 of this Federal Law;
local33-u4f888d1888c57cad66-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ubf01cc3934c77a6767-1.text: 5) the head of the municipality, the local administration, other local self-government bodies and officials of the municipality and subordinate organizations allowing widespread violations of state guarantees of equality of human and civil rights and freedoms on grounds of race, ethnicity, language, attitude to religion or other circumstances, restrictions of rights and discrimination on grounds of racial, ethnic, linguistic or religious affiliation, where this has disrupted interethnic and interfaith harmony and contributed to the emergence of interethnic and interfaith conflicts;
local33-ubf01cc3934c77a6767-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u265371b622236b0fe6-1.text: 6) systematic failure to attain indicators of the effectiveness of local self-government bodies’ activities.
local33-u265371b622236b0fe6-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-uac5a227fb43fc7ca5d-1.text: 4. An initiative by deputies of the representative body of a municipality to remove the head of the municipality from office, proposed by at least one third of the established number of deputies, is formalized as an appeal submitted to the representative body. The appeal is submitted together with a draft decision of the representative body to remove the head from office. The head of the municipality and the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be notified of the initiative no later than the day following submission of the appeal to the representative body.
local33-uac5a227fb43fc7ca5d-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u647e8c01dacc9b1580-1.text: 5. An initiative by deputies of the representative body of a municipality to remove the head of the municipality from office is considered taking into account the opinion of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-u647e8c01dacc9b1580-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u7dece06ce0646596f7-1.text: 6. If consideration of an initiative by deputies of the representative body of a municipality to remove the head from office is to include matters concerning the assurance that local self-government bodies exercise individual state powers delegated to them by federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, and/or decisions or actions (inaction) of the head resulting in the consequences provided for in points 2 and 3 of part 1 of Article 38 of this Federal Law, a decision to remove the head from office may be adopted only with the consent of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-u7dece06ce0646596f7-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u78a663e4b9f36dfea1-1.text: 7. An initiative by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation to remove the head of a municipality from office is formalized as an appeal submitted to the representative body of the municipality together with a draft of its corresponding decision. The head of the municipality shall be notified of the initiative no later than the day following submission of the appeal to the representative body.
local33-u78a663e4b9f36dfea1-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-uda57bf1e92985e0c38-1.text: 8. An initiative to remove the head of a municipality from office on the ground provided for in point 6 of part 3 of this Article is submitted to the representative body by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. Such an initiative may be submitted by that highest official no earlier than one year after the head of the municipality took office.
local33-uda57bf1e92985e0c38-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u790a3588a2b612b670-1.text: 9. An initiative by deputies of the representative body of a municipality or by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation to remove the head of the municipality from office is considered by the representative body within one month after the relevant appeal is submitted.
local33-u790a3588a2b612b670-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u20e0513d9b2e861d49-1.text: 10. A decision of the representative body of a municipality to remove the head of the municipality from office is considered adopted if at least two thirds of the established number of deputies of the representative body vote in favor.
local33-u20e0513d9b2e861d49-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ue83a9776ba1fc570b5-1.text: 11. A decision of the representative body of a municipality to remove the head of the municipality from office is signed by the chair of the representative body.
local33-ue83a9776ba1fc570b5-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ue0c2d21c982a0e3f25-1.text: 12. When the representative body of a municipality considers and adopts a decision to remove the head of the municipality from office, the following must be ensured:
local33-ue0c2d21c982a0e3f25-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-uf37b3cc23f8ccf1f73-1.text: 1) the head receives advance notice of the date and place of the relevant meeting and is given access to the appeal of the deputies or of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the draft decision of the representative body to remove the head from office;
local33-uf37b3cc23f8ccf1f73-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u7c0ff1180bd298d9b7-1.text: 2) the head is given an opportunity to provide the deputies of the representative body with explanations concerning the circumstances advanced as grounds for removal from office.
local33-u7c0ff1180bd298d9b7-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u50db608b36da041958-1.text: 13. A decision of the representative body of a municipality to remove the head of the municipality from office must be promulgated no later than five days after its adoption.
local33-u50db608b36da041958-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u5f2e401061125a58e7-1.text: 14. If an initiative by deputies of the representative body of a municipality or by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation to remove the head of the municipality from office is rejected by the representative body, the matter of removal may be resubmitted to that body no earlier than two months after the meeting at which the matter was considered.
local33-u5f2e401061125a58e7-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ucb75e8c2457e4866ac-1.text: 15. A head of a municipality whom the representative body has decided to remove from office may apply to a court to challenge that decision within 10 days after its official publication.
local33-ucb75e8c2457e4866ac-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-uae61c37c61fecda244-1.text: 16. If the powers of the head of a municipality terminate early, or if a court orders procedural coercive measures against the head in the form of detention in custody or temporary suspension from office, the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall, within 10 days, appoint a person to temporarily exercise the powers of the head from among persons who, on the date of appointment, are not subject to restrictions on the right to stand for election under the legislation on basic guarantees of electoral rights and the right of citizens of the Russian Federation to participate in a referendum.
local33-uae61c37c61fecda244-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u055fc02399973941bf-1.text: 17. If the powers of the head of a municipality terminate early, elections of a head who is elected in municipal elections are held within the time limits established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on elections and referendums.
local33-u055fc02399973941bf-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ua18098c8654db33c1b-1.text: 18. If a head of a municipality whose powers have been terminated early on the basis of a legal act of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation dismissing the head from office, or a decision of the municipal representative body removing the head from office, challenges that act or decision in court, early elections of a head who is elected in municipal elections may not be called until the court decision becomes legally effective.
local33-ua18098c8654db33c1b-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ucc7e6e764570b2895c-1.text: 19. If the powers of the head of a municipality terminate early, the election of a head who is elected by the representative body from among its members, from among candidates presented by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, or from among candidates presented by the competition commission on the basis of the competition results, shall take place no later than six months after that termination of powers. If fewer than six months remain until the expiry of the representative body’s term of office, the head shall be elected from among its members at the first meeting of the newly elected representative body, whereas election from among candidates presented by the highest official of the constituent entity or by the competition commission on the basis of the competition results shall take place within three months after the representative body has been elected with a legally competent composition.
local33-ucc7e6e764570b2895c-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u8bfe4e8e026bc56947-1.text: 20. If a head of a municipality whose powers have been terminated early on the basis of a legal act of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation dismissing the head from office, or a decision of the municipal representative body removing the head from office, challenges that act or decision in court, the representative body may not decide to elect a head from among its members, from among candidates presented by the highest official of the constituent entity, or from among candidates presented by the competition commission on the basis of the competition results, until the court decision becomes legally effective.
local33-u8bfe4e8e026bc56947-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u66da09f63b6cc083d2-1.text: 21. If the powers of a head of a municipality who heads the local administration terminate early, their powers as head of the local administration terminate simultaneously.
local33-u66da09f63b6cc083d2-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u5f4bf52bd03f1a04da-1.text: 22. The highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation issues a legal act dismissing the head of a municipality from office where:
local33-u5f4bf52bd03f1a04da-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u3ec4bf7d36c3619641-1.text: 1) the head of the municipality has issued a regulatory legal act conflicting with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws, the constitution (charter) or laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or the municipal charter, where such conflicts have been established by the relevant court and the head has failed, within two months after the court decision entered into force or within another period specified by that decision, to take measures within their powers to implement the court decision;
local33-u3ec4bf7d36c3619641-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u02d7cd0a3a704b534a-1.text: 2) the head of the municipality has committed acts, including the issue of a non-regulatory legal act, entailing a violation of human and civil rights and freedoms; a threat to the unity and territorial integrity of the Russian Federation, its national security and defense capability, or the unity of its legal and economic space; misuse of earmarked interbudgetary transfers or budget loans; or violation of the conditions for providing interbudgetary transfers or budget loans received from other budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation, where this has been established by the relevant court and the head has failed to take measures within their powers to implement the court decision.
local33-u02d7cd0a3a704b534a-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-ude35e1104d7f38e3c9-1.text: 23. The highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may issue a legal act dismissing the head of a municipality from office under part 22 of this Article no earlier than one month and no later than six months after the entry into force of the latest court decision necessary for issuing that legal act.
local33-ude35e1104d7f38e3c9-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u30da079ae9b8787e93-1.text: 24. The highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may dismiss from office:
local33-u30da079ae9b8787e93-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u8063a89b609c6815e4-1.text: 1) the head of a municipality if, within one month after the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation has issued a warning or reprimand to the head in accordance with part 7 of Article 29 of this Federal Law, the head has failed to take measures within their powers to eliminate the reasons that served as grounds for the warning or reprimand;
local33-u8063a89b609c6815e4-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u59c8386d93de21be54-1.text: 2) the head of a municipality for improper performance or non-performance of duties to ensure that local self-government bodies exercise powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life as provided for in parts 2 and 3 of Article 32 of this Federal Law, and also on the ground provided for in point 6 of part 3 of this Article, taking into account the opinion of the representative body of the municipality, no earlier than one year after the head took office;
local33-u59c8386d93de21be54-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-uab2e71f319d24347ce-1.text: 3) the head of a municipality on one of the grounds provided for in part 3 of this Article, taking into account the opinion of the council of municipalities of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation, no earlier than two years after the head took office, if the highest official of the constituent entity has submitted initiatives to remove the head from office to the municipal representative body two or more times and that body has rejected them.
local33-uab2e71f319d24347ce-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u8909f7e50d1012e2be-1.text: 25. A head of a municipality in respect of whom the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation has issued a legal act of dismissal from office may challenge that act in court within 10 days after its official publication.
local33-u8909f7e50d1012e2be-1.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality

local33-u0b59b4562cee3249c1-1.text: 1. The local administration (the municipality’s executive and administrative body) is vested by the municipal charter with powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life and with powers to exercise individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.

local33-u957ead49828f61dc13-1.text: 2. The local administration is led by the head of the local administration on the principle of individual authority and responsibility.

local33-u47b9bd46ab51515fb0-1.text: 3. The head of the local administration is the head of the municipality or a person appointed to the position of head of the local administration under a contract concluded on the basis of a competition to fill that position.

local33-uc52ed68907cd02109a-1.text: 4. A head of the local administration appointed under a contract concluded on the basis of a competition holds a municipal service position.

local33-u8013f81be4335291ee-1.text: 5. A contract with the head of the local administration is concluded for the term of office of the municipal representative body that decided to appoint the person as head of the local administration (until the day the new convocation of the representative body begins its work), but for no less than two years.

local33-u48b8feb9fc491ddf4e-1.text: 6. The terms of the contract for the head of the local administration are approved by the municipal representative body insofar as they concern powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life, and by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation insofar as they concern the exercise of individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.

local33-u4d36d3456d67625a19-1.text: 7. If a person is appointed as head of the local administration under a contract, additional requirements for candidates for that position may be established by the municipal charter and by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.

local33-ub3f85b28a0deb53166-1.text: 8. The procedure for conducting a competition to fill the position of head of the local administration is established by the municipal representative body.

local33-uf337091b815dcdef0a-1.text: 9. The procedure for conducting a competition to fill the position of head of the local administration must provide for publication of the competition conditions, information about its date, time and place, and the draft contract no later than 20 days before the competition date.

local33-uc7b78298097768e294-1.text: 10. The total number of members of the competition commission in a municipality is established by the municipal representative body.

local33-uae13f928f71e2c89a0-1.text: 11. In a municipality, half of the competition commission’s members are appointed by the municipal representative body, and the other half by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.

local33-ua4c0dc7207e3436403-1.text: 12. The head of the local administration is appointed by the municipal representative body from among candidates presented by the competition commission on the basis of the competition results.

local33-u7a754640862d23a6db-1.text: 13. The contract with a head of the local administration exercising powers on the basis of a competition is concluded by the head of the municipality.

local33-u4aa62bfdba10d01b79-1.text: 14. A head of the local administration exercising powers on the basis of a competition:

local33-ua08c4e0ac874ad7436-1.text: 1) is subject to oversight by, and accountable to, the municipal representative body;

local33-uf57a056bdfd6ff2fce-1.text: 2) submits annual reports to the municipal representative body on the results of their activities and the activities of the local administration;

local33-u313f6fe472bc25492b-1.text: 3) ensures that the local administration exercises powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life and individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;

local33-u8c402edbc12c2ff905-1.text: 4) must notify the head of the municipality in writing of the termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation, acquisition of citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state, or receipt of a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen of the Russian Federation’s right to permanent residence in a foreign state, on the day they learn of it, but no later than five working days after the termination of Russian citizenship, acquisition of foreign citizenship (subjecthood), or receipt of a residence permit or other document referred to in this point.

local33-uaffbbf5865dbc6b001-1.text: 15. The local administration has the rights of a legal entity.

local33-ub90c8cb01374505a87-1.text: 16. The structure of the local administration is approved by the municipal representative body upon submission by the head of the local administration.

local33-ua2b8cdbc75d30c6d48-1.text: 17. To address tasks as effectively as possible in the interests of the population residing in the relevant territory, territorial bodies of the local administration may be formed within its structure in accordance with criteria established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. That law must include, as one of the criteria for forming territorial bodies within the local administration’s structure, pedestrian accessibility enabling residents of all settlements within the municipality to travel to the municipality’s administrative center or to territorial bodies of the local administration and back within a working day.

local33-u5c0de4d6ca0c5520d8-1.text: 18. Where the structure of the local administration includes territorial bodies, expenditure on supporting their activities is provided for in the local budget separately from other expenditure, in accordance with the expenditure classification of the budgets of the Russian Federation.

local33-uf4700045d3732cdde9-1.text: 19. Sectoral (functional) bodies of the local administration may be formed within its structure.

local33-u83deffc857d6847c66-1.text: 20. The municipal charter may, in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, provide for the municipal representative body’s right to participate in forming the local administration, including in approving or consenting to the appointment of deputy heads of the local administration and heads of its sectoral (functional) and/or territorial bodies, and may establish the forms and procedure for such participation.

local33-u87bc526e8e74d0440c-1.text: 21. In the temporary absence of the head of the local administration (in particular, owing to illness, leave, a business trip or other reasons), their powers are temporarily exercised by a local self-government official or an authorized municipal servant designated in accordance with the municipal charter.

local33-ua65eb1b59ea21aafd8-1.text: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
local33-ua65eb1b59ea21aafd8-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-ua06a9c8a6fded98cc6-1.text: 1. The powers of the head of the local administration terminate early in the following cases:
local33-ua06a9c8a6fded98cc6-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-u0e9aeb7f53d83ed7dc-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-uc7b7da23aba01b66fa-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-u578babfad3b9ee20e3-1.text: 3) release from the position held in accordance with part 2 or 3 of this Article;
local33-u578babfad3b9ee20e3-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-u202da47529814841bb-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-ueca3e87b559790d379-1.text: 5) being declared legally incapable or of limited legal capacity by a court;
local33-ueca3e87b559790d379-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-u9f870acd5bb97b8544-1.text: 6) being declared missing or dead by a court;
local33-u9f870acd5bb97b8544-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-ua6e7e236050165e6bf-1.text: 7) a court judgment of conviction against the head becoming legally effective;
local33-ua6e7e236050165e6bf-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-u389bac5c99befe07b7-1.text: 8) departure from the Russian Federation for permanent residence abroad;
local33-u389bac5c99befe07b7-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-uf898071edbf562ba09-1.text: 9) termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation, or possession of citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state or a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen of the Russian Federation’s right to permanent residence in a foreign state;
local33-uf898071edbf562ba09-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-u3b11551b45b3dd1fcb-1.text: 10) conscription for military service or assignment to alternative civilian service in its place;
local33-u3b11551b45b3dd1fcb-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-ua747064c178cf6da81-1.text: 11) transformation of the municipality in accordance with parts 6 and 7 of Article 12 of this Federal Law;
local33-ua747064c178cf6da81-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-ud6497a85e3c9471aaa-1.text: 12) an increase of more than 25 percent in the number of voters in the municipality;
local33-ud6497a85e3c9471aaa-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-ufd8841541e1f28906a-1.text: 13) assumption of office by a head of the municipality exercising the powers of head of the local administration;
local33-ufd8841541e1f28906a-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-ub6686d405cf6afd524-1.text: 14) early termination of the powers of a head of the municipality exercising the powers of head of the local administration;
local33-ub6686d405cf6afd524-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-u117acdee3c42559d66-1.text: 15) failure to meet the deadline for issuing a municipal legal act necessary to implement a decision adopted through the population’s direct expression of will;
local33-u117acdee3c42559d66-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-uff401c070ae438810e-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-u7b3e4a12baab10018d-1.text: 2. The head of the local administration may be released from the position held by agreement of the parties or through judicial proceedings on the basis of an application by:
local33-u7b3e4a12baab10018d-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-u278819dcfb61adcb14-1.text: 1) the municipal representative body or the head of the municipality, in connection with violations committed by the head of the local administration concerning the resolution of matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life, and also in connection with failure to observe restrictions and prohibitions or to perform duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption;
local33-u278819dcfb61adcb14-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-ubdd8a5cba64bd3be5e-1.text: 2) the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, in connection with violations committed by the head of the local administration concerning the exercise of individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and also in connection with failure to observe restrictions and prohibitions or to perform duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption;
local33-ubdd8a5cba64bd3be5e-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-u156dd491687d68a07b-1.text: 3) the head of the local administration, in connection with violations of the conditions for holding the position of head of the local administration by local self-government bodies and/or state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-u156dd491687d68a07b-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-ub5c7dc6696eef268f1-1.text: 3. The head of the local administration may be released from the position held through judicial proceedings on the basis of an application by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in connection with failure to observe restrictions and prohibitions or to perform duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption, identified through verification of the accuracy and completeness of information on income, expenditure, property and property-related obligations submitted in accordance with that legislation.
local33-ub5c7dc6696eef268f1-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-uc22138601c6752067e-1.text: 4. If the powers of the head of the local administration terminate early, or if a court orders procedural coercive measures against the head in the form of detention in custody or temporary suspension from office, the powers are temporarily exercised by a local self-government official or an authorized municipal servant designated in accordance with the municipal charter.
local33-uc22138601c6752067e-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-u38c3eb2981890b269b-1.text: 5. The highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation issues a legal act dismissing the head of the local administration from office where:
local33-u38c3eb2981890b269b-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-u6569488a360d34a461-1.text: 1) the head of the local administration has issued a regulatory legal act conflicting with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws, the constitution (charter) or laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or the municipal charter, where such conflicts have been established by the relevant court and the head has failed, within two months after the court decision entered into force or within another period specified by that decision, to take measures within their powers to implement the court decision;
local33-u6569488a360d34a461-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-u643398bd0d82b5e6b0-1.text: 2) the head of the local administration has committed acts, including the issue of a non-regulatory legal act, entailing a violation of human and civil rights and freedoms; a threat to the unity and territorial integrity of the Russian Federation, its national security and defense capability, or the unity of its legal and economic space; misuse of earmarked interbudgetary transfers or budget loans; or violation of the conditions for providing interbudgetary transfers or budget loans received from other budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation, where this has been established by the relevant court and the head has failed to take measures within their powers to implement the court decision.
local33-u643398bd0d82b5e6b0-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-u9bb15e8a8dcbd2a975-1.text: 6. The highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may issue a legal act dismissing the head of the local administration from office under part 5 of this Article no earlier than one month and no later than six months after the entry into force of the latest court decision necessary for issuing that legal act.
local33-u9bb15e8a8dcbd2a975-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-ufa6a63072bb52e8d85-1.text: 7. The highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may dismiss the head of the local administration from office if, within one month after that highest official has issued a warning or reprimand to the head in accordance with part 7 of Article 29 of this Federal Law, the head has failed to take measures within their powers to eliminate the reasons that served as grounds for the warning or reprimand.
local33-ufa6a63072bb52e8d85-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-u78be1b623e674fe44d-1.text: 8. A head of the local administration in respect of whom the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation has issued a legal act of dismissal from office may challenge that act in court within 10 days after its official publication.
local33-u78be1b623e674fe44d-1.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration

local33-uc44e67b3be7e2ba187-1.text: Article 24. Control and accounts body of a municipality
local33-uc44e67b3be7e2ba187-1.locator: Article 24. Control and accounts body of a municipality

local33-u1c7fd66788d0b33a4d-1.text: 1. For the purpose of external municipal financial control, the municipal representative body may establish a control and accounts body of the municipality.
local33-u1c7fd66788d0b33a4d-1.locator: Article 24. Control and accounts body of a municipality

local33-u8ce2d58758a7f1171b-1.text: 2. The organization and activities of a municipal control and accounts body are governed by Federal Law of 07.02.2011 No. 6-ФЗ “On the General Principles of the Organization and Activities of Control and Accounts Bodies of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, Federal Territories and Municipalities”, this Federal Law, the Budget Code of the Russian Federation, other federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, and municipal regulatory legal acts. In the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by federal laws, the organization and activities of municipal control and accounts bodies are also legally regulated by laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-u8ce2d58758a7f1171b-1.locator: Article 24. Control and accounts body of a municipality

local33-u781f67b239a7a296e8-1.text: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
local33-u781f67b239a7a296e8-1.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u27c30061122ee1136e-1.text: 1. A local self-government official means a person holding a municipal office or having concluded a contract (employment contract) who is vested, in accordance with the municipal charter, with executive and administrative powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life and/or to organize the activities of a local self-government body.
local33-u27c30061122ee1136e-1.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices

local33-uc2f764b6d601a74e38-1.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u4e704e0963c6179062-1.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u78cae1f5550ec562a0-1.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u05331b54331466ad63-1.text: 3) the chair, deputy chair and auditor of a municipal control and accounts body;
local33-u05331b54331466ad63-1.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices

local33-ue77817ef6b889b2dde-1.text: 4) other persons in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the municipal charter.
local33-ue77817ef6b889b2dde-1.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u2ef22b66c06ee84306-1.text: 3. Persons holding municipal offices are provided with conditions enabling the unimpeded exercise of their powers.
local33-u2ef22b66c06ee84306-1.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u8deb1d5953cd4f544f-1.text: 4. The term of office of persons holding municipal offices is five years.
local33-u8deb1d5953cd4f544f-1.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u306da1ba6183810df5-1.text: 5. The provisions of part 4 of this Article apply taking into account the special features of the procedure for terminating the powers of a person holding a municipal office provided for by this Article.
local33-u306da1ba6183810df5-1.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u25edba9f1439fd7a09-1.text: 6. A deputy’s powers begin on the day of election and terminate on the day the first quorate meeting of the new convocation of the municipal representative body is held.
local33-u25edba9f1439fd7a09-1.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u0eed40bcf976c0eba0-1.text: 7. The powers of the head of a municipality begin on the day of ceremonial assumption of office in accordance with the procedure provided for by the municipal charter and terminate on the day the newly elected head takes office.
local33-u0eed40bcf976c0eba0-1.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u8b616489f3b6e64c5e-1.text: 8. The powers of a head of a municipality elected by the municipal representative body begin on the day of election by that body and ceremonial assumption of office in accordance with the procedure provided for by the municipal charter, and terminate on the day the new convocation of the representative body holds a meeting at which the election of the head of the municipality is considered.
local33-u8b616489f3b6e64c5e-1.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u894f4c46192406b63c-1.text: 9. A decision changing the procedure for electing (appointing) a person holding a municipal office applies only to persons elected (appointed) after that decision enters into force. A decision changing the list of powers of a person holding a municipal office applies only to persons elected (appointed) after that decision enters into force, except where the changes are made to bring those powers into conformity with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
local33-u894f4c46192406b63c-1.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u73c16baf2636394eee-1.text: 10. Persons holding municipal offices may exercise their powers on a full-time basis in accordance with this Federal Law and the municipal charter.
local33-u73c16baf2636394eee-1.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u637732e69a7e164803-1.text: 11. Deputies of the municipal representative body generally exercise their powers on a non-full-time basis.
local33-u637732e69a7e164803-1.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u4ad763fcf675d7020b-1.text: 12. No more than 10 percent of the established number of deputies in the municipal representative body may work on a full-time basis; if the representative body has fewer than 10 members, 1 deputy may do so.
local33-u4ad763fcf675d7020b-1.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u6d62112e389540c0ba-1.text: Article 26. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office
local33-u6d62112e389540c0ba-1.locator: Article 26. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office

local33-u9cdb80fd513912b30e-1.text: 1. A deputy of the municipal representative body exercising powers on a non-full-time basis is guaranteed release from work by the employer with retention of their job (position) for a period whose duration is established by the municipal charter in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and may not total fewer than two or more than six working days per month.
local33-u9cdb80fd513912b30e-1.locator: Article 26. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office

local33-u071a79b50930ba317b-1.text: 2. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office are established by the municipal charter in accordance with federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-u071a79b50930ba317b-1.locator: Article 26. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office

local33-u4b105c3ffe0c079a2c-1.text: 3. If the municipal charter, in accordance with federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, provides additional social and other guarantees to persons holding municipal offices upon termination of their powers (including early termination), the relevant charter provisions apply only to persons exercising powers on a full-time basis who reached retirement age or lost their capacity for work while holding a municipal office. They may not provide such guarantees to persons who held municipal offices and whose powers were terminated for failure to observe restrictions and prohibitions or to perform duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption, or on the grounds provided for in points 1–3 of part 1 of Article 21, points 6, 7 and 10 of part 1 and part 2 of Article 30 of this Federal Law.
local33-u4b105c3ffe0c079a2c-1.locator: Article 26. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office

local33-u72cab6b6984611f63a-1.text: 4. Persons who have held municipal offices for the period specified in the municipal charter may be granted supplementary pension provision in addition to an old-age (disability) insurance pension awarded under Federal Law of 28.12.2013 No. 400-ФЗ “On Insurance Pensions” or awarded early under Federal Law of 12.12.2023 No. 565-ФЗ “On Employment of the Population in the Russian Federation”, in the cases, on the conditions and in accordance with the procedure provided for by the municipal charter in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. Expenditure associated with establishing supplementary pension provision is financed from the local budget.
local33-u72cab6b6984611f63a-1.locator: Article 26. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office

local33-ue804342be2b9ca81b3-1.text: 5. For the head of a municipality, a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may establish guarantees associated with holding a state office of that constituent entity in addition to the guarantees established under part 2 of this Article. Expenditure associated with establishing those guarantees is financed from the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-ue804342be2b9ca81b3-1.locator: Article 26. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office

local33-u73d6cae7d663304a0f-1.text: 6. Persons who have held the office of head of a municipality for the period specified by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, calculated from the date this Federal Law enters into force, may be granted supplementary pension provision in addition to an old-age (disability) insurance pension awarded under Federal Law of 28.12.2013 No. 400-ФЗ “On Insurance Pensions” or awarded early under Federal Law of 12.12.2023 No. 565-ФЗ “On Employment of the Population in the Russian Federation”, and in addition to supplementary pension provision established under part 4 of this Article, in the cases, on the conditions and in accordance with the procedure provided for by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. Expenditure associated with establishing such supplementary pension provision is financed from the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-u73d6cae7d663304a0f-1.locator: Article 26. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office

local33-u4ae2dc4c2c066c8661-1.text: Article 27. Meetings between a deputy and voters
local33-u4ae2dc4c2c066c8661-1.locator: Article 27. Meetings between a deputy and voters

local33-u3ba4dadd155a385ce3-1.text: 1. Meetings between a deputy and voters are held in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on assemblies, rallies, demonstrations, marches and picketing.
local33-u3ba4dadd155a385ce3-1.locator: Article 27. Meetings between a deputy and voters

local33-u48e42bcdf57aaa6f72-1.text: 2. Local self-government bodies designate places specifically set aside for meetings between deputies and voters, and determine the list of premises they provide for such meetings and the procedure for making those premises available.
local33-u48e42bcdf57aaa6f72-1.locator: Article 27. Meetings between a deputy and voters

local33-u5cbf89f96bf1ddebae-1.text: 3. Obstructing the organization or holding of meetings between a deputy and voters entails administrative liability in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
local33-u5cbf89f96bf1ddebae-1.locator: Article 27. Meetings between a deputy and voters

local33-uf23f78375aba94815c-1.text: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
local33-uf23f78375aba94815c-1.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices

local33-u995ec3a2198eaf5825-1.text: 1. Persons holding municipal offices may not be senators of the Russian Federation, deputies of the State Duma of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation or deputies of legislative bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, or hold other state offices of the Russian Federation, state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, state civil service positions or municipal service positions, except in the cases established by this Federal Law or other federal laws.
local33-u995ec3a2198eaf5825-1.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices

local33-u161dcdc001d1c14a34-1.text: 2. The head of a municipality may not simultaneously exercise the powers of a deputy of the municipal representative body.
local33-u161dcdc001d1c14a34-1.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices

local33-ud1eeac059bb83b555a-1.text: 3. A deputy of the representative body of a municipality or the head of a municipality may not simultaneously exercise the powers of a deputy of the representative body of another municipality or the head of another municipality, except in the cases established by this Federal Law or other federal laws.
local33-ud1eeac059bb83b555a-1.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices

local33-ud057d248ef7f34f34a-1.text: 4. Persons holding municipal offices who exercise their powers on a full-time basis may not:
local33-ud057d248ef7f34f34a-1.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices

local33-ub335c4a0ec843c00f4-1.text: 1) engage in entrepreneurial activity personally or through authorized persons;
local33-ub335c4a0ec843c00f4-1.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices

local33-udb638cce1b741b595b-1.text: 2) participate in the management of a commercial or nonprofit organization, except in the following cases:
local33-udb638cce1b741b595b-1.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices

local33-ub939c497a57e2de95d-1.text: а) participation without remuneration in the management of a political party or a trade union body, including an elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a local self-government body, or participation in a congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real estate owners;
local33-ub939c497a57e2de95d-1.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices

local33-u9160b05e0509e70303-1.text: б) participation without remuneration in the management of a nonprofit organization (other than participation in the management of a political party or a trade union body, including an elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a local self-government body, or participation in a congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real estate owners), with prior notification of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the procedure established by a law of that constituent entity;
local33-u9160b05e0509e70303-1.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices

local33-ua129c9927b6edba557-1.text: в) representing the municipality’s interests without remuneration in the council of municipalities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, other associations of municipalities, and their governing bodies;
local33-ua129c9927b6edba557-1.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices

local33-uc62a43a8a0943be748-1.text: г) representing the municipality’s interests without remuneration in the governing bodies and audit commission of an organization of which the municipality is a founder (shareholder or participant), in accordance with municipal legal acts determining the procedure for exercising a founder’s powers on behalf of the municipality or the procedure for managing municipally owned shares (participatory interests in charter capital);
local33-uc62a43a8a0943be748-1.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices

local33-u16fc3d8b8a9281510f-1.text: д) other cases provided for by federal laws;
local33-u16fc3d8b8a9281510f-1.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices

local33-u43a67aeee8d6a4adee-1.text: 3) engage in other paid activities, except teaching, scientific and other creative activities. Teaching, scientific and other creative activities may not be financed exclusively from the funds of foreign states, international and foreign organizations, foreign citizens or stateless persons, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or the legislation of the Russian Federation;
local33-u43a67aeee8d6a4adee-1.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices

local33-u79c47f2918a5ecae86-1.text: 4) be members of governing bodies, boards of trustees or supervisory boards, or other bodies of foreign nonprofit nongovernmental organizations and their structural subdivisions operating in the Russian Federation, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or the legislation of the Russian Federation.
local33-u79c47f2918a5ecae86-1.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices

local33-u9de36a43a9ba9bcd5b-1.text: 5. Persons holding municipal offices must observe the restrictions and prohibitions and perform the duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption.
local33-u9de36a43a9ba9bcd5b-1.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices

local33-uc69808311644d585fa-1.text: 6. Persons holding municipal offices who exercise their powers on a full-time basis may not participate as defense counsel or representatives (except in cases of statutory representation) in civil, administrative or criminal proceedings or in proceedings concerning an administrative offense.
local33-uc69808311644d585fa-1.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices

local33-u87e15defb46931e8cc-1.text: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
local33-u87e15defb46931e8cc-1.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u7ec9a6d81db99225bd-1.text: 1. The powers of a person holding a municipal office terminate early if the person fails to observe restrictions and prohibitions or to perform duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law.
local33-u7ec9a6d81db99225bd-1.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u9389d3159360c8bdbe-1.text: 2. The accuracy and completeness of information on income, expenditure, property and property-related obligations submitted by a person holding a municipal office in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption are verified by decision of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the procedure established by a law of that constituent entity.
local33-u9389d3159360c8bdbe-1.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u343e59c980629a848f-1.text: 3. If verification conducted under part 2 of this Article reveals failure to observe restrictions and prohibitions or to perform duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption, the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation applies to the local self-government body authorized to take the relevant decision, or to a court, for early termination of the powers of the person holding a municipal office or for another measure of liability to be imposed on that person.
local33-u343e59c980629a848f-1.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices

local33-ub7c6f8ec5de9fe0d96-1.text: 4. The following measures of liability may be imposed on a person holding a municipal office who has submitted inaccurate or incomplete information on their income, expenditure, property and property-related obligations, or such information concerning their spouse and minor children, where the distortion of that information is insignificant:
local33-ub7c6f8ec5de9fe0d96-1.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u315a79161baab102a8-1.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices

local33-ud29a16f800046222ea-1.text: 2) release of the person holding a municipal office from their position in the relevant local self-government body, with deprivation of the right to hold positions in that body until the expiry of their term of office;
local33-ud29a16f800046222ea-1.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u0f68b9eeb5da1ac547-1.text: 3) release from the exercise of powers on a full-time basis, with deprivation of the right to exercise powers on a full-time basis until the expiry of the term of office;
local33-u0f68b9eeb5da1ac547-1.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u152b99c498cb28c3df-1.text: 4) prohibition on holding positions in the relevant local self-government body until the expiry of the term of office;
local33-u152b99c498cb28c3df-1.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u3c45e7e42061e442ca-1.text: 5) prohibition on exercising powers on a full-time basis until the expiry of the term of office.
local33-u3c45e7e42061e442ca-1.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u313e816b09d42b0c61-1.text: 5. The procedure for deciding to impose the measures of liability specified in part 4 of this Article on a person holding a municipal office is determined by a municipal legal act in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-u313e816b09d42b0c61-1.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices

local33-ucb8038ee16e202db23-1.text: 6. Persons holding municipal offices are exempt from liability for failure to observe restrictions, prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established by this Federal Law and other federal laws for the purposes of combating corruption, if that failure is recognized as resulting from circumstances beyond their control in accordance with the procedure provided for in parts 3–6 of Article 13 of Federal Law of 25.12.2008 No. 273-ФЗ “On Combating Corruption”.
local33-ucb8038ee16e202db23-1.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices

local33-uf6f269f40573307216-1.text: 7. The highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may issue a warning or reprimand to the head of a municipality or the head of the local administration for improper performance or non-performance of duties to ensure that local self-government bodies exercise individual state powers delegated to them by federal laws and/or laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-uf6f269f40573307216-1.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u79c87710a2ce59c926-1.text: 8. Guarantees of the rights of persons holding municipal offices when they are subjected to criminal or administrative liability, apprehension, detention, search, interrogation or other criminal procedural or administrative procedural actions, and when operational investigative measures are conducted in respect of those persons, their residential and/or official premises, their luggage, personal and official vehicles, correspondence, means of communication used by them, and documents belonging to them, are established by federal laws.
local33-u79c87710a2ce59c926-1.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u7c2950f7f2a355c8fa-1.text: 9. Persons holding municipal offices may not be subjected to criminal or administrative liability for opinions expressed, positions taken in voting or other actions consistent with their status, including after the expiry of their terms of office. This provision does not apply where those persons have committed public insults, defamation or other violations for which liability is provided by federal law.
local33-u7c2950f7f2a355c8fa-1.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices

local33-ua99dae21828e71e3b6-1.text: 10. A person holding a municipal office’s participation in collective decision-making (including voting on agenda items), or performance of other duties of the office provided for by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, does not constitute a ground for holding that person liable for failure to comply with requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest under the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption.
local33-ua99dae21828e71e3b6-1.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u6d82f3a588f7213e6e-1.text: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
local33-u6d82f3a588f7213e6e-1.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u3415cad664c0e9355e-1.text: 1. The powers of a person holding a municipal office terminate early in the following cases:
local33-u3415cad664c0e9355e-1.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u0e9aeb7f53d83ed7dc-2.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-uc7b7da23aba01b66fa-2.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u1f93236a651e494773-1.text: 3) being declared legally incapable or of limited legal capacity by a court;
local33-u1f93236a651e494773-1.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-ucd5e8fbf46f481ce25-1.text: 4) being declared missing or dead by a court;
local33-ucd5e8fbf46f481ce25-1.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u9f851dd5f72ed95bb3-1.text: 5) a court judgment of conviction against the person becoming legally effective;
local33-u9f851dd5f72ed95bb3-1.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u2551057e80794aa24d-1.text: 6) departure from the Russian Federation for permanent residence abroad;
local33-u2551057e80794aa24d-1.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u1d99e4f172fdf6b53f-1.text: 7) termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation, or possession of citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state or a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen of the Russian Federation’s right to permanent residence in a foreign state;
local33-u1d99e4f172fdf6b53f-1.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u406572628b3dbe8ff8-1.text: 8) early termination of the powers of the relevant local self-government body;
local33-u406572628b3dbe8ff8-1.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u8b1eb8aa6faed3bbc3-1.text: 9) conscription for military service or assignment to alternative civilian service in its place;
local33-u8b1eb8aa6faed3bbc3-1.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-ubc4e7138c6601d1a15-1.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u20a9451facf6ebb8e5-1.text: 11) other cases established by this Federal Law and other federal laws.
local33-u20a9451facf6ebb8e5-1.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u38aa417cfce7b7a50e-1.text: 2. A deputy’s powers in the municipal representative body are terminated early by a decision of that body if the deputy is absent without valid reasons from all its meetings for six consecutive months.
local33-u38aa417cfce7b7a50e-1.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-ufad656810336f99681-1.text: 3. A deputy of the municipal representative body whose powers that body has decided to terminate early may apply to a court to challenge the decision within 10 days after its official publication.
local33-ufad656810336f99681-1.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u4dc2adea8723af07f1-1.text: 4. If a deputy of the municipal representative body whose powers have been terminated early by a decision of that body challenges the decision in court, the representative body may not decide to call by-elections of deputies until the court decision becomes legally effective.
local33-u4dc2adea8723af07f1-1.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u213a9547c934eeaabf-1.text: 5. A decision of the municipal representative body to terminate a deputy’s powers early is adopted no later than 30 days after the ground for early termination arises; if the ground arises between sessions of the representative body, the decision is adopted no later than three months after that ground arises.
local33-u213a9547c934eeaabf-1.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-uc391f4a8963c1c3537-1.text: 6. If the municipal representative body fails to adopt a decision to terminate a deputy’s powers early on the ground provided for in point 2 of part 1 of this Article within the time limits provided for in part 5 of this Article, the deputy may apply to a court to challenge the representative body’s inaction in accordance with the procedure provided for by procedural legislation.
local33-uc391f4a8963c1c3537-1.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-u829c480896e2c719f9-1.text: 7. Where the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation applies for early termination of a deputy’s powers in the municipal representative body, the day the ground for early termination arises is the day that body receives the application.
local33-u829c480896e2c719f9-1.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices

local33-uc7acdcaaa2cc1081bb-1.text: Municipal service, including requirements for municipal service positions, the status of municipal servants, and the conditions and procedure for performing municipal service, is legally regulated by federal law and by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, municipal charters and other municipal legal acts adopted in accordance with it.

local33-u05510c12a0c3f2b683-1.text: Chapter 4. Functional foundations of the organization of local self-government
local33-u05510c12a0c3f2b683-1.locator: Chapter 4. Functional foundations of the organization of local self-government

local33-u0ec89b853be16b5051-1.text: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
local33-u0ec89b853be16b5051-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u02bcd8718d9fa79b9e-1.text: 1. The powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life that may not be redistributed between local self-government bodies and state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation include:
local33-u02bcd8718d9fa79b9e-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ub70fc1d8e463f966de-1.text: 1) adoption of the municipal charter and amendments and additions to it, and issue of municipal legal acts;
local33-ub70fc1d8e463f966de-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u5ff6dfdf0150a109f1-1.text: 2) establishment of the municipality’s official symbols;
local33-u5ff6dfdf0150a109f1-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u9851867dad05b0d1eb-1.text: 3) preparation and consideration of the draft municipal budget, approval and execution of the local budget, municipal financial control, including control over execution of the municipal budget, and preparation and approval of the report on local budget execution in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation;
local33-u9851867dad05b0d1eb-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-uf463e65e6fe30be737-1.text: 4) possession, use and disposal of municipally owned property;
local33-uf463e65e6fe30be737-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u6bc13d395dd784fe5d-1.text: 5) establishment, introduction and termination of previously introduced municipal local taxes and fees in accordance with the legislation on taxes and fees;
local33-u6bc13d395dd784fe5d-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u368e11993a9aa8768e-1.text: 6) participation in protecting citizens’ health in the municipality, including ensuring access to medical care, in accordance with Federal Law of 21.11.2011 No. 323-ФЗ “On the Fundamentals of Health Protection of Citizens in the Russian Federation”, including in creating conditions for providing medical care to the population (except in territories included in the list approved by the Government of the Russian Federation of territories whose populations receive medical care in medical organizations subordinate to the federal executive authority responsible for medical and sanitary support of the populations of certain territories), in accordance with the territorial program of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens;
local33-u368e11993a9aa8768e-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u4417324f3bbf465d05-1.text: 7) organizational and logistical support for the preparation and conduct of municipal elections and local referendums;
local33-u4417324f3bbf465d05-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-udd0f226cf2e20b9eb7-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u24de036b71a2489366-1.text: 9) establishment of a print media outlet and/or online publication to promulgate municipal legal acts and bring official information to the attention of municipal residents;
local33-u24de036b71a2489366-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ub5e575c17f575f8798-1.text: 10) establishment of municipal enterprises and institutions, provision of funding for the activities of municipal treasury-funded institutions and for the performance of municipal assignments by municipal budgetary and autonomous institutions;
local33-ub5e575c17f575f8798-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u1fd10f9933e64f2f84-1.text: 11) setting tariffs for services provided and work performed by municipal enterprises and institutions, unless otherwise provided by federal laws;
local33-u1fd10f9933e64f2f84-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ueb105a74d39cfc2f0a-1.text: 12) implementation of measures to combat corruption within the municipality’s boundaries;
local33-ueb105a74d39cfc2f0a-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u2b7624f08e9891e94d-1.text: 13) participation in preventing terrorism and extremism and in minimizing and/or eliminating the consequences of manifestations of terrorism and extremism within the municipality’s boundaries;
local33-u2b7624f08e9891e94d-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-uc69e9fab1c90504e17-1.text: 14) participation in preventing emergencies and eliminating their consequences within the municipality’s boundaries;
local33-uc69e9fab1c90504e17-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u0df34aeb9968303366-1.text: 15) organization and implementation of mobilization preparedness measures for municipal enterprises and institutions located in the municipality;
local33-u0df34aeb9968303366-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u4da2c5e5dba39136cb-1.text: 16) maintaining records of citizens who retain the right to a social payment to purchase housing outside territories formerly included in closed administrative-territorial formations in respect of which the President of the Russian Federation has decided on transformation or abolition, in accordance with the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on closed administrative-territorial formations; determining the amount of that payment; monitoring citizens’ compliance with the conditions for receiving it; and exercising the right to pay the cost of travel of citizens and their family members from their former to their new place of residence and the cost of transporting their luggage;
local33-u4da2c5e5dba39136cb-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ud091e1ed18917b8f76-1.text: 17) conducting international and foreign economic relations in accordance with this Federal Law;
local33-ud091e1ed18917b8f76-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u467c6e73ae18db5508-1.text: 18) exercising municipal control over compliance with requirements established by municipal legal acts adopted on matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life.
local33-u467c6e73ae18db5508-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u31c23233c4ef493e9e-1.text: 2. The powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life that may be redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation for exercise by state authorities of that constituent entity include:
local33-u31c23233c4ef493e9e-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-uc79ba998bf03ea658a-1.text: 1) organization of electricity, heat, gas and water supplies to the population, wastewater disposal and fuel supplies to the population within the municipality’s boundaries, within the powers established by the legislation of the Russian Federation;
local33-uc79ba998bf03ea658a-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u746248ee936622ceb2-1.text: 2) provision of housing to low-income citizens residing in the municipality who need housing, organization of construction and maintenance of the municipal housing stock, creation of conditions for housing construction, decisions approving the alteration of installations and replanning of premises in apartment buildings, and exercise of other powers of local self-government bodies under housing legislation;
local33-u746248ee936622ceb2-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ud34b5f0580aa49bc84-1.text: 3) provision of premises for an officer holding the position of district police commissioner to work in the administrative district of the municipality served by that officer;
local33-ud34b5f0580aa49bc84-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ud117668503e33625fc-1.text: 4) organization of generally accessible and free preschool, primary general, basic general and secondary general education under basic general education programs in municipal educational organizations (except powers to finance the implementation of basic general education programs in accordance with federal state educational standards); organization of supplementary education for children in municipal educational organizations (except supplementary education for children financed by state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation); organization of supplementary education for adults under supplementary sports training programs in municipal educational organizations; and creation of conditions for supervision and care of children and for their upkeep in municipal educational organizations;
local33-ud117668503e33625fc-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
