local33-ufbc8f92ec3de4c4edf-1.text: 5) ensuring conditions for the development of physical culture and sport in the municipality, including promoting the development and accessibility of mass sport, developing children’s and youth sport (including school sport), and organizing and holding official municipal physical culture and sports events;
local33-ufbc8f92ec3de4c4edf-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u5643a85d7a92dd1789-1.text: 6) implementation, within their powers, of measures to ensure the organization of children’s recreation during school holidays, including measures to protect their lives and health;
local33-u5643a85d7a92dd1789-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ud428397b525e3aa466-1.text: 7) creation of conditions for providing municipal residents with communications, catering, retail and consumer services;
local33-ud428397b525e3aa466-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u916f244a8d9e6928d5-1.text: 8) establishment and maintenance of the municipal archive;
local33-u916f244a8d9e6928d5-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u85c5139bc2e6a86f89-1.text: 9) organization of library services for the population and acquisition and preservation of the collections of municipal libraries;
local33-u85c5139bc2e6a86f89-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u26c5ef926a87b9bc9f-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u8762e085f9fb6bec95-1.text: 11) assignment, change and cancellation of addresses of addressable objects; assignment, change and cancellation of names of elements of the street and road network (except roads of federal, regional or intermunicipal significance) and of elements of the planning structure within the municipality’s boundaries; and entry of information in the State Address Register;
local33-u8762e085f9fb6bec95-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u17b188ee01f1657de5-1.text: 12) approval of rules for improvement and upkeep of the municipality’s territory, and organization of such improvement and upkeep in accordance with those rules;
local33-u17b188ee01f1657de5-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u0cc9ed306257deb330-1.text: 13) adoption of decisions and implementation of measures in the municipality to identify right holders of previously recorded real estate, and submission of information about those right holders for entry in the Unified State Register of Real Estate;
local33-u0cc9ed306257deb330-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u4f912fe3d6e105d91f-1.text: 14) ensuring performance of the work necessary to create artificial land plots for municipal needs in accordance with federal law;
local33-u4f912fe3d6e105d91f-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u4146d16758cc87bd9d-1.text: 15) identification of sites of accumulated environmental damage and organization of remediation of that damage in territories located within the boundaries of municipally owned land plots;
local33-u4146d16758cc87bd9d-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ucbfdef352e04974489-1.text: 16) organization of collection of statistical indicators characterizing the state of the municipality’s economy and social sphere, and provision of those data to state authorities in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation;
local33-ucbfdef352e04974489-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u47c7f9c5ad47fb186e-1.text: 17) recording in household registers the personal subsidiary farms operated by citizens in accordance with Federal Law of 07.07.2003 No. 112-ФЗ “On Personal Subsidiary Farming”;
local33-u47c7f9c5ad47fb186e-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ue4613c36e89b2aed90-1.text: 18) organization of professional education and supplementary professional education for persons holding municipal offices, municipal servants and employees of municipal enterprises and institutions, and organization of personnel training for municipal service in accordance with the procedure provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on education and on municipal service;
local33-ue4613c36e89b2aed90-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u9c8716a576f5f6b8df-1.text: 19) development and implementation of measures to strengthen interethnic and interfaith harmony, support and develop the languages and cultures of the peoples of the Russian Federation residing in the municipality, realize the rights of indigenous small-numbered peoples and other national minorities, ensure migrants’ social and cultural adaptation, and prevent interethnic conflicts;
local33-u9c8716a576f5f6b8df-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ue588ff1b8e80c1d2f7-1.text: 20) creation of conditions for the development of local traditional folk artistic creativity, and participation in the preservation, revival and development of folk arts and crafts;
local33-ue588ff1b8e80c1d2f7-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ue6f13abacfc96e6a2a-1.text: 21) ensuring basic fire safety measures within the municipality’s boundaries;
local33-ue6f13abacfc96e6a2a-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u730e25bf1c5dc9315b-1.text: 22) creation of conditions for municipal residents to receive services from cultural organizations, for the organization of leisure and mass recreation for residents, and development of public recreation areas;
local33-u730e25bf1c5dc9315b-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ueb856f081007a6e17e-1.text: 23) preservation, use and promotion of municipally owned cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments), and protection of cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) of local (municipal) significance located in the municipality;
local33-ueb856f081007a6e17e-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u378cbec747817bc9e8-1.text: 24) creation of conditions for the development of agricultural production and expansion of the market for agricultural products, raw materials and food;
local33-u378cbec747817bc9e8-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u3a55c7e864a11f9dbe-1.text: 25) promotion of the development of small and medium-sized entrepreneurship;
local33-u3a55c7e864a11f9dbe-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u177abd7a94a4050c90-1.text: 26) support for socially oriented nonprofit organizations, charitable activities and volunteering;
local33-u177abd7a94a4050c90-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ua27dfda5773d803510-1.text: 27) support for scientific, scientific and technological, and innovation activities carried out in the municipality; adoption of programs and organization and conduct of municipal events aimed at popularizing science;
local33-ua27dfda5773d803510-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-uf622f24bd9be4dda5b-1.text: 28) organization and implementation of work with children and young people; participation in the implementation of youth policy; development and implementation of measures to ensure and protect young people’s rights and legitimate interests; development and implementation of municipal programs in the principal areas of youth policy implementation; and organization and conduct of monitoring of youth policy implementation in the municipality;
local33-uf622f24bd9be4dda5b-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u81e93358b7ca0e43fe-1.text: 29) exercise of the following types of municipal control in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on state control (supervision) and municipal control in the Russian Federation:
local33-u81e93358b7ca0e43fe-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-uead5f9eb5473376b66-1.text: а) municipal control over compliance by the single heat supply organization with obligations to construct, reconstruct and/or modernize heat supply facilities;
local33-uead5f9eb5473376b66-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u63f28068c9373f7955-1.text: б) municipal control in the field of territorial improvement and upkeep, whose subject is compliance with the municipality’s territorial improvement and upkeep rules, including requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of social, engineering and transport infrastructure facilities and services provided (in the course of municipal control in this field, an order may be issued to remedy violations of mandatory requirements identified through observation of compliance with mandatory requirements (safety monitoring);
local33-u63f28068c9373f7955-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u5de0dd85045ac9a749-1.text: в) municipal control in the field of protection and use of specially protected natural areas of local significance;
local33-u5de0dd85045ac9a749-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ua59aa74a8cd345735d-1.text: г) municipal control over road transport, urban surface electric transport and road infrastructure within the boundaries of settlements forming part of the relevant municipality;
local33-ua59aa74a8cd345735d-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u4208050a5f100b0ca7-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u2313df5d85fb148e6d-1.text: е) municipal land control within the municipality’s boundaries;
local33-u2313df5d85fb148e6d-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u063782a412377e24b3-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u8dacaa185a9429f3fb-1.text: 3. To ensure the population’s daily life, a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may provide for local self-government bodies to exercise the following powers:
local33-u8dacaa185a9429f3fb-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u999c1226ab6519cfdb-1.text: 1) road-related activities concerning roads of local significance within the municipality’s boundaries and ensuring road traffic safety on them, including creating and ensuring the operation of parking facilities (parking spaces), organizing road traffic, and exercising other powers concerning road use and road-related activities in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation;
local33-u999c1226ab6519cfdb-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u13cd349ac44f696720-1.text: 2) creation of conditions for providing transport services to the population and organization of transport services for the population within the municipality’s boundaries;
local33-u13cd349ac44f696720-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u9431e16d8af8ae90b7-1.text: 3) development and approval of programs for the integrated development of municipal utility infrastructure systems, transport infrastructure and social infrastructure, the requirements for which are established by the Government of the Russian Federation;
local33-u9431e16d8af8ae90b7-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u90df7f63950dc1dba4-1.text: 4) organization of environmental protection measures within the municipality’s boundaries, including organization and conduct, in accordance with environmental protection legislation, of public discussions of planned economic and other activities in the relevant municipality;
local33-u90df7f63950dc1dba4-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ued35615d14f1df6aeb-1.text: 5) approval and implementation of energy conservation and energy efficiency programs; organization of energy audits of apartment buildings whose premises form part of the municipal housing stock within the municipality’s boundaries; and organization and implementation of other measures provided for by legislation on energy conservation and energy efficiency;
local33-ued35615d14f1df6aeb-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ue1504228a8580e9952-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u1b1bfbe83c52a13803-1.text: 7) participation in organizing the accumulation (including separate accumulation), collection, transportation, processing, recovery, neutralization and burial of municipal solid waste;
local33-u1b1bfbe83c52a13803-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u8f9795b8a26902d5ac-1.text: 8) development and approval of municipal master plans and land use and development rules; approval of territorial planning documentation; issue of an urban development plan for a land plot located within the municipality’s boundaries; issue of construction permits (except in the cases provided for by the Urban Development Code of the Russian Federation and other federal laws) and commissioning permits for the construction or reconstruction of capital construction facilities located in the municipality; approval of municipal local urban planning design standards; maintenance of an information system supporting urban development activities carried out in the municipality; decisions on reserving land and expropriating land plots within the municipality’s boundaries for municipal needs; inspections of buildings and structures in the cases provided for by the Urban Development Code of the Russian Federation and issue of recommendations to remedy violations identified during those inspections; sending notices that the parameters of an individual residential building or garden house specified in a notice of planned construction comply with the established parameters and that placement of the individual residential building or garden house on the land plot is permissible, notices that those parameters do not comply with the established parameters and/or that such placement is impermissible, and notices that a constructed or reconstructed individual residential building or garden house complies or does not comply with urban development legislation, where such buildings or houses are constructed or reconstructed on land plots in municipalities; decisions, in accordance with the civil legislation of the Russian Federation, to demolish an unauthorized structure, to demolish an unauthorized structure or bring it into compliance with established requirements, and to expropriate a land plot not used for its designated purpose or used in violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation; demolition of an unauthorized structure or bringing it into compliance with established requirements in the cases provided for by the Urban Development Code of the Russian Federation; decisions to declare a capital construction facility unsafe and subject to demolition or reconstruction in the cases provided for by that Code; and decisions on integrated territorial development and conclusion of integrated territorial development agreements in the cases provided for by that Code;
local33-u8f9795b8a26902d5ac-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ue9f6998448f13d1f58-1.text: 9) decisions to change a land plot’s permitted use from one type to another, and decisions to transfer privately owned land plots from one land category to another, except in the cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation;
local33-ue9f6998448f13d1f58-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u37b6fb8023b06b2096-1.text: 10) organization, in accordance with federal law, of comprehensive cadastral work and approval of the territory’s cadastral map-plan;
local33-u37b6fb8023b06b2096-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ub45e75cc7089aec95c-1.text: 11) decisions to establish or abolish forest districts and subordinate forest subdistricts located on settlement lands, and to establish and change their boundaries; and development and approval of forestry regulations for forest districts located on lands of settlements forming part of the municipality’s territory;
local33-ub45e75cc7089aec95c-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u1ff821450777e6d663-1.text: 12) implementation of forest management planning measures for forests located on lands of settlements forming part of the municipality’s territory;
local33-u1ff821450777e6d663-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ud4a0ff5707348c8b35-1.text: 13) approval of the advertising structures placement plan, issue and cancellation of permits to install and operate advertising structures in the municipality, and issue of orders to dismantle advertising structures installed without authorization in the municipality, in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on advertising;
local33-ud4a0ff5707348c8b35-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-uaee33aaaf090983b26-1.text: 14) organization and implementation of territorial defense and civil defense measures and measures to protect the population and territory of the municipality from natural and technological emergencies, including maintaining public danger warning systems and civil defense facilities in constant readiness for use, and creating and maintaining stocks of equipment, food, medical and other supplies for civil defense purposes;
local33-uaee33aaaf090983b26-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-uc1462271c5c784bff9-1.text: 15) establishment, maintenance and organization of the activities of emergency rescue services and/or emergency rescue units in the municipality;
local33-uc1462271c5c784bff9-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u52376fa1700243fdb7-1.text: 16) implementation of measures to ensure people’s safety at water bodies and protect their lives and health;
local33-u52376fa1700243fdb7-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u136087369298ccf19a-1.text: 17) establishment of rules for the use of public water bodies for personal and household needs, and informing the population of restrictions on the use of those water bodies, including ensuring citizens’ free access to public water bodies and their shore strips, and establishment of rules for the use of water bodies for recreational purposes;
local33-u136087369298ccf19a-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ue9db733380ce38ba27-1.text: 18) support for citizens and their associations participating in the protection of public order, and creation of conditions for the activities of voluntary public patrols.
local33-ue9db733380ce38ba27-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u49b27a9ccf5c134d0f-1.text: 4. The powers provided for in parts 2 and 3 of this Article are exercised taking into account the special provisions of this Article.
local33-u49b27a9ccf5c134d0f-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u2f2609071a7a1bfaf9-1.text: 5. The powers provided for in part 2 of this Article may be redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation for exercise by state authorities of that constituent entity.
local33-u2f2609071a7a1bfaf9-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u2517ef0793143ae6c3-1.text: 6. The powers provided for in part 2 of this Article that are exercised by state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation following redistribution may not be transferred to local self-government bodies, even in part, through the procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers provided for in Article 34 of this Federal Law.
local33-u2517ef0793143ae6c3-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u592119f3e8f7b1862c-1.text: 7. The powers provided for in part 3 of this Article are redistributed by virtue of this Federal Law for exercise by state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. The powers provided for in part 3 of this Article may be redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation for exercise by local self-government bodies.
local33-u592119f3e8f7b1862c-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ud48139714596b46011-1.text: 8. Redistribution by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation of the powers provided for in part 3 of this Article for exercise by local self-government bodies does not constitute vesting those bodies with individual state powers under Article 34 of this Federal Law.
local33-ud48139714596b46011-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u597682c083c602668e-1.text: 9. Redistribution by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation of the powers provided for in parts 2 and 3 of this Article is permitted for a period no shorter than the term of office of the legislative body of that constituent entity. Laws of a constituent entity providing for redistribution of powers enter into force at the beginning of the next financial year and must be adopted no later than two months before that year begins. Such laws may apply to all or to individual municipalities in the constituent entity and establish the scope of the powers redistributed by the law (including a list of individual components of a power where that power is not redistributed in full). If the powers redistributed by the law concern areas in which federal legislation provides for municipal control, the law on redistribution must contain provisions redistributing powers to exercise the corresponding type of municipal control. A law of the constituent entity redistributing the powers provided for in part 3 of this Article for exercise by local self-government bodies must contain provisions for transferring to those bodies the material resources and financial means necessary to exercise the powers.
local33-u597682c083c602668e-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ua0402dbb3af7b6131d-1.text: 10. To ensure that state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation exercise the powers provided for in part 2 of this Article that have been redistributed under part 5 of this Article and/or the powers provided for in part 3 of this Article that have not been redistributed by a law of that constituent entity for exercise by local self-government bodies, municipal property is made available for use without charge by the state authorities of the constituent entity under an agreement concluded between those authorities and local self-government bodies. The agreement determines the procedure for possession and use of the municipal property made available for use without charge by the state authorities of the constituent entity.
local33-ua0402dbb3af7b6131d-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-uea9551a69a1eaf1f2d-1.text: 11. The powers provided for in part 2 of this Article that have not been redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation are exercised by local self-government bodies. Exercise of those powers provided for in part 2 of this Article that have not been redistributed is financed from the local budget.
local33-uea9551a69a1eaf1f2d-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u5d2f009fab3163b6c6-1.text: 12. The powers provided for in part 2 of this Article that have been redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation are exercised by state authorities of that constituent entity. Exercise of those powers provided for in part 2 of this Article that have been redistributed is financed from the budget of the constituent entity, without redistribution of revenues between that budget and the local budget.
local33-u5d2f009fab3163b6c6-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ueaa1774bbec2d7ec2f-1.text: 13. The powers provided for in part 3 of this Article that have not been redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation for exercise by local self-government bodies are exercised by state authorities of that constituent entity. Exercise of those powers provided for in part 3 of this Article that have not been redistributed for exercise by local self-government bodies is financed from the budget of the constituent entity, without redistribution of revenues between that budget and the local budget.
local33-ueaa1774bbec2d7ec2f-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-uf6e17ef942741b7da0-1.text: 14. The powers provided for in part 3 of this Article that have been redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation for exercise by local self-government bodies are exercised by local self-government bodies. Exercise of the powers provided for in part 3 of this Article that have been redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation for exercise by local self-government bodies is financed from the local budget, taking into account uniform, additional and/or differentiated shares of individual federal and/or regional taxes and fees, taxes under special tax regimes and non-tax revenues which, under the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and legislation on taxes and fees, are payable to the budget of the constituent entity, and/or interbudgetary transfers, mandatorily transferred by state authorities of the constituent entity to municipal budgets in accordance with the procedure established by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation. When exercising the powers provided for in part 3 of this Article that have been redistributed by a law of the constituent entity for exercise by local self-government bodies, those bodies may additionally use their own material resources and financial means in the cases and in accordance with the procedure provided for by the municipal charter.
local33-uf6e17ef942741b7da0-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u1c9211c863e843ec87-1.text: 15. If a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation redistributes the powers provided for in part 3 of this Article for exercise by local self-government bodies, state authorities of the constituent entity may oversee the exercise of those powers by local self-government bodies.
local33-u1c9211c863e843ec87-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u0ae733219a274e4b96-1.text: 16. Local self-government bodies bear responsibility for exercising the powers provided for in part 3 of this Article that have been redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation for exercise by local self-government bodies, within the material resources and financial means transferred to those bodies in accordance with the law of the constituent entity provided for in part 5 of this Article.
local33-u0ae733219a274e4b96-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u76b01fcdfa82d4f0e7-1.text: 17. The powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life are established by parts 1–3 of this Article.
local33-u76b01fcdfa82d4f0e7-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-ud973baa9b5bf72b9ea-1.text: 18. The list of powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life may be changed only by amending and/or supplementing parts 1–3 of this Article.
local33-ud973baa9b5bf72b9ea-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u8cdafdc771928dfd37-1.text: 19. The powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life established by parts 1–3 of this Article may be specified in greater detail by federal laws to ensure their exercise. No new expenditure obligations not provided for by this Federal Law may thereby be imposed on municipalities.
local33-u8cdafdc771928dfd37-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-uaf0964e9eeca3ea0bd-1.text: 20. When exercising the powers established by part 1 of this Article, local self-government bodies are authorized to procure goods, work and services. When exercising the powers established by part 2 or 3 of this Article (taking account of their redistribution), local self-government bodies and/or state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation are authorized to procure goods, work and services.
local33-uaf0964e9eeca3ea0bd-1.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life

local33-u9baf277b62c78d0163-1.text: Article 33. Exercise of individual state powers by local self-government bodies
local33-u9baf277b62c78d0163-1.locator: Article 33. Exercise of individual state powers by local self-government bodies

local33-u76d27cfe3bd9a82e31-1.text: 1. Constituent entities of the Russian Federation may delegate to local self-government bodies the exercise of individual state powers exercised by those constituent entities in the territories of the respective municipalities, in accordance with Article 34 of this Federal Law and Federal Law of 21.12.2021 No. 414-ФЗ “On the General Principles of the Organization of Public Authority in Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation”, which establishes the general principles for the organization of public authority in a constituent entity, provided that the material resources and financial means necessary to exercise those powers are transferred to the local self-government bodies.
local33-u76d27cfe3bd9a82e31-1.locator: Article 33. Exercise of individual state powers by local self-government bodies

local33-u76e923a3e4e59b77a3-1.text: 2. Local self-government bodies bear responsibility for exercising delegated powers of the Russian Federation and powers of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation within the subventions provided to local budgets to finance the exercise of the corresponding powers.
local33-u76e923a3e4e59b77a3-1.locator: Article 33. Exercise of individual state powers by local self-government bodies

local33-ud72b87fd482563a8f1-1.text: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
local33-ud72b87fd482563a8f1-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-u734224ea69120a0742-1.text: 1. Local self-government bodies are vested with individual state powers of the Russian Federation by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and with individual state powers of constituent entities of the Russian Federation by laws of those constituent entities.
local33-u734224ea69120a0742-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-u6b5c83e36c80c05a3e-1.text: 2. Individual state powers of the Russian Federation delegated for exercise by state authorities of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may be delegated by laws of that constituent entity to local self-government bodies in accordance with the procedure established by this Article, if the right to do so is granted by the federal laws delegating the corresponding powers of the Russian Federation to state authorities of its constituent entities, and unless otherwise provided by regulatory legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation or regulatory legal acts of the Government of the Russian Federation.
local33-u6b5c83e36c80c05a3e-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-u234178558aa9fce347-1.text: 3. Local self-government bodies may be vested with individual state powers for an unlimited period or, if the powers have a fixed period of validity, for that period.
local33-u234178558aa9fce347-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-uc5714084da4c066e22-1.text: 4. The exercise of delegated powers is financed through subventions from the relevant budget. Local self-government bodies may additionally use their own property (material resources and financial means) to exercise individual state powers delegated to them, in the cases and in accordance with the procedure provided for by the municipal charter.
local33-uc5714084da4c066e22-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-u485ff6b5e80b70decf-1.text: 5. Provisions of federal laws and laws of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers enter into force at the beginning of the next financial year; those federal laws and constituent entity laws must be adopted no later than two months before that year begins.
local33-u485ff6b5e80b70decf-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-ue527b491b11efb3d26-1.text: 6. A federal law or law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers must contain:
local33-ue527b491b11efb3d26-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-ubef4c1ad0e69ef326d-1.text: 1) the type or name of the municipality whose local self-government bodies are vested with the corresponding powers;
local33-ubef4c1ad0e69ef326d-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-u5207c4645e1997ba57-1.text: 2) a list of the rights and duties of local self-government bodies and of state authorities in exercising the corresponding powers;
local33-u5207c4645e1997ba57-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-u5eb16409e5f404498c-1.text: 3) a method (methodology) for calculating the standards used to determine the total amount of subventions provided to local budgets from the federal budget and the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation to exercise the corresponding powers, including federal or regional state minimum social standards. The total amount of subventions provided to local budgets from the federal budget and the constituent entity’s budget must be determined taking into account the costs of organizing the exercise of delegated powers of the Russian Federation and powers of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
local33-u5eb16409e5f404498c-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-u12432324e89604aedc-1.text: 4) a list of property to be transferred for use and/or management that is necessary to exercise the individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies, or the procedure for determining that list;
local33-u12432324e89604aedc-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-ue0f989a7e003326ca1-1.text: 5) the procedure for local self-government bodies to report on the exercise of the individual state powers delegated to them;
local33-ue0f989a7e003326ca1-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-u279dcc11d42421f8b1-1.text: 6) the procedure for state authorities to oversee the exercise of individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies, and the names of the bodies exercising that oversight;
local33-u279dcc11d42421f8b1-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-ud3f27fa2e8bd859f4a-1.text: 7) the conditions and procedure for terminating the exercise by local self-government bodies of the individual state powers delegated to them.
local33-ud3f27fa2e8bd859f4a-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-ud289f90698ead75085-1.text: 7. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation vesting local self-government bodies with state powers of the Russian Federation delegated for exercise by state authorities of that constituent entity must also contain provisions determining:
local33-ud289f90698ead75085-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-ud2cee910763024959f-1.text: 1) the rights and duties of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation relating to the exercise by local self-government bodies of delegated state powers of the Russian Federation, analogous to the rights and duties of federal executive authorities relating to the exercise of delegated powers and provided for by the federal law under which those powers are delegated for exercise by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, insofar as establishing such rights and duties does not conflict with federal laws;
local33-ud2cee910763024959f-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-u393a7f56881b8e340c-1.text: 2) the rights and duties of local self-government bodies relating to the exercise of state powers of the Russian Federation delegated to them, analogous to the rights and duties of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation relating to the exercise of delegated powers and provided for by the federal law under which those powers are delegated for exercise by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, insofar as establishing such rights and duties does not conflict with federal laws.
local33-u393a7f56881b8e340c-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-uef7515689485e2c2ec-1.text: 8. When a draft law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers is submitted to the legislative body of that constituent entity, the holder or holders of the right of legislative initiative must submit an opinion on the draft law from the council of municipalities of the relevant constituent entity.
local33-uef7515689485e2c2ec-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-u589f4c0f530f6c7663-1.text: 9. State authorities, in accordance with federal law, oversee the exercise of individual state powers by local self-government bodies and the use of property provided for those purposes.
local33-u589f4c0f530f6c7663-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-uae5e7c216e9ae18611-1.text: 10. If violations of statutory requirements concerning the exercise of individual state powers by local self-government bodies or local self-government officials are identified, the corresponding powers may be withdrawn in accordance with the procedure provided for by this Federal Law. Authorized state bodies may issue written orders to remedy such violations that are binding on local self-government bodies and officials. Those orders may be challenged in court.
local33-uae5e7c216e9ae18611-1.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers

local33-u5f85fe4b5058c2c071-1.text: Article 35. Procedure for withdrawing individual state powers from local self-government bodies
local33-u5f85fe4b5058c2c071-1.locator: Article 35. Procedure for withdrawing individual state powers from local self-government bodies

local33-u035ebfe526d57a5d9e-1.text: 1. Individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies are withdrawn by federal laws or laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, respectively.
local33-u035ebfe526d57a5d9e-1.locator: Article 35. Procedure for withdrawing individual state powers from local self-government bodies

local33-ue9d0ba225ce308c1b0-1.text: 2. Federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation providing for the withdrawal of individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies enter into force at the beginning of the next financial year.
local33-ue9d0ba225ce308c1b0-1.locator: Article 35. Procedure for withdrawing individual state powers from local self-government bodies

local33-uebbd68da497c8b2cef-1.text: Article 36. Participation of local self-government bodies in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them
local33-uebbd68da497c8b2cef-1.locator: Article 36. Participation of local self-government bodies in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them

local33-u5c68f89664a4db8933-1.text: 1. On matters concerning the exercise of individual state powers by local self-government bodies, federal executive authorities and executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation may, in the cases established by federal laws and laws of constituent entities and within their competence, issue binding regulatory legal acts and oversee their implementation.
local33-u5c68f89664a4db8933-1.locator: Article 36. Participation of local self-government bodies in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them

local33-u56cc7e3c7d08681a85-1.text: 2. Federal laws establishing the right of local self-government bodies to participate in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them under Article 34 of this Federal Law may contain provisions allowing and defining the limits of legal regulation of those powers by state authorities.
local33-u56cc7e3c7d08681a85-1.locator: Article 36. Participation of local self-government bodies in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them

local33-ua3410f1f47bf556ef5-1.text: 3. Local self-government bodies participate in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them under Article 34 of this Federal Law if the municipal representative body decides to exercise the right to participate in the exercise of those powers.
local33-ua3410f1f47bf556ef5-1.locator: Article 36. Participation of local self-government bodies in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them

local33-ud2ebde44f7034384a4-1.text: 4. Local self-government bodies may incur expenditure from the municipal budget (excluding funds transferred to the local budget for earmarked expenditure) to exercise powers not delegated to them under Article 34 of this Federal Law, if federal laws allow such expenditure.
local33-ud2ebde44f7034384a4-1.locator: Article 36. Participation of local self-government bodies in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them

local33-uf1072a775f5b170897-1.text: 5. Local self-government bodies may establish additional social support and social assistance measures for individual categories of citizens from municipal budget funds (excluding funds transferred to the local budget for earmarked expenditure), irrespective of whether federal laws contain provisions establishing that right.
local33-uf1072a775f5b170897-1.locator: Article 36. Participation of local self-government bodies in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them

local33-ue657a5eb3ecdf0ac0c-1.text: 6. Financing the powers provided for in this Article is not an obligation of the municipality, is undertaken where resources permit, and does not constitute a ground for allocating additional funds from other budgets of the budget system of the Russian Federation.
local33-ue657a5eb3ecdf0ac0c-1.locator: Article 36. Participation of local self-government bodies in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them

local33-u9b3733e9812af2bbfe-1.text: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
local33-u9b3733e9812af2bbfe-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u1a428cb812a7a369b4-1.text: 1. Local self-government bodies may exercise powers not assigned to them as powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life using local budget revenues, excluding interbudgetary transfers provided from budgets of the budget system of the Russian Federation and tax revenue received under additional revenue-sharing rates.
local33-u1a428cb812a7a369b4-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-udc03c8815dacf9f4a8-1.text: 2. Local self-government bodies have the right to:
local33-udc03c8815dacf9f4a8-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u6baf0a4f7ac87a9ed3-1.text: 1) exercise powers in the field of strategic planning provided for by federal legislation on strategic planning in the Russian Federation, including approval of the municipality’s socioeconomic development strategy;
local33-u6baf0a4f7ac87a9ed3-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u6db967848ce171c9fc-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u673ca7ebee579b8595-1.text: 3) create conditions for organizing independent assessments of the quality of conditions under which organizations provide services, in accordance with the procedure and on the conditions established by federal laws; use the results of such assessments when evaluating the performance of heads of subordinate organizations; and, in accordance with federal laws, monitor the adoption of measures to remedy shortcomings identified by such assessments;
local33-u673ca7ebee579b8595-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u66b828e3c19d161452-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u4362f23fe4611625fb-1.text: 5) create conditions for the development of tourism;
local33-u4362f23fe4611625fb-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u195285d451ddfd7148-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u838b4dd924c53397fb-1.text: 7) promote the development of physical culture and sport for persons with disabilities and persons with health-related limitations, and of adaptive physical culture and adaptive sport;
local33-u838b4dd924c53397fb-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u0aba421a7fca963afc-1.text: 8) support public associations of persons with disabilities and organizations established by all-Russian public associations of persons with disabilities, in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on social protection of persons with disabilities;
local33-u0aba421a7fca963afc-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u6202ddec8378019343-1.text: 9) perform notarial acts provided for by legislation if there is no notary in a settlement that forms part of the municipality’s territory and is not its administrative center;
local33-u6202ddec8378019343-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u08184f01a51fc4352c-1.text: 10) assist notaries in receiving members of the public in accordance with the reception schedule approved by the notarial chamber of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
local33-u08184f01a51fc4352c-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-uea42098cee3c0ac4f3-1.text: 11) provide citizens with accommodation from the municipal housing stock under tenancy agreements for housing in the housing stock for social use, in accordance with housing legislation;
local33-uea42098cee3c0ac4f3-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u888c46838e8d422c8b-1.text: 12) provide accommodation to an officer holding the position of district police commissioner and the officer’s family members for the period during which the officer holds that position;
local33-u888c46838e8d422c8b-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u3dcfe904294ad22f06-1.text: 13) carry out activities relating to the handling of ownerless animals living in the municipality;
local33-u3dcfe904294ad22f06-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-ue754ace51be400e2cc-1.text: 14) implement measures to assist persons in a state of intoxication caused by alcohol, narcotics or other toxic substances;
local33-ue754ace51be400e2cc-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u19bcdab2f8441b70b4-1.text: 15) participate in measures to prevent the unlawful consumption of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances and drug addiction;
local33-u19bcdab2f8441b70b4-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u88417213b3007b92f4-1.text: 16) implement measures to prevent offenses in accordance with Federal Law of 23.06.2016 No. 182-ФЗ “On the Fundamentals of the System for Preventing Offenses in the Russian Federation”;
local33-u88417213b3007b92f4-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u63d4bd3c6c9a1b7ca4-1.text: 17) establish public councils attached to local self-government bodies in accordance with Federal Law of 21.07.2014 No. 212-ФЗ “On the Fundamentals of Public Oversight in the Russian Federation”;
local33-u63d4bd3c6c9a1b7ca4-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u15733ba6b969eee1ab-1.text: 18) establish scientific and technical councils attached to local self-government bodies to ensure the municipality’s participation in implementing a unified state science and technology policy.
local33-u15733ba6b969eee1ab-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-ud0fa62818533c06d99-1.text: 3. Local self-government bodies may exercise other powers where provided for by federal laws.
local33-ud0fa62818533c06d99-1.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies

local33-u61583a7cbb3b076571-1.text: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
local33-u61583a7cbb3b076571-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u42408c9242ec618df5-1.text: 1. Individual powers of local self-government bodies may temporarily be exercised by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation where:
local33-u42408c9242ec618df5-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-ub264706a0c221ffb34-1.text: 1) because of a natural disaster, catastrophe or other emergency, the municipal representative body and local administration are absent and/or cannot be formed in accordance with this Federal Law;
local33-ub264706a0c221ffb34-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u6f0cb5a9695ceb3575-1.text: 2) decisions or actions (inaction) of local self-government bodies result in overdue municipal debt and/or budgetary obligations, determined in accordance with the procedure established by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation, exceeding 30 percent of the municipalities’ own budget revenues in the latest reporting year, and/or overdue municipal budgetary obligations exceeding 40 percent of budget appropriations in the reporting financial year, provided that the federal budget and budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation have fulfilled their budgetary obligations toward the budgets of those municipalities;
local33-u6f0cb5a9695ceb3575-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u0e7362970370a0c580-1.text: 3) in exercising individual delegated state powers financed by subventions to local budgets, local self-government bodies have misused budget funds or violated the Constitution of the Russian Federation, a federal law or other regulatory legal acts, as established by the relevant court.
local33-u0e7362970370a0c580-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u7b616144c7c99ecab7-1.text: 2. In the cases established by point 1 of part 1 of this Article, a decree (resolution) on the temporary exercise by executive bodies of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation of the corresponding powers of local self-government bodies is adopted by the highest official of the constituent entity on the basis of a decision of the representative body of local self-government or a decision of the constituent entity’s legislative body adopted by a majority of at least two thirds of the established number of deputies.
local33-u7b616144c7c99ecab7-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u11668ccea51eb491fa-1.text: 3. A decree (resolution) of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation on the temporary exercise by that constituent entity’s executive bodies of individual powers of local self-government bodies under part 2 of this Article must contain:
local33-u11668ccea51eb491fa-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u84c6f5314fae8290bd-1.text: 1) the name or names of the municipality or municipalities in which the exercise of individual powers of their local self-government bodies is temporarily assigned to executive bodies of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
local33-u84c6f5314fae8290bd-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u466e97a3ecaee12772-1.text: 2) a list of the individual powers of local self-government bodies established by this Federal Law that are to be exercised by executive bodies of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
local33-u466e97a3ecaee12772-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u41843e8a66613f978f-1.text: 3) a list of executive bodies of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and/or officials appointed by its state authorities that are assigned to exercise individual powers of local self-government bodies, with the distribution of those powers among them;
local33-u41843e8a66613f978f-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-uc95e6f4b24292bd5eb-1.text: 4) the period during which executive bodies of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation exercise individual powers of local self-government bodies, which may not extend beyond the elimination of the circumstances provided for in point 1 of part 1 of this Article;
local33-uc95e6f4b24292bd5eb-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-udcf78133f056934df9-1.text: 5) the sources and procedure for financing the temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by executive bodies of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-udcf78133f056934df9-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u0de257314e98949672-1.text: 4. In the case provided for in point 2 of part 1 of this Article, a temporary financial administration is introduced in the municipality concerned for up to one year by a decision of the commercial (arbitrazh) court of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, upon a petition by the highest official of that constituent entity and/or the municipal representative body or the head of the municipality.
local33-u0de257314e98949672-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u7cd994d13f5e55ae6b-1.text: 5. A temporary financial administration may not be introduced upon a petition by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation within one year after the municipal representative body assumes its powers.
local33-u7cd994d13f5e55ae6b-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-uc3e2f297fff41a9ac2-1.text: 6. To restore the municipality’s solvency, the temporary financial administration, in accordance with federal law, takes measures to restructure the municipality’s overdue debts; prepares amendments and additions to the municipal budget for the current financial year and a draft municipal budget for the next financial year; submits them to the municipal representative body for consideration and approval and, in the cases provided for by federal law, to the highest executive body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation for approval by a law of that constituent entity; ensures internal municipal financial control, including control over municipal budget execution in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation; and exercises other powers in accordance with this Federal Law.
local33-uc3e2f297fff41a9ac2-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u38270c6228dc2ae18a-1.text: 7. In the case provided for in point 3 of part 1 of this Article, the decision on the temporary exercise by executive bodies of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation of individual powers of local self-government bodies is adopted by that constituent entity’s highest executive body, with simultaneous withdrawal of the corresponding subventions.
local33-u38270c6228dc2ae18a-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u68e30db890d388afb6-1.text: 8. Decisions of public authorities referred to in this Article may be challenged in court.
local33-u68e30db890d388afb6-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u5941582895912d4e52-1.text: 9. The powers of local self-government bodies to adopt a municipal charter, amend and supplement it, establish the structure of local self-government bodies, change the boundaries of the municipality’s territory or transform the municipality may not temporarily be exercised by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
local33-u5941582895912d4e52-1.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u044142f3362f739676-1.text: 1. Local self-government bodies organize and exercise municipal control over compliance with requirements established by municipal legal acts adopted on matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life and, where federal laws assign the corresponding types of control to local self-government bodies, also municipal control over compliance with requirements established by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, taking into account parts 5 and 9 of Article 32 of this Federal Law.

local33-u4c86a621350fbac64a-1.text: 2. Local self-government bodies and officials vested with control functions under the municipal charter oversee whether the activities of local self-government bodies and officials comply with the municipal charter and regulatory legal acts of the municipal representative body adopted in accordance with it.

local33-u3e18eb9ad00b385bf7-1.text: 3. The organization and exercise of types of municipal control are regulated by the legislation of the Russian Federation on state control (supervision) and municipal control in the Russian Federation.

local33-u76244cb5555bd840ae-1.text: Article 40. Assessment of the effectiveness of local self-government bodies’ activities
local33-u76244cb5555bd840ae-1.locator: Article 40. Assessment of the effectiveness of local self-government bodies’ activities

local33-u4e4730d4e3f6c9333b-1.text: 1. The list of indicators for assessing the effectiveness of local self-government bodies’ activities is approved in accordance with a procedure determined by the President of the Russian Federation.
local33-u4e4730d4e3f6c9333b-1.locator: Article 40. Assessment of the effectiveness of local self-government bodies’ activities

local33-u855bfdcb12f21aa6a9-1.text: 2. Regulatory legal acts of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may provide for grants to municipalities from that constituent entity’s budget to facilitate and/or reward achievement of the best values of the indicators referred to in part 1 of this Article.
local33-u855bfdcb12f21aa6a9-1.locator: Article 40. Assessment of the effectiveness of local self-government bodies’ activities

local33-ue430d3f3d466cca78d-1.text: 3. Regulatory legal acts of the Government of the Russian Federation may provide for interbudgetary transfers from the federal budget to the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation to facilitate and/or reward achievement of the best values of indicators of local self-government bodies’ activities, or to reward best practices in organizing municipal administration and resolving matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life.
local33-ue430d3f3d466cca78d-1.locator: Article 40. Assessment of the effectiveness of local self-government bodies’ activities

local33-ue34734bab2f24ac3a2-1.text: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
local33-ue34734bab2f24ac3a2-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-u0db126e92385b7d2e9-1.text: 1. The prosecution authorities of the Russian Federation supervise compliance by local self-government bodies and local self-government officials with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws, constitutions (charters) and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, municipal charters and municipal legal acts.
local33-u0db126e92385b7d2e9-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-u53afe7eaada5aee605-1.text: 2. State bodies authorized under federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation to exercise state control (supervision) over the activities of local self-government bodies and officials, including territorial bodies of federal executive authorities and executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (hereinafter, state control (supervision) bodies), exercise, within their competence, control (supervision) over compliance by local self-government bodies and officials with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, constitutions (charters), laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, municipal charters and other municipal regulatory legal acts when local self-government bodies exercise powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life, other powers and rights assigned to them under federal laws and municipal charters; and over the conformity of municipal legal acts with the requirements of the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, constitutions (charters), laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and municipal charters.
local33-u53afe7eaada5aee605-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-u251da559dd8d3969dc-1.text: 3. State control (supervision) bodies may not require local self-government bodies or officials to exercise powers that this Federal Law and other federal laws do not assign to the local self-government bodies of the municipality concerned, or to finance the corresponding expenditure from the local budget.
local33-u251da559dd8d3969dc-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-u65d555c7aa75f8201a-1.text: 4. State control (supervision) bodies exercise state control (supervision) over the activities of local self-government bodies and officials on the principles of objectivity, openness and publicity.
local33-u65d555c7aa75f8201a-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-u75c9d2370f10a54729-1.text: 5. In exercising state control (supervision), duplication of the control and supervisory powers of state control (supervision) bodies at different levels is prohibited.
local33-u75c9d2370f10a54729-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-u3fcfd7942b34517a88-1.text: 6. The prosecution authorities of the Russian Federation coordinate the activities of state control (supervision) bodies in planning and conducting inspections of local self-government bodies and officials.
local33-u3fcfd7942b34517a88-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-u6ff0b601278d811c5a-1.text: 7. Scheduled inspections of the activities of local self-government bodies and officials are conducted jointly by state control (supervision) bodies on the basis of an annual inspection plan compiled and approved by the prosecutor’s office of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation (hereinafter, the annual plan). A scheduled inspection of the same local self-government body or official may be conducted no more than once every two years.
local33-u6ff0b601278d811c5a-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-ub94b584998abf7327a-1.text: 8. State control (supervision) bodies submit draft annual plans for inspections of local self-government bodies and officials to the prosecutor’s office of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation no later than 01.09 of the year preceding the inspection year.
local33-ub94b584998abf7327a-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-u93c11a0e6812903d21-1.text: 9. The draft annual inspection plans referred to in part 8 of this Article are reviewed by the prosecutor’s office of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation to determine whether the inclusion of objects of state control (supervision) is lawful, with proposals to the heads of state control (supervision) bodies for joint scheduled inspections.
local33-u93c11a0e6812903d21-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-ucf1253e5b5ff83e4c3-1.text: 10. On the basis of the draft annual inspection plans submitted by state control (supervision) bodies, the prosecutor’s office of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation compiles the annual plan for inspections of local self-government bodies and officials no later than 01.10 of the year preceding the inspection year.
local33-ucf1253e5b5ff83e4c3-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-u38451c62faca112207-1.text: 11. The annual plan for inspections of local self-government bodies and officials includes the following information:
local33-u38451c62faca112207-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-u1645fa9ebbb3bd41a9-1.text: 1) the names and locations of the local self-government bodies and officials whose activities are to be inspected;
local33-u1645fa9ebbb3bd41a9-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-u107370bfc4e59b3458-1.text: 2) the names of the state control (supervision) bodies planning the inspections;
local33-u107370bfc4e59b3458-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-u440bd62a1cbc7e380e-1.text: 3) the purposes, grounds and dates of the inspections.
local33-u440bd62a1cbc7e380e-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-u3e13defb045649f477-1.text: 12. The annual plan for inspections of local self-government bodies and officials must be posted on the official websites of the prosecutor’s office of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the relevant state control (supervision) body on the Internet information and telecommunications network no later than 01.11 of the year preceding the inspection year.
local33-u3e13defb045649f477-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-uf2e34c925b16cd8943-1.text: 13. Unscheduled inspections of the activities of local self-government bodies and officials are conducted by state control (supervision) bodies on the basis of a decision of the head of the relevant body, approved by the prosecutor’s office of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, made on the basis of submissions by citizens and legal entities and information from state bodies concerning violations of the legislation of the Russian Federation that cause emergencies, threaten citizens’ lives and health, or entail mass violations of citizens’ rights.
local33-uf2e34c925b16cd8943-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-u5eb2a7853e3f6e40a2-1.text: 14. Unscheduled inspections of the activities of local self-government bodies and officials may also be conducted pursuant to instructions of the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, or at the request of the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or the prosecutor of a constituent entity for an unscheduled inspection in the course of supervision of compliance with laws on the basis of materials and submissions received by prosecution authorities, and also to monitor compliance with previously issued orders to remedy identified violations. These inspections are conducted without obtaining approval from the prosecution authorities of the Russian Federation.
local33-u5eb2a7853e3f6e40a2-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-ub0f24bc92ba9d62465-1.text: 15. Information on scheduled and unscheduled inspections of the activities of local self-government bodies and officials, their results and measures taken to stop identified violations and/or eliminate their consequences must be entered in the Unified Register of Inspections in accordance with the rules for establishing and maintaining that register approved by the Government of the Russian Federation.
local33-ub0f24bc92ba9d62465-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-u7fa4430cea6c7edfd0-1.text: 16. A request for information from a state control (supervision) body is addressed to the head of a local self-government body or to a local self-government official, taking their powers into account. The request is directly considered by the head of the local self-government body whose competence covers the matters it contains.
local33-u7fa4430cea6c7edfd0-1.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials

local33-u4cacf50dc770e1b3a3-1.text: 17. The period set by state control (supervision) bodies for local self-government bodies and officials to provide requested information is at least 10 working days.
