local33-ub5611c37bedc65eaf8-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-ufb105168c298976127-1.text: 1) maintenance of public-use areas and the procedure for using such areas;
local33-ufb105168c298976127-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-u6149ba2f64fac670ff-1.text: 2) the external appearance of facades and enclosing structures of buildings, structures and facilities;
local33-u6149ba2f64fac670ff-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-u22869728b5fa17b690-1.text: 3) design, placement, maintenance and restoration of elements of territorial improvement and upkeep, including after earthworks;
local33-u22869728b5fa17b690-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-ubbcdbd6b11d5d56139-1.text: 4) organization of lighting in the municipality, including architectural illumination of buildings, structures and facilities;
local33-ubbcdbd6b11d5d56139-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-u6de3fa7bc35276a309-1.text: 5) organization of greening in the municipality, including the procedure for creating, maintaining, restoring and protecting lawns, flower beds and other areas occupied by herbaceous plants within the boundaries of settlements;
local33-u6de3fa7bc35276a309-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-u21a2108a965cc86c80-1.text: 6) placement of information in the municipality, including installation of street-name and house-number signs and signboards;
local33-u21a2108a965cc86c80-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-ud577a47f80ac22e265-1.text: 7) placement and maintenance of children’s playgrounds and sports grounds, animal-walking areas, parking areas (parking spaces) and small architectural forms;
local33-ud577a47f80ac22e265-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-u90cd7657558afcfec1-1.text: 8) organization of pedestrian routes, including sidewalks, avenues, walkways and paths;
local33-u90cd7657558afcfec1-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-u2c5a6758e25dd0e3df-1.text: 9) development of the territory of the municipality to ensure unhindered movement within it by persons with disabilities and other population groups with limited mobility;
local33-u2c5a6758e25dd0e3df-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-ubdf465d8e86db6c2b8-1.text: 10) cleaning of the territory of the municipality, including in winter;
local33-ubdf465d8e86db6c2b8-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-u71f50c72e8fea74f4a-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-u7917bbd48a3fbc9c51-1.text: 12) the procedure for carrying out earthworks;
local33-u7917bbd48a3fbc9c51-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-ub26fbfd1305277826a-1.text: 13) participation, including financial participation, by owners and/or other lawful possessors of buildings, structures, facilities and land plots (except owners and/or other lawful possessors of premises in apartment buildings whose underlying land plots have not been formed or have been formed along the boundaries of those buildings) in the maintenance of adjoining areas;
local33-ub26fbfd1305277826a-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-u4a4bb0b312871c84da-1.text: 14) determination of the boundaries of adjoining areas in accordance with the procedure established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
local33-u4a4bb0b312871c84da-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-u4fb399069dca5375ca-1.text: 15) festive decoration of the territory of the municipality;
local33-u4fb399069dca5375ca-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-u1cfba730d70fba03f0-1.text: 16) the procedure for participation by citizens and organizations in implementing measures for territorial improvement and upkeep in the municipality.
local33-u1cfba730d70fba03f0-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-u45729a724a90134d63-1.text: 3. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may provide for other matters regulated by the rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality, based on the natural and climatic, geographical, socioeconomic and other characteristics of individual municipalities.
local33-u45729a724a90134d63-1.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality

local33-ue5e1f7feffbeb40c0e-1.text: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
local33-ue5e1f7feffbeb40c0e-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u7c9765734b5ed76fc8-1.text: 1. Regulatory legal acts of the representative body of a municipality include:
local33-u7c9765734b5ed76fc8-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u96d466cd1b5e29e99c-1.text: 1) a regulatory legal act approving the charter of the municipality;
local33-u96d466cd1b5e29e99c-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-udf811c05a389db6640-1.text: 2) a regulatory legal act approving the budget of the municipality;
local33-udf811c05a389db6640-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u344254554972b9599a-1.text: 3) the rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in the municipality;
local33-u344254554972b9599a-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u6906712269a6c2f45f-1.text: 4) regulatory legal acts approving agreements concluded between local self-government bodies;
local33-u6906712269a6c2f45f-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u90f6990d3db69e03fb-1.text: 5) other regulatory legal acts adopted by the representative body of the municipality on matters assigned to its competence by federal laws, laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the charter of the municipality.
local33-u90f6990d3db69e03fb-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u3102221f870471eb28-1.text: 2. On matters assigned to its competence by federal laws, laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the charter of the municipality, the representative body of the municipality shall adopt:
local33-u3102221f870471eb28-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u2667b491695de7183d-1.text: 1) decisions establishing rules binding within the territory of the municipality;
local33-u2667b491695de7183d-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u56067f25b3bc5927f3-1.text: 2) a decision on removal of the head of the municipality from office;
local33-u56067f25b3bc5927f3-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-uf29c71c44204fd7334-1.text: 3) decisions on the organization of the activities of the representative body of the municipality;
local33-uf29c71c44204fd7334-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u48281a7b1191fdf778-1.text: 4) decisions on other matters assigned to its competence by federal laws, laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the charter of the municipality.
local33-u48281a7b1191fdf778-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-udc26c68b221b10ea39-1.text: 3. Draft regulatory legal acts of the representative body of a municipality on establishing, bringing into effect or terminating taxes (levies), changing tax rates (levy rates), the procedure and time limits for paying taxes (levies), establishing (abolishing) tax benefits (levy benefits) and/or the grounds and procedure for their application, and other draft regulatory legal acts of the representative body of the municipality providing for expenditure financed from the local budget shall be considered by the representative body of the municipality upon submission by the head of the local administration or where an opinion of that person is available. That opinion shall be submitted to the representative body of the municipality within the period established by the charter of the municipality, which may not be less than 20 days.
local33-udc26c68b221b10ea39-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u19249eebd6d665c754-1.text: 4. Draft regulatory legal acts may be submitted to the representative body of a municipality by deputies of the representative body of the municipality, the head of the municipality, other local self-government bodies, the head of the local administration, territorial public self-government bodies, citizens’ initiative groups and other holders of the right of lawmaking initiative specified in the charter of the municipality, except in cases provided for by this Federal Law.
local33-u19249eebd6d665c754-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-ucca66c1ecc36565219-1.text: 5. The procedure for adoption of decisions by the representative body of a municipality shall be determined by the charter of the municipality. A decision of the representative body of a municipality, including a decision establishing rules binding within the territory of the municipality or on matters of organization of the representative body’s activities, may not be deemed adopted if fewer than half of the established number of deputies of the representative body of the municipality voted in its favour.
local33-ucca66c1ecc36565219-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u9e4de64caf8e702632-1.text: 6. The head of the municipality shall sign and make public a regulatory legal act adopted by the representative body of the municipality.
local33-u9e4de64caf8e702632-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u3b870b54c48dc7d283-1.text: 7. A regulatory legal act adopted by the representative body of a municipality shall be forwarded to the head of the municipality for signature and making public within 10 days.
local33-u3b870b54c48dc7d283-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-uf3ce1228662fe71d8b-1.text: 8. The head of a municipality has the right to reject a regulatory legal act adopted by the representative body of the municipality. In that case, the regulatory legal act shall be returned to the representative body of the municipality within 10 days with a reasoned justification for its rejection or proposals for amendments and additions.
local33-uf3ce1228662fe71d8b-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-u6cd8c03be27091556d-1.text: 9. A regulatory legal act rejected by the head of a municipality shall be reconsidered by the representative body of the municipality.
local33-u6cd8c03be27091556d-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-uc47cf85c98c9dd7365-1.text: 10. If, on reconsideration, the regulatory legal act is approved in its previously adopted wording by a majority of at least two thirds of the established number of deputies of the representative body of the municipality, it shall be signed by the head of the municipality within seven days and made public.
local33-uc47cf85c98c9dd7365-1.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality

local33-ub31b61d8ad138bba44-1.text: Article 60. Legal acts of the head of a municipality
local33-ub31b61d8ad138bba44-1.locator: Article 60. Legal acts of the head of a municipality

local33-u7f4bf3406b408f124f-1.text: Within the powers established by the charter of the municipality and decisions of the representative body of the municipality, the head of the municipality shall issue resolutions and executive orders on matters assigned to the head’s competence by the charter of the municipality in accordance with this Federal Law and other federal laws, and also resolutions and executive orders of the local administration on the matters specified in part 2 of Article 61 of this Federal Law where the head of the municipality exercises the powers of the head of the local administration.
local33-u7f4bf3406b408f124f-1.locator: Article 60. Legal acts of the head of a municipality

local33-uaf2c86a95f20faab24-1.text: Article 61. Legal acts of local self-government officials
local33-uaf2c86a95f20faab24-1.locator: Article 61. Legal acts of local self-government officials

local33-u5f0f9836d339f23311-1.text: 1. The chair of the representative body of a municipality shall issue resolutions and executive orders on the organization of the activities of the representative body of the municipality and sign decisions of the representative body of the municipality.
local33-u5f0f9836d339f23311-1.locator: Article 61. Legal acts of local self-government officials

local33-udcb209e4ce82944777-1.text: 2. Within the powers established by federal laws, laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, the charter of the municipality and regulatory legal acts of the representative body of the municipality, the head of the local administration shall issue resolutions of the local administration on matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life and matters connected with the exercise of individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and executive orders of the local administration on the organization of the work of the local administration.
local33-udcb209e4ce82944777-1.locator: Article 61. Legal acts of local self-government officials

local33-u4352b550f1ffdb3181-1.text: 3. Other local self-government officials shall issue executive orders and administrative orders on matters assigned to their powers.
local33-u4352b550f1ffdb3181-1.locator: Article 61. Legal acts of local self-government officials

local33-u235175677e5d739f51-1.text: Chapter 7. Economic basis of local self-government
local33-u235175677e5d739f51-1.locator: Chapter 7. Economic basis of local self-government

local33-ud38ad6bbd805dbd5a6-1.text: Article 62. Economic basis of local self-government
local33-ud38ad6bbd805dbd5a6-1.locator: Article 62. Economic basis of local self-government

local33-u6691eb9669d9ed8ff9-1.text: 1. The economic basis of local self-government comprises municipally owned property, including the property rights of municipalities, and local budget funds.
local33-u6691eb9669d9ed8ff9-1.locator: Article 62. Economic basis of local self-government

local33-u97d062d9535623faa0-1.text: 2. In accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, municipal ownership is recognized and protected by the state on an equal basis with other forms of ownership.
local33-u97d062d9535623faa0-1.locator: Article 62. Economic basis of local self-government

local33-u93dc9f8bab14c0abca-1.text: 1) property intended for addressing the matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life established by this Federal Law;

local33-ucb8daddef085ef172d-1.text: 2) property intended for exercising individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies in cases established by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;

local33-ua2b3c3a9ad2e4424df-1.text: 3) property intended for supporting the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials, municipal servants and employees of municipal enterprises and institutions in accordance with regulatory legal acts of the representative body of the municipality;

local33-u7c36df42dcd0a33b2f-1.text: 4) property necessary for exercising powers not assigned to the powers of local self-government bodies to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life;

local33-u54414585d4ca4e2fb0-1.text: 5) property necessary for local self-government bodies to participate in the exercise of state powers not transferred to them and exercised in accordance with Article 36 of this Federal Law.

local33-ud569dddc0f2209ea2e-1.text: 2. Where municipalities acquire ownership of property that does not meet the requirements of part 1 of this Article, that property shall be repurposed (its designated purpose changed) or alienated. The procedure and time limits for alienating such property shall be established by federal law.

local33-u557f3fed8a2a8ec6bb-1.text: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
local33-u557f3fed8a2a8ec6bb-1.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property

local33-u8a6c11cbf5b80c50bb-1.text: 1. On behalf of the municipality, local self-government bodies shall independently possess, use and dispose of municipal property in accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal laws and regulatory legal acts of local self-government bodies adopted pursuant to them.
local33-u8a6c11cbf5b80c50bb-1.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property

local33-u5bcb2a16ffb08d141c-1.text: 2. Local self-government bodies have the right to acquire property into municipal ownership, transfer municipal property for temporary possession and/or use to individuals and legal entities and public authorities, including local self-government bodies of other municipalities, alienate it and enter into other transactions in accordance with federal laws.
local33-u5bcb2a16ffb08d141c-1.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property

local33-uad574941a62a973dd6-1.text: 3. The procedure and conditions for privatization of municipal property shall be determined by regulatory legal acts of local self-government bodies in accordance with federal laws.
local33-uad574941a62a973dd6-1.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property

local33-u608ae94126fb906a53-1.text: 4. Revenue from the use and privatization of municipal property shall be credited to local budgets.
local33-u608ae94126fb906a53-1.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property

local33-u79864fc9ac9f71e982-1.text: 5. Municipalities may establish municipal enterprises and institutions and participate in establishing business companies, including intermunicipal companies, necessary for exercising powers to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life. The functions and powers of the founder in relation to municipal enterprises and institutions shall be exercised by authorized local self-government bodies.
local33-u79864fc9ac9f71e982-1.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property

local33-u125d7b738d55c12f12-1.text: 6. On behalf of the municipality, local self-government bodies shall bear subsidiary liability for the obligations of municipal treasury-funded institutions and ensure performance of those obligations in accordance with the procedure established by federal law.
local33-u125d7b738d55c12f12-1.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property

local33-uc97860bc4099980356-1.text: 7. Local self-government bodies shall maintain registers of municipal property in accordance with the procedure established by the federal executive authority authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation.
local33-uc97860bc4099980356-1.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property

local33-u03251a7b524d008981-1.text: 8. Local self-government bodies shall transfer municipally owned electric-grid facilities for gratuitous possession and use to the system-forming territorial grid organization or territorial grid organization operating within the boundaries of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, in the cases, in accordance with the procedure and on the conditions established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the electric power industry.
local33-u03251a7b524d008981-1.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property

local33-uab90641808a0163081-1.text: 1. Each municipality has its own budget (local budget).

local33-ub1e16d71f9ee84f363-1.text: 2. Revenue and expenditure estimates for individual settlements and other territories that are not municipalities may be provided for as a constituent part of municipal budgets.

local33-u58ed50a0a1b9096b38-1.text: 3. The procedure for drawing up, approving and executing the estimates specified in part 2 of this Article shall be determined independently by the local self-government bodies of the corresponding municipalities, in compliance with the requirements established by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.

local33-ub04ad0a0c52ea79a16-1.text: 4. Local self-government bodies shall independently draw up and consider the draft local budget, approve and execute the local budget, monitor its execution, and draw up and approve the report on execution of the local budget, in compliance with the requirements established by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.

local33-ua7b30b300c3c2fefe7-1.text: 5. The budgetary powers of municipalities, local self-government bodies and local self-government officials shall be established by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.

local33-uf3cbab32c67ebcc1c1-1.text: 6. The territorial bodies of the federal executive authority authorized to exercise control and supervision in the field of taxes and levies shall provide municipal financial bodies with information on the assessment and payment of taxes and levies to be credited to the budgets of the corresponding municipalities, in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.

local33-u2619fbeae2c86bc246-1.text: 7. The head of the financial body of an urban okrug or municipal okrug shall be appointed from among persons meeting the qualification requirements established by the federal executive authority authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation.

local33-u9c77b088cb2e0800bd-1.text: 8. Verification of whether candidates for the position of head of the financial body of an urban okrug or municipal okrug meet the qualification requirements shall be carried out with the participation of the financial body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. The procedure for participation by the financial body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in that verification shall be established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.

local33-u63de1530d2b9340b67-1.text: 9. The law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation specified in part 8 of this Article shall provide for a list of documents to be submitted to the financial body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, methods of verifying candidates’ compliance with qualification requirements, including interviews with candidates, and a list of decisions adopted following such verification and the form of the opinion on its results. A law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may also regulate other matters concerning the procedure for participation by the financial body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in such verification.

local33-u9c4ecaae9629a1b456-1.text: 10. The draft local budget, the decision approving the local budget, the annual report on its execution, quarterly information on the progress of execution of the local budget and on the number of municipal servants in local self-government bodies and employees of municipal institutions, indicating the actual expenditure on their remuneration, shall be officially published.

local33-ue0fe99dcf6c0a8b663-1.text: 11. Equalization of municipalities’ budgetary capacity shall be carried out in accordance with the requirements of the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.

local33-ue7866ab56d630e1242-1.text: 1. Local budget expenditure shall be formed in accordance with the expenditure obligations of municipalities established and fulfilled by the local self-government bodies of those municipalities in accordance with the requirements of the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.

local33-u3979f597785600eaab-1.text: 2. Municipalities’ expenditure obligations shall be fulfilled from the funds of the corresponding local budgets in accordance with the requirements of the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.

local33-u8e891be399a16cc69c-1.text: Article 67. Procurement to meet municipal needs
local33-u8e891be399a16cc69c-1.locator: Article 67. Procurement to meet municipal needs

local33-u33066a9fcd20e49483-1.text: 1. Procurement of goods, works and services to meet municipal needs shall be carried out in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the contract system for procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs.
local33-u33066a9fcd20e49483-1.locator: Article 67. Procurement to meet municipal needs

local33-u76966af8366888fa26-1.text: 2. Procurement of goods, works and services to meet municipal needs shall be financed from the local budget, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law.
local33-u76966af8366888fa26-1.locator: Article 67. Procurement to meet municipal needs

local33-u4e1d370340cbc545e8-1.text: Local budget revenue shall be formed in accordance with the budget legislation of the Russian Federation, legislation on taxes and levies and legislation on other mandatory payments.

local33-uc65d192959c9350801-1.text: 1. Citizens’ self-taxation funds mean one-off payments made by citizens to address specific matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life. The amount of payments under citizens’ self-taxation shall be set as an absolute amount equal for all residents of the municipality (a settlement (part of a settlement’s territory) forming part of the territory of the municipality), except for certain categories of citizens whose number may not exceed 30 per cent of the total number of residents of the municipality (a settlement (part of a settlement’s territory) forming part of the territory of the municipality) and for whom the amount of payments may be reduced.

local33-ud23c510a2bc5a8310d-1.text: 2. Matters concerning the introduction and use of the one-off payments by citizens specified in part 1 of this Article shall be decided at a local referendum or, in the cases provided for in points 1 and 2 of part 1 of Article 45 of this Federal Law, at a citizens’ assembly.

local33-u30175fcf6050388d08-1.text: Article 70. Financial and other support for implementation of initiative projects
local33-u30175fcf6050388d08-1.locator: Article 70. Financial and other support for implementation of initiative projects

local33-u8361fd42f9b4c32945-1.text: 1. The source of financing for implementation of the initiative projects provided for in Article 49 of this Federal Law shall be the budget appropriations for implementation of initiative projects provided for in the local budget, formed taking into account, among other things, the amounts of initiative contributions and/or interbudgetary transfers from the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation provided to finance the corresponding expenditure obligations of the municipality.
local33-u8361fd42f9b4c32945-1.locator: Article 70. Financial and other support for implementation of initiative projects

local33-u061043dbf3ed07873d-1.text: 2. Initiative contributions mean funds of citizens, individual entrepreneurs and legal entities formed in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation, paid voluntarily and credited to the local budget in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation to implement specific initiative projects.
local33-u061043dbf3ed07873d-1.locator: Article 70. Financial and other support for implementation of initiative projects

local33-uf022c19b800d1df28f-1.text: 3. If an initiative project has not been implemented, the initiative contributions shall be returned to the persons (including organizations) that transferred them to the local budget. If, upon completion of an initiative project, a balance remains of initiative contributions not used for its implementation, those contributions shall be returned to the persons (including organizations) that transferred them to the local budget.
local33-uf022c19b800d1df28f-1.locator: Article 70. Financial and other support for implementation of initiative projects

local33-u0b9820680d4a903d93-1.text: 4. The procedure for calculating and returning the amounts of initiative contributions to be returned to the persons (including organizations) that transferred them to the local budget shall be determined by a regulatory legal act of the representative body of the municipality.
local33-u0b9820680d4a903d93-1.locator: Article 70. Financial and other support for implementation of initiative projects

local33-u26be67189e2922d1b1-1.text: 5. Implementation of initiative projects may also be supported through voluntary contributions of property and/or labour by interested persons.
local33-u26be67189e2922d1b1-1.locator: Article 70. Financial and other support for implementation of initiative projects

local33-u0b10e65b471b02e566-1.text: Article 71. Provision of subventions to local budgets for the exercise of state powers by local self-government bodies
local33-u0b10e65b471b02e566-1.locator: Article 71. Provision of subventions to local budgets for the exercise of state powers by local self-government bodies

local33-u8b70ef18898eb3f384-1.text: 1. Expenditure obligations of municipalities arising in the performance of state powers of the Russian Federation transferred to local self-government bodies for exercise shall be financed from the federal budget by providing subventions to local budgets from the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
local33-u8b70ef18898eb3f384-1.locator: Article 71. Provision of subventions to local budgets for the exercise of state powers by local self-government bodies

local33-u24e32e9b73143a5a0c-1.text: 2. Subventions for exercising state powers of the Russian Federation transferred to local self-government bodies shall be provided from the federal budget to the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for distribution among local budgets for those purposes in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
local33-u24e32e9b73143a5a0c-1.locator: Article 71. Provision of subventions to local budgets for the exercise of state powers by local self-government bodies

local33-ue39bafa0fd5902d58d-1.text: 3. Expenditure obligations of municipalities arising in the performance of state powers of constituent entities of the Russian Federation transferred to local self-government bodies for exercise by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be financed from the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation by providing subventions to local budgets from the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation adopted pursuant to it.
local33-ue39bafa0fd5902d58d-1.locator: Article 71. Provision of subventions to local budgets for the exercise of state powers by local self-government bodies

local33-u6f0285e16efc511f13-1.text: Article 72. Subsidies, grants and other interbudgetary transfers provided to local budgets from the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
local33-u6f0285e16efc511f13-1.locator: Article 72. Subsidies, grants and other interbudgetary transfers provided to local budgets from the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-ufd541372e593485049-1.text: 1. To co-finance expenditure obligations arising in the performance of the powers of local self-government bodies to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life, subsidies may be provided to local budgets from the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted pursuant to it.
local33-ufd541372e593485049-1.locator: Article 72. Subsidies, grants and other interbudgetary transfers provided to local budgets from the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u8c1960378802721242-1.text: 2. In the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts of state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted pursuant to them, grants and other interbudgetary transfers may be provided to local budgets from the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-u8c1960378802721242-1.locator: Article 72. Subsidies, grants and other interbudgetary transfers provided to local budgets from the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-uafb026f601a1aa9092-1.text: 3. In the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by federal laws and regulatory legal acts of the Government of the Russian Federation, other grants may be provided to the budgets of individual municipalities from the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, financed by grants provided from the federal budget to the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for those purposes. The distribution of such grants among municipalities shall be approved by the law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation on the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or by a regulatory legal act of the highest executive state authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the distribution approved by the federal law on the federal budget or a legal act of the Government of the Russian Federation, if grants for two or more municipalities are provided to the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-uafb026f601a1aa9092-1.locator: Article 72. Subsidies, grants and other interbudgetary transfers provided to local budgets from the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u8593b42f35aebb096d-1.text: Municipalities have the right to undertake municipal borrowing, including by issuing municipal securities, in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and the charter of the municipality.

local33-uabeb4185e42e05bfcc-1.text: Article 74. Interbudgetary transfers provided from local budgets
local33-uabeb4185e42e05bfcc-1.locator: Article 74. Interbudgetary transfers provided from local budgets

local33-u523cdb48ad6ed028c6-1.text: 1. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may provide for subsidies and other interbudgetary transfers from local budgets to the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the requirements and in the cases established by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
local33-u523cdb48ad6ed028c6-1.locator: Article 74. Interbudgetary transfers provided from local budgets

local33-u0bc357a494f1a12168-1.text: 2. Subsidies and other interbudgetary transfers may be provided to the budgets of municipalities from the budgets of other municipalities in accordance with the requirements and in the cases established by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
local33-u0bc357a494f1a12168-1.locator: Article 74. Interbudgetary transfers provided from local budgets

local33-ue2f735c102e1bc4d17-1.text: 1. Intermunicipal cooperation shall take the following forms:

local33-u6476efc9b1ca3fd069-1.text: 1) membership of municipalities in associations of municipalities;

local33-ua802b4f0beff754fbb-1.text: 2) establishment of intermunicipal business companies and an intermunicipal print media outlet and online publication;

local33-ue54703fdae8b5e985b-1.text: 3) establishment of nonprofit organizations by municipalities;

local33-u2b7ae023b9ba0f0c18-1.text: 5) organization of interaction among councils of municipalities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.

local33-u502174b70c9502b42f-1.text: 2. Associations of municipalities, intermunicipal business companies and nonprofit organizations established by municipalities may not be vested with the powers of local self-government bodies.

local33-u5b5df24a0b5ed218c4-1.text: 1. Associations of municipalities shall be established to organize interaction among local self-government bodies and to express and protect the common interests of residents of municipalities.

local33-ua77c269c32d3707f19-1.text: 2. The organization and activities of associations of municipalities shall comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on nonprofit organizations applicable to associations.

local33-u741bda3f0cdd5408c4-1.text: 3. A council of municipalities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be formed in each constituent entity of the Russian Federation to ensure interaction among local self-government bodies, their officials and municipalities, and representation and protection of their common interests within the territory of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.

local33-u4895de9e7abe1397fa-1.text: 4. State authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall interact with councils of municipalities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in accordance with the procedure established by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.

local33-u5e6784b06611464260-1.text: 5. Persons representing the governing bodies of councils of municipalities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, including persons holding municipal offices, have the right to serve on coordinating, advisory and other bodies attached to executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation whose activities concern matters falling within the powers of local self-government bodies to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life, and individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.

local33-uf2ec11a5958f08f739-1.text: 6. The council of municipalities of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall prepare and submit to the highest executive authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the Association “All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government” an annual report on the state and development of local self-government in the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. Specific features of preparation of that report may be established by laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.

local33-ud6ae42a7fd59b5baf8-1.text: Article 77. All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government
local33-ud6ae42a7fd59b5baf8-1.locator: Article 77. All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government

local33-uae6bc65b482456796f-1.text: 1. The Association “All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government” shall organize interaction among municipalities, councils of municipalities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, other associations of municipalities and nonprofit organizations whose objectives include ensuring the realization of citizens’ constitutional rights to exercise local self-government, for the purpose of representing and protecting the common interests of local self-government bodies and their officials, including representing those interests within the unified system of public authority and when organizing cooperation between municipalities and international organizations and foreign legal entities.
local33-uae6bc65b482456796f-1.locator: Article 77. All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government

local33-ub18a7b687593d17fc1-1.text: 2. The organization and activities of the Association “All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government” shall comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on nonprofit organizations applicable to associations.
local33-ub18a7b687593d17fc1-1.locator: Article 77. All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government

local33-u2c7570e38e2ea72612-1.text: 3. Councils of municipalities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be members of the Association “All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government”.
local33-u2c7570e38e2ea72612-1.locator: Article 77. All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government

local33-udf193cd9b1bd9c479e-1.text: 4. Persons representing the governing bodies of the Association “All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government”, including persons holding municipal offices, have the right to serve on coordinating, advisory and other bodies attached to federal executive authorities whose activities concern matters falling within the powers of local self-government bodies to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life, and individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws.
local33-udf193cd9b1bd9c479e-1.locator: Article 77. All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government

local33-u36e98832a560190f5d-1.text: 5. The Association “All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government” shall prepare and submit to the Government of the Russian Federation an annual report on the state and development of local self-government in the Russian Federation.
local33-u36e98832a560190f5d-1.locator: Article 77. All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government

local33-u87218762aefc17d464-1.text: 1. Intermunicipal business companies shall be established to pool the financial, material and other resources of municipalities for jointly addressing matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life.

local33-ua1a7aa1368a5c12349-1.text: 2. Intermunicipal business companies shall be established in the form of non-public joint-stock companies and limited liability companies by decision of the representative bodies of municipalities.

local33-u98eabc46a4246c45fe-1.text: 3. Intermunicipal business companies shall conduct their activities in accordance with the Civil Code of the Russian Federation and other federal laws.

local33-u94efc0f82e42573f7c-1.text: 4. State registration of intermunicipal business companies shall be carried out in accordance with Federal Law No. 129-ФЗ of 08.08.2001 “On State Registration of Legal Entities and Individual Entrepreneurs”.

local33-u84d36c5c221e6b1cfb-1.text: 5. Local self-government bodies may act as co-founders of an intermunicipal print media outlet and online publication.

local33-u330a993ba6189d82fb-1.text: 1. Nonprofit organizations of municipalities shall be established in the form of autonomous nonprofit organizations and foundations by decision of the representative body of the municipality.

local33-u6463ed644d1ded2f9a-1.text: 2. Nonprofit organizations of municipalities shall conduct their activities in accordance with the Civil Code of the Russian Federation, Federal Law No. 7-ФЗ of 12.01.1996 “On Nonprofit Organizations” and other federal laws.

local33-u77ba8a74a3c29315ad-1.text: Chapter 9. International and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
local33-u77ba8a74a3c29315ad-1.locator: Chapter 9. International and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-u284ecf19f6c903083e-1.text: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
local33-u284ecf19f6c903083e-1.locator: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-ubd5c994ff736974131-1.text: The powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies include:
local33-ubd5c994ff736974131-1.locator: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-ued962037bdf60767e2-1.text: 1) developing, implementing and ensuring the pursuit of a unified state policy in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies;
local33-ued962037bdf60767e2-1.locator: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-u5dd5f288183abd9354-1.text: 2) determining priority areas of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies;
local33-u5dd5f288183abd9354-1.locator: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-u90b4c3aad1c901a021-1.text: 3) representing the interests of the Russian Federation in relations with foreign states and international organizations on matters of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies;
local33-u90b4c3aad1c901a021-1.locator: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-u8dc8c6d09826b48350-1.text: 4) providing constituent entities of the Russian Federation with legal, organizational and methodological support on matters of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies;
local33-u8dc8c6d09826b48350-1.locator: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-ud12f38d89ea48ee4be-1.text: 5) compiling and maintaining the list of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies with local self-government bodies of foreign states;
local33-ud12f38d89ea48ee4be-1.locator: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-u0f1ac30d0947b8022e-1.text: 6) other powers in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies in accordance with international treaties of the Russian Federation, federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
local33-u0f1ac30d0947b8022e-1.locator: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-u2314d1ac704a730731-1.text: Article 81. Powers of state authorities of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
local33-u2314d1ac704a730731-1.locator: Article 81. Powers of state authorities of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-u16b53474ea32318265-1.text: The powers of state authorities of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies include legal regulation of the conduct of international and foreign economic relations by local self-government bodies, provision to local self-government bodies of legal, organizational and methodological support in conducting international and foreign economic relations, and other powers established by this Federal Law and other federal laws.
local33-u16b53474ea32318265-1.locator: Article 81. Powers of state authorities of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-uf75da02b11597c492d-1.text: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations
local33-uf75da02b11597c492d-1.locator: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations

local33-ucfd85b6a0d1a91798e-1.text: 1. Local self-government bodies shall conduct international and foreign economic relations to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life, with the agreement of the state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the procedure established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-ucfd85b6a0d1a91798e-1.locator: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations

local33-ude036db6b816d9720e-1.text: 2. The powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations include:
local33-ude036db6b816d9720e-1.locator: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations

local33-uecd1b1ebc3fc40df68-1.text: 1) holding meetings, consultations and other events in the field of international and foreign economic relations with representatives of state-territorial, administrative-territorial and municipal entities of foreign states;
local33-uecd1b1ebc3fc40df68-1.locator: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations

local33-u54e10d78fc98bb395f-1.text: 2) concluding agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies with local self-government bodies of foreign states;
local33-u54e10d78fc98bb395f-1.locator: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations

local33-u030507519d0dd3bdcc-1.text: 3) participating in the activities of international organizations in the field of intermunicipal cooperation within the powers of bodies established specifically for that purpose;
local33-u030507519d0dd3bdcc-1.locator: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations

local33-u3e9d5f207d624fa4d0-1.text: 4) participating in the development and implementation of projects under international programmes of intermunicipal cooperation;
local33-u3e9d5f207d624fa4d0-1.locator: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations

local33-u2c4b85cacd4dc53662-1.text: 5) other powers in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies in accordance with international treaties of the Russian Federation, federal laws, other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-u2c4b85cacd4dc53662-1.locator: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations

local33-u89e9c4c80b6837724a-1.text: Article 83. Agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
local33-u89e9c4c80b6837724a-1.locator: Article 83. Agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-u3e809ec876889b84cc-1.text: 1. To address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life, local self-government bodies shall conclude agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations with local self-government bodies of foreign states, with the agreement of the highest executive authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in whose territory the corresponding municipality is located, in accordance with the procedure determined by the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-u3e809ec876889b84cc-1.locator: Article 83. Agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-u367cccf2570b7c5043-1.text: 2. Registration by state authorities of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies of that constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be carried out in accordance with the procedure determined by a law of that constituent entity of the Russian Federation and is a mandatory condition for such agreements to enter into force.
local33-u367cccf2570b7c5043-1.locator: Article 83. Agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-u494a6b4cc847e60448-1.text: 3. Signed agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies shall be officially published in accordance with the procedure provided for official publication of municipal legal acts.
local33-u494a6b4cc847e60448-1.locator: Article 83. Agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-u054f89b4973534f52b-1.text: Article 84. Reporting on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
local33-u054f89b4973534f52b-1.locator: Article 84. Reporting on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-ufdc3d66e8de0c4d01b-1.text: 1. Each year before 15.01, the head of the municipality shall inform the authorized state authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, in accordance with the procedure established by that authority, about the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of the local self-government bodies of that municipality and the results of such relations in the preceding year.
local33-ufdc3d66e8de0c4d01b-1.locator: Article 84. Reporting on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-u05d4731e714ab9bd16-1.text: 2. Each year before 01.02, the highest executive authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall inform the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies, in accordance with the procedure established by that federal authority, about the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies and the results of such relations in the preceding year.
local33-u05d4731e714ab9bd16-1.locator: Article 84. Reporting on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-u459ac1161d8d679106-1.text: Article 85. List of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
local33-u459ac1161d8d679106-1.locator: Article 85. List of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-ude50f7211dea9e0eec-1.text: 1. A municipality shall compile a list of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of the local self-government bodies of that municipality in accordance with the procedure determined by the highest executive authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. That list shall include all agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of the local self-government bodies of that municipality, including agreements that have ceased to be in force.
local33-ude50f7211dea9e0eec-1.locator: Article 85. List of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-uc0c0ae9eb71ac7b23b-1.text: 2. Each year before 15.01, the head of the municipality shall send the authorized state authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation the list of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of the local self-government bodies of that municipality, including in it agreements concluded and agreements that ceased to be in force in the preceding year. If such a list is sent for the first time, it shall include all agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of the local self-government bodies of that municipality, including agreements that have ceased to be in force.
local33-uc0c0ae9eb71ac7b23b-1.locator: Article 85. List of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-ucac4175644d2988d8a-1.text: 3. On the basis of the lists provided for by this Article, the highest executive authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall compile the list of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies of that constituent entity of the Russian Federation and, each year before 01.02, send that list to the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies.
local33-ucac4175644d2988d8a-1.locator: Article 85. List of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

local33-uae66c872a6a25285a0-1.text: Chapter 10. Specific features of the organization of local self-government
local33-uae66c872a6a25285a0-1.locator: Chapter 10. Specific features of the organization of local self-government

local33-u68c591f9237e4fd07e-1.text: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
local33-u68c591f9237e4fd07e-1.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories

local33-ue10c2248177798f192-1.text: This Federal Law and other federal laws may establish specific features of the organization of local self-government:
local33-ue10c2248177798f192-1.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories

local33-u96908f74d9b66d7cec-1.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories

local33-u524708608ce5499fde-1.text: 2) in the territories of cities of federal significance;
local33-u524708608ce5499fde-1.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories

local33-u19a81851bdf5dc7db7-1.text: 3) in the territories of administrative centres (capitals) of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
local33-u19a81851bdf5dc7db7-1.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories

local33-ub34311c28a1e4ea2af-1.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories

local33-u18bc6fc161cad59fb4-1.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories

local33-u4f9850c7bc0ce02536-1.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories

local33-ue7429a8f96ae725985-1.text: 7) in the territory of the Skolkovo Innovation Centre;
local33-ue7429a8f96ae725985-1.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories

local33-ud4b50778fb3530a58c-1.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories

local33-u47f9d87ac4bf548f85-1.text: 9) in the territories of innovative scientific and technological centres;
local33-u47f9d87ac4bf548f85-1.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories

local33-uee90455c9f7fbc86a1-1.text: 10) in the territory of the Free Port of Vladivostok;
local33-uee90455c9f7fbc86a1-1.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories

local33-ub9b15635ad46930371-1.text: 11) in municipalities whose territories form part of the Arctic Zone of the Russian Federation;
local33-ub9b15635ad46930371-1.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories

local33-u93028a05f25a99e473-1.text: 12) in territories with a low rural population density and in remote and hard-to-reach localities;
local33-u93028a05f25a99e473-1.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories

local33-ub7e6d13d8dad14c868-1.text: 13) in the territory of the ERA Military Innovation Technopolis of the Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation;
local33-ub7e6d13d8dad14c868-1.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories

local33-u8d6ddb013a3e25dea9-1.text: 14) in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization.
local33-u8d6ddb013a3e25dea9-1.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories

local33-u4c7523bc6a9e51542c-1.text: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
local33-u4c7523bc6a9e51542c-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-u3fc7e9f106015b9c26-1.text: 1. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance shall be established by laws of those constituent entities of the Russian Federation, taking into account the provisions of this Article.
local33-u3fc7e9f106015b9c26-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-u00473d7dbbd04806c3-1.text: 2. In cities of federal significance, local self-government shall be exercised by local self-government bodies in intracity municipalities of the city of federal significance in accordance with the charters of those constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
local33-u00473d7dbbd04806c3-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-u416afca8db0367d919-1.text: 3. Specific features of determining the type of municipality in the territories of cities of federal significance shall be determined by laws of cities of federal significance.
local33-u416afca8db0367d919-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-u159567e65f9eba2adf-1.text: 4. The charter of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance may, in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is a city of federal significance, provide that the head of the municipality simultaneously holds a state office of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and a municipal office.
local33-u159567e65f9eba2adf-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-udb9af9e30f44ffb5b9-1.text: 5. The charter of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance may provide for the formation of an executive-administrative body headed by the head of the municipality who exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality.
local33-udb9af9e30f44ffb5b9-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-ud76f5cfb705f4d1224-1.text: 6. The provisions of part 6 of Article 10 of this Federal Law do not apply to intracity municipalities of a city of federal significance.
local33-ud76f5cfb705f4d1224-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-udd082dd91abee9d782-1.text: 7. The provisions of part 8 of Article 15 and parts 7–10 of Article 59 of this Federal Law do not apply to the local self-government bodies of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance in which, under the charter of that municipality, the head of the municipality exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality.
local33-udd082dd91abee9d782-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-ue86145ffab99bf89bb-1.text: 8. The requirement to terminate the powers of a deputy of the representative body of a municipality established by part 4 of Article 19 of this Federal Law does not apply to a deputy of the representative body of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance elected head of the municipality in which, under the charter of that municipality, the head of the municipality exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality.
local33-ue86145ffab99bf89bb-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-u73d2c47f0cd7afd596-1.text: 9. The restrictions established by part 16 of Article 19 and part 2 of Article 28 of this Federal Law do not apply to the local self-government bodies of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance, except where the head of the municipality is elected by the representative body of the municipality from among candidates nominated by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or by the representative body of the municipality from among candidates nominated by the competition commission following a competition.
local33-u73d2c47f0cd7afd596-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-u08da493ddad90fd429-1.text: 10. The number of deputies of the representative body of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance shall be determined by the charter of the municipality in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is a city of federal significance and may not be fewer than 10 persons.
local33-u08da493ddad90fd429-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-ud7d25e086e5a152a61-1.text: 11. The representative body of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance may have the rights of a legal entity in accordance with the charter of the municipality.
local33-ud7d25e086e5a152a61-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-u5861f1f5c6f4508df9-1.text: 12. In cities of federal significance, the boundaries of intracity municipalities of the corresponding cities of federal significance shall be established and changed, and those municipalities reorganized, by laws of cities of federal significance, taking into account the opinion of the population of the corresponding intracity municipalities of the city of federal significance expressed in accordance with the procedure provided for by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance.
local33-u5861f1f5c6f4508df9-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-ud24edc83397b30d0df-1.text: 13. The list of powers of local self-government bodies to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life and the sources of local budget revenue of intracity municipalities of cities of federal significance shall be determined by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance, based on the need to preserve the unity of the urban economy.
local33-ud24edc83397b30d0df-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-u8cea75378ec91e67dc-1.text: 14. Sources of local budget revenue established by this Federal Law and other federal laws that are not assigned by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance to the sources of budget revenue of intracity municipalities shall be credited to the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance.
local33-u8cea75378ec91e67dc-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-u82877a90aec0d71bef-1.text: 15. The powers of local self-government bodies shall be exercised by the local self-government bodies of intracity municipalities of cities of federal significance where the corresponding powers are assigned to the powers of the local self-government bodies of intracity municipalities of cities of federal significance by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance.
local33-u82877a90aec0d71bef-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-uc47022d2b2d979e10f-1.text: 16. The procedure for making public municipal legal acts of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance, including agreements concluded between local self-government bodies, shall be established by the charter of the intracity municipality of the city of federal significance in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is a city of federal significance and shall ensure that citizens can acquaint themselves with those acts, except for municipal legal acts or individual provisions thereof containing information whose dissemination is restricted by federal law.
local33-uc47022d2b2d979e10f-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-u0052fc24fc759b35a1-1.text: 17. In the territories of cities of federal significance, the organization of territorial improvement and upkeep, approval of rules for territorial improvement and upkeep, and assignment of powers to exercise municipal control in that field, the subject of which is compliance with those rules, including requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of social, engineering and transport infrastructure facilities and services provided, to the powers of local self-government bodies of intracity municipalities of cities of federal significance to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life or to the powers of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance as powers to exercise a type of regional state control (supervision), shall be regulated by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance.
local33-u0052fc24fc759b35a1-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-u44eea2e7f42c1429a8-1.text: 18. In accordance with laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance, based on the need to preserve the unity of the urban economy and the established list of powers of local self-government bodies of intracity municipalities of cities of federal significance to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life, a local administration need not be formed in such municipalities.
local33-u44eea2e7f42c1429a8-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-uc80dbeeeb734310b85-1.text: 19. Laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance may provide for specific features of the exercise of individual state powers of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance transferred to local self-government bodies of intracity municipalities of cities of federal significance, where exercising those powers will not require expenditure from the budgets of cities of federal significance and/or local budgets or material resources.
local33-uc80dbeeeb734310b85-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-ucc6fd882eb5da79fb7-1.text: 20. The composition of municipal property of intracity municipalities of cities of federal significance shall be determined by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance in accordance with the list of powers of local self-government bodies of intracity municipalities of cities of federal significance to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life established for those municipalities by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance.
local33-ucc6fd882eb5da79fb7-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-uedd87e70200527cfa4-1.text: 21. The procedure for proposing, submitting, discussing and considering initiative projects and for conducting their competitive selection in the territories of cities of federal significance shall be established by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance.
local33-uedd87e70200527cfa4-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-u4810eff718b8f0efca-1.text: 22. In cities of federal significance, the scope of powers of a person temporarily exercising the powers of head of a municipality, appointed by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is a city of federal significance in the cases provided for by this Federal Law, may be limited by the charter of the municipality to the extent provided for by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is a city of federal significance and/or by the regulatory legal act of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is a city of federal significance appointing the person temporarily exercising the powers of head of the municipality.
local33-u4810eff718b8f0efca-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-ua608533928d996885c-1.text: 23. A decision of the representative body of a municipality on removal of the head of the municipality from office shall be signed by the chair of the representative body of the municipality.
local33-ua608533928d996885c-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-u49aed5113db126fc83-1.text: 24. Where, under the charter of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance, the head of the municipality exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality, consideration of removal of the head of the municipality from office at a meeting of the representative body of the intracity municipality of the city of federal significance shall take place under the chairmanship of a deputy of the representative body of the intracity municipality of the city of federal significance authorized for that purpose by the representative body of that municipality.
