The decision on removal of the head of the municipality from office shall be signed by the deputy chairing the meeting of the representative body of the intracity municipality of the city of federal significance.
local33-u49aed5113db126fc83-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-u1732852cdd8b45d235-1.text: 25. Where, under the charter of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance, the head of the municipality exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality, the deputy elected head of the municipality and exercising their powers on a full-time basis under the charter of the municipality shall be counted when determining the number of deputies of the representative body of the municipality who may work on a full-time basis in accordance with part 12 of Article 25 of this Federal Law.
local33-u1732852cdd8b45d235-1.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance

local33-u18cdb0571dd7df3a5c-1.text: Article 88. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in the territories of administrative centres (capitals) of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
local33-u18cdb0571dd7df3a5c-1.locator: Article 88. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in the territories of administrative centres (capitals) of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u367c1dd16744d0b5f9-1.text: 1. A municipality whose territory includes a settlement that is the administrative centre (capital) of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be an urban okrug.
local33-u367c1dd16744d0b5f9-1.locator: Article 88. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in the territories of administrative centres (capitals) of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-uc141e8ef426d054534-1.text: 2. The head of a municipality whose territory includes a settlement that is the administrative centre (capital) of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be elected by the representative body of the municipality from among candidates nominated by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-uc141e8ef426d054534-1.locator: Article 88. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in the territories of administrative centres (capitals) of constituent entities of the Russian Federation

local33-u2c35852a58b1db8221-1.text: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
local33-u2c35852a58b1db8221-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-ua762847f2d5fe4b476-1.text: 1. The specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization established by this Article shall apply in constituent entities of the Russian Federation in accordance with part 7 of Article 9 of this Federal Law.
local33-ua762847f2d5fe4b476-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-u8c5833aeffe041167c-1.text: 2. In municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization, local self-government shall be exercised in rural settlement municipalities, urban settlement municipalities and municipal raions. In territories of a municipal raion located outside the boundaries of settlement municipalities on the date this Federal Law enters into force, specific features of the organization of local self-government shall be established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-u8c5833aeffe041167c-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-u1f101d2b8590088698-1.text: 3. A rural settlement municipality is a municipality whose territory includes one or more rural settlements united by a common territory (settlements, villages, stanitsas, hamlets, khutors, kishlaks, auls and other rural settlements) that are not municipalities. The territory of a rural settlement municipality may also include territories intended for the development of its social, transport and other infrastructure.
local33-u1f101d2b8590088698-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-u1f8d7182007c2bb874-1.text: 4. An urban settlement municipality is a municipality whose territory includes a city and/or another urban settlement that are not municipalities. The territory of an urban settlement municipality may also include the territories of rural settlements that are not municipalities and territories intended for the development of its social, transport and other infrastructure.
local33-u1f8d7182007c2bb874-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-u3f94012acc3090ec74-1.text: 5. A municipal raion is a municipality whose territory includes several settlement municipalities united by a common territory, within whose boundaries local self-government is exercised for the purpose of exercising the powers of local self-government bodies to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life that are of an intersettlement nature. The territory of a municipal raion may also include territories outside the boundaries of settlement municipalities.
local33-u3f94012acc3090ec74-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-ue75202409a4c9338bf-1.text: 6. The provisions of this Federal Law shall apply to rural settlement municipalities, urban settlement municipalities and municipal raions subject to the specific features provided for by this Article.
local33-ue75202409a4c9338bf-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-u85cdd2a6e00d11eb70-1.text: 7. The provisions of part 7 of Article 10 of this Federal Law do not apply to rural settlement municipalities and urban settlement municipalities.
local33-u85cdd2a6e00d11eb70-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-u9c03e6436fc88a6b00-1.text: 8. The charter of a rural settlement municipality may provide for the formation of an executive-administrative body headed by the head of the municipality who exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality.
local33-u9c03e6436fc88a6b00-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-uc39cd1cb9b2f09aacd-1.text: 9. The charters of a municipal raion and of the settlement municipality that is its administrative centre may provide for the formation of a local administration of the municipal raion entrusted with exercising the powers of the local administration of that settlement municipality. In that case, no local administration shall be formed in the settlement municipality that is the administrative centre of the municipal raion; the head of the settlement municipality shall be a member of its representative body and exercise the powers of its chair.
local33-uc39cd1cb9b2f09aacd-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-uc04f1efdc89778f332-1.text: 10. In accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the charter of the municipal raion, the representative body of a municipal raion:
local33-uc04f1efdc89778f332-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-u49a78fcccb36477cfd-1.text: 1) may consist of the heads of settlement municipalities forming part of the municipal raion and deputies of the representative bodies of those settlement municipalities elected by their representative bodies from among their members in accordance with an equal representation quota irrespective of the population of the settlement municipality. If the head of a settlement municipality is elected by its representative body from among candidates nominated by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or by the representative body of the municipality from among candidates nominated by the competition commission following a competition, that head of the settlement municipality shall not be a member of the representative body of the municipal raion; in addition to the deputies it has elected under that representation quota for settlement municipalities, the representative body of that settlement municipality shall elect one additional deputy from among its members to the representative body of the municipal raion of which that settlement municipality forms part. A law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and, pursuant to it, the charter of the municipal raion and the charters of settlement municipalities may establish a representation quota for settlement municipalities forming part of the municipal raion in the representative body of that municipal raion based on the population of the settlement municipality. The representation quota of one settlement municipality forming part of the municipal raion may not exceed one third of the established membership of the representative body of that municipal raion;
local33-u49a78fcccb36477cfd-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-uc0d065595a362e1bc6-1.text: 2) may be elected at municipal elections on the basis of universal, equal and direct suffrage by secret ballot. The number of deputies elected from one settlement municipality may not exceed two fifths of the established membership of the representative body of the municipal raion.
local33-uc0d065595a362e1bc6-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-ud59f50c6a352d26926-1.text: 11. If a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation provides for a transition from election of the representative body of a municipal raion at municipal elections to its formation from among the members of representative bodies of settlement municipalities, elections of deputies of that municipal raion shall not be called or held if that law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation entered into force before the date from which the representative body of the municipal raion would be entitled to adopt a decision calling elections in accordance with Federal Law No. 67-ФЗ of 12.06.2002 “On the Basic Guarantees of Electoral Rights and the Right of Citizens of the Russian Federation to Participate in a Referendum”. The procedure for formation of the representative body of the municipal raion thus established shall apply after expiry of the term of powers of the representative body of the municipal raion elected before the date that law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation entered into force.
local33-ud59f50c6a352d26926-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-u9fbc6838056c91e2e9-1.text: 12. If a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation provides for a transition from formation of the representative body of a municipal raion from among the members of representative bodies of settlement municipalities and intracity districts to election at municipal elections, elections to the representative body of the municipal raion shall be held no later than six months from the date that law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation enters into force, unless otherwise provided by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
local33-u9fbc6838056c91e2e9-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-u16aeef6869276800eb-1.text: 13. The number of deputies of the representative body of a municipal raion shall be determined by the charter of the municipal raion and may not be fewer than 15 persons.
local33-u16aeef6869276800eb-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-ufeff06e9b93a42916a-1.text: 14. The charter of a settlement municipality may, in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, provide that the head of the municipality simultaneously holds a state office of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and a municipal office.
local33-ufeff06e9b93a42916a-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-u3c77aa372c773a56b5-1.text: 15. When a competition is held to select candidates for the position of head of a settlement municipality, half of the members of the competition commission shall be appointed by the representative body of the settlement municipality and the other half by the head of the corresponding municipal raion.
local33-u3c77aa372c773a56b5-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-uf606c98bb5ed81bb2f-1.text: 16. In the case provided for by part 9 of this Article, when a competition is held to select candidates for the position of head of a municipal raion, one quarter of the members of the competition commission shall be appointed by the representative body of the municipal raion, one quarter by the representative body of the settlement municipality that is the administrative centre of the municipal raion, and half by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-uf606c98bb5ed81bb2f-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-u419af48b2595ab9566-1.text: 17. The provisions of part 8 of Article 15 and parts 7–10 of Article 59 of this Federal Law do not apply to the local self-government bodies of a rural settlement municipality in which, under the charter of that municipality, the head of the municipality exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality.
local33-u419af48b2595ab9566-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-u75fd9836aa1db24833-1.text: 18. The requirement to terminate the powers of a deputy of the representative body of a municipality established by part 4 of Article 19 of this Federal Law does not apply to a deputy of the representative body of a rural settlement municipality elected head of the rural settlement municipality in which, under the charter of that municipality, the head of the municipality exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality.
local33-u75fd9836aa1db24833-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-u612383bdda8d4f99e5-1.text: 19. The restrictions established by part 16 of Article 19 and part 2 of Article 28 of this Federal Law do not apply to the local self-government bodies of a rural settlement municipality, except where the head of the municipality is elected by the representative body of the municipality from among candidates nominated by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or by the representative body of the municipality from among candidates nominated by the competition commission following a competition.
local33-u612383bdda8d4f99e5-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-uf01a8342fc0f50ad11-1.text: 20. In the case provided for by part 9 of this Article, the contract terms concerning the exercise of powers to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life for the head of the local administration of the municipal raion who is entrusted with exercising the powers of head of the local administration of the settlement municipality shall be approved by the representative body of the municipal raion with the agreement of the representative body of that settlement municipality.
local33-uf01a8342fc0f50ad11-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-udc289adaef6f947926-1.text: 21. When a competition is held to fill the position of head of the local administration of a settlement municipality, half of the members of the competition commission shall be appointed by the representative body of the settlement municipality and the other half by the head of the local administration of the corresponding municipal raion.
local33-udc289adaef6f947926-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-ueac72dde8540c7ee42-1.text: 22. In the case provided for by part 9 of this Article, when a competition is held to fill the position of head of the local administration of a municipal raion, one quarter of the members of the competition commission shall be appointed by the representative body of the municipal raion, one quarter by the representative body of the settlement municipality that is the administrative centre of the municipal raion, and half by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-ueac72dde8540c7ee42-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-u5c266ff06cf30fd6f2-1.text: 23. The powers provided for in parts 1–3 of Article 32 of this Federal Law shall be exercised in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation by local self-government bodies of rural settlement municipalities, urban settlement municipalities or local self-government bodies of municipal raions, unless otherwise provided by this Article, taking into account the specific features provided for in parts 5–16 of Article 32 of this Federal Law.
local33-u5c266ff06cf30fd6f2-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-uc60c10c4b9df46ac38-1.text: 24. The powers of local self-government bodies to adopt the charter of a municipality and amend and supplement it, issue municipal legal acts, establish official symbols of the municipality, draw up and consider the draft budget of the municipality, approve and execute the local budget, exercise municipal financial control, including control over execution of the budget of the municipality, draw up and approve the report on execution of the local budget in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation, possess, use and dispose of municipally owned property, and establish, bring into effect and terminate previously introduced local taxes and levies of the municipality in accordance with legislation on taxes and levies shall be exercised by local self-government bodies of rural settlement municipalities, urban settlement municipalities and municipal raions.
local33-uc60c10c4b9df46ac38-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-u778153a3ba34cbbdda-1.text: 25. Individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies for exercise shall be exercised by local self-government bodies of municipal raions, unless otherwise established by federal law or a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-u778153a3ba34cbbdda-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-ub34d325bea009a1de3-1.text: 26. Where, under the charter of a rural settlement municipality, the head of the municipality exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality, consideration of removal of the head of the municipality from office at a meeting of the representative body of the rural settlement municipality shall take place under the chairmanship of a deputy of the representative body of the rural settlement municipality authorized for that purpose by the representative body of that municipality. The decision on removal of the head of the municipality from office shall be signed by the deputy chairing the meeting of the representative body of the rural settlement municipality.
local33-ub34d325bea009a1de3-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-uee108803742f607c1e-1.text: 27. Where, under the charter of a rural settlement municipality, the head of the municipality exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality, the deputy elected head of the municipality and exercising their powers on a full-time basis under the charter of the municipality shall be counted when determining the number of deputies of the representative body of the municipality who may work on a full-time basis in accordance with part 12 of Article 25 of this Federal Law.
local33-uee108803742f607c1e-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-u03c41717b979205565-1.text: 28. In the event of early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipal raion formed in accordance with point 1 of part 10 of this Article, the representative bodies of the corresponding settlement municipalities shall elect other deputies to the representative body of the municipal raion within one month.
local33-u03c41717b979205565-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-udc974d1ca9452f3f2d-1.text: 29. If all settlement municipalities forming part of a municipal raion are merged and a municipal okrug is formed in their territory, the municipal raion and those settlement municipalities shall be abolished.
local33-udc974d1ca9452f3f2d-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-uc18cdd84192845753d-1.text: 30. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization that are not regulated by this Federal Law shall be established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-uc18cdd84192845753d-1.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization

local33-u131c8bf623910584dc-1.text: Chapter 11. Specific features of the exercise of powers by local self-government bodies in particular territories
local33-u131c8bf623910584dc-1.locator: Chapter 11. Specific features of the exercise of powers by local self-government bodies in particular territories

local33-u1ba6fcf8bda93d20ea-1.text: Article 90. Specific features of organizing and carrying out northern deliveries in municipalities
local33-u1ba6fcf8bda93d20ea-1.locator: Article 90. Specific features of organizing and carrying out northern deliveries in municipalities

local33-ubd475e7a7d153fd127-1.text: 1. Local self-government bodies of municipalities whose territories are included in the list of northern-delivery territories shall exercise powers in the field of northern deliveries in accordance with Federal Law No. 411-ФЗ of 04.08.2023 “On Northern Deliveries”.
local33-ubd475e7a7d153fd127-1.locator: Article 90. Specific features of organizing and carrying out northern deliveries in municipalities

local33-ub9c8ccd05ad2d2f042-1.text: 2. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall select suppliers (providers) of goods and services necessary to support the daily life of the population residing in northern-delivery territories for procuring entities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and municipal procuring entities of municipalities located in those constituent entities of the Russian Federation, in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the contract system for procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs, where a list of such goods and services is approved by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
local33-ub9c8ccd05ad2d2f042-1.locator: Article 90. Specific features of organizing and carrying out northern deliveries in municipalities

local33-u5df0b9c61823ef5951-1.text: 3. The list specified in part 2 of this Article may include socially significant food products, essential non-food consumer goods, medicinal products, medical devices, specialized therapeutic nutrition products, fuel and energy resources, fuels and lubricants, industrial and technical products and services related to their delivery. Other goods and services may not be included in that list.
local33-u5df0b9c61823ef5951-1.locator: Article 90. Specific features of organizing and carrying out northern deliveries in municipalities

local33-ub398f9637b66d728cc-1.text: 4. Procurement to meet municipal needs of other goods and services necessary to support the daily life of the population residing in northern-delivery territories but not included in the list specified in part 2 of this Article shall be carried out independently by local self-government bodies of municipalities, unless otherwise provided by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the contract system for procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs.
local33-ub398f9637b66d728cc-1.locator: Article 90. Specific features of organizing and carrying out northern deliveries in municipalities

local33-ub01e8a717d57ff2bd6-1.text: 1. Until 01.01.2028, local self-government bodies shall exercise powers in accordance with Articles 14–18 of Federal Law No. 131-ФЗ of 06.10.2003 “On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation”.

local33-u1a7e6dc93070b4bf22-1.text: 2. Laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation regulating matters of local self-government organization and municipal legal acts shall be brought into conformity with this Federal Law no later than 01.01.2027. Until they are brought into conformity with this Federal Law, they shall apply to the relevant relations insofar as they do not contradict this Federal Law.

local33-ue2073a9b71ccfda29d-1.text: 3. From the date this Federal Law enters into force, laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation may be adopted establishing the territorial organization of local self-government in the corresponding constituent entity of the Russian Federation, with local self-government exercised in the types of municipalities specified in points 1 and 2 of part 2 of Article 9 of this Federal Law throughout the territory of the corresponding constituent entity of the Russian Federation or in the territory of an individual municipal raion.

local33-u8930ec371d2ae6df82-1.text: 4. From the date of entry into force of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with part 3 of this Article that provides for local self-government to be exercised in the territory of a municipal raion in the types of municipalities specified in points 1 and 2 of part 2 of Article 9 of this Federal Law:

local33-u54bcd562a4a8ee32c3-1.text: 1) new elections of heads of settlement municipalities and municipal raions elected at municipal elections and of deputies of representative bodies of settlement municipalities and municipal raions shall not be called or held, except for by-elections of deputies of the representative body of a municipality and elections of the head of a municipality provided for in point 2 of part 6 of this Article;

local33-u5b99e9c81a8fe66244-1.text: 2) the representative bodies of rural settlement municipalities, urban settlement municipalities and municipal raions shall exercise their powers until expiry of the term of powers provided for by the charters of those municipalities.

local33-u604067047b307692f1-1.text: 5. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with part 3 of this Article shall provide for the formation of local self-government bodies in accordance with the new territorial organization of local self-government, taking into account expiry of the terms of powers of representative bodies of municipal raions or in connection with early termination of the powers of representative bodies of municipal raions.

local33-udac7101a640ff5e799-1.text: 6. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with part 3 of this Article may provide for:

local33-ub3d6040f465d5314d6-1.text: 1) extension of the terms of powers of heads of settlement municipalities and municipal raions and representative bodies of settlement municipalities and municipal raions by no more than two years;

local33-u316626c1906302efe6-1.text: 2) election of heads of settlement municipalities and municipal raions, including the holding of elections of heads of settlement municipalities and municipal raions, for a term ending upon expiry of the term of powers of the representative body of the corresponding municipality;

local33-ua90721af3ec71e517a-1.text: 3) the possibility for local self-government bodies of a municipal raion to exercise the powers of local self-government bodies of settlement municipalities in the event of early termination of the powers of local self-government bodies of settlement municipalities;

local33-u732c42cfe5646cd66a-1.text: 4) other matters connected with ensuring that the territorial organization of local self-government in the corresponding constituent entity of the Russian Federation is brought into conformity with the provisions of this Federal Law.

local33-u827bad40fd28fab880-1.text: 7. The powers of local self-government bodies of a settlement municipality or municipal raion whose term of powers has expired, including in the event of early termination of the powers of the corresponding local self-government bodies, shall be exercised by the local self-government bodies of the corresponding settlement municipalities and/or municipal raions until the formation of local self-government bodies of the newly formed municipalities.

local33-u93ad4ae63ca21c27ab-1.text: 8. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with part 3 of this Article may provide for the formation of a municipal okrug or urban okrug within boundaries coinciding with the territorial boundaries of a settlement municipality (rural or urban) or municipal raion existing on the date this Federal Law enters into force. If municipal and/or urban okrugs are formed within the boundaries of all settlement municipalities that formed part of the territory of a municipal raion, the municipal raion shall be abolished.

local33-u9f799ee1e298666037-1.text: 9. A municipality formed under the procedure provided for by part 8 of this Article within boundaries coinciding with the territorial boundaries of a settlement municipality (rural or urban) existing on the date this Federal Law enters into force has the right, in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, to retain the name existing on the date this Federal Law enters into force, including a name indicating the type of municipality (urban or rural settlement municipality).

local33-u21522b79305bcc5a88-1.text: 10. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with part 3 of this Article may, to ensure the development of social, transport and other infrastructure, provide for the formation of a municipality within boundaries combining the territories of several municipalities existing on the date this Federal Law enters into force or within other territorial boundaries, including a territory comprising part (parts) of the territory of the specified municipality (municipalities).

local33-ub040a74a4552d6b783-1.text: 11. The number of deputies of the representative body of the first convocation of a municipal okrug or urban okrug newly formed under the procedure provided for by this Article within boundaries coinciding with the territorial boundaries of a municipal raion existing on the date this Federal Law enters into force shall be established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. That number may not be fewer than the number of deputies of the representative body of the municipal raion existing on the date this Federal Law enters into force.

local33-u99ae8a71f61c0902c9-1.text: 12. Where a municipal or urban okrug is formed under the procedure provided for by this Article within the boundaries of more than one settlement municipality existing on the date this Federal Law enters into force, territorial bodies of the local administration forming part of its structure shall be established in the administrative centres of those settlement municipalities.

local33-u29b6b7e99ea94d600c-1.text: 13. Where territorial bodies of the local administration are formed in accordance with part 12 of this Article and a person who held the position of head of a settlement municipality on the date this Federal Law enters into force is appointed head of a territorial body of the local administration, a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with part 3 of this Article may provide for:

local33-uafa87b4776f773dd26-1.text: 1) a dual title for the position in the local administration, comprising a title determined with regard to historical and other local traditions for naming leadership positions in local self-government bodies and the title of the position of head of a territorial body of the local administration in accordance with the register of municipal service positions in the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, and the procedure for using that dual title;

local33-uadd77d94d4cbd2cd96-1.text: 2) filling the position of head of a territorial body of the local administration without regard to the qualification requirements for the level of professional education established in accordance with Federal Law No. 25-ФЗ of 02.03.2007 “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”.

local33-u913f723c666d0af6da-1.text: 14. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is a city of federal significance may provide for extension by no more than two years of the terms of powers of heads of municipalities and representative bodies of intracity municipalities to ensure the simultaneous commencement of the exercise of powers of local self-government bodies established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is a city of federal significance regulating the territorial organization of local self-government and the status and powers of local self-government bodies of intracity municipalities, adopted in accordance with this Federal Law.

local33-ub8364305db425488ba-1.text: 15. Until expiry of the terms of powers of representative bodies of municipalities elected before 01.01.2027, the provisions of part 8 of Article 15, parts 4 and 16 of Article 19 and part 2 of Article 28 of this Federal Law shall not apply to heads of municipalities exercising the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality.

local33-ub7ffc88c13d19aa529-1.text: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
local33-ub7ffc88c13d19aa529-1.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced

local33-ubd7eb7cb5605b84fd3-1.text: 1. Individual powers of local self-government bodies may be temporarily exercised by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation where, during the introduction of a special legal regime (including during martial law or in wartime), local self-government bodies are absent and cannot be formed in accordance with the procedure provided for by federal constitutional laws and this Federal Law.
local33-ubd7eb7cb5605b84fd3-1.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced

local33-u9f5d8cff0bfc12fdd1-1.text: 2. In the cases established by part 1 of this Article, the decision on temporary exercise by executive authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation of the corresponding powers of local self-government bodies shall be adopted by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. The decree (resolution) of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation on temporary exercise by executive authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation of individual powers of local self-government bodies shall contain:
local33-u9f5d8cff0bfc12fdd1-1.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced

local33-u8a3da04e38429be149-1.text: 1) the name of the municipality or municipalities in which the exercise of individual powers of the local self-government bodies of those municipalities is temporarily entrusted to executive authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
local33-u8a3da04e38429be149-1.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced

local33-ud1cac671ead8922cc9-1.text: 2) the list of individual powers of local self-government bodies established by this Federal Law and other federal laws that are exercised by executive authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
local33-ud1cac671ead8922cc9-1.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced

local33-u41843e8a66613f978f-2.text: 3) the list of executive authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and/or officials appointed by state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation entrusted with exercising individual powers of local self-government bodies, with the allocation of those powers among them;
local33-u41843e8a66613f978f-2.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced

local33-u385a081aca1349bde9-1.text: 4) the period during which executive authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation exercise individual powers of local self-government bodies, which may not extend beyond the period until the circumstances provided for in part 1 of this Article are eliminated;
local33-u385a081aca1349bde9-1.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced

local33-udcf78133f056934df9-2.text: 5) the sources and procedure of financing the temporary exercise by executive authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation of individual powers of local self-government bodies.
local33-udcf78133f056934df9-2.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced

local33-u4b84bd32cf61d3fa8f-1.text: 3. The exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies temporarily exercised by executive authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with part 1 of this Article may, by decree (resolution) of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, be entrusted to local self-government bodies of another municipality (other municipalities).
local33-u4b84bd32cf61d3fa8f-1.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced

local33-udf65c18847f7235cdc-1.text: 4. The decree (resolution) of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation on temporary exercise by local self-government bodies of another municipality of individual powers of local self-government bodies shall contain:
local33-udf65c18847f7235cdc-1.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced

local33-uac7e92bda5b0533bd9-1.text: 1) the name of the municipality (municipalities) or individual settlement (settlements) in which the exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies is temporarily entrusted to local self-government bodies of another municipality;
local33-uac7e92bda5b0533bd9-1.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced

local33-uee5f7ffccf97b62370-1.text: 2) the list of individual powers of local self-government bodies established by this Federal Law and other federal laws that are exercised by local self-government bodies of another municipality, except for the powers of local self-government bodies to adopt the charter of a municipality, amend and supplement it, establish the structure of local self-government bodies, change the territorial boundaries of a municipality and reorganize a municipality;
local33-uee5f7ffccf97b62370-1.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced

local33-u0d71f405101fe78af6-1.text: 3) the period during which local self-government bodies of another municipality exercise individual powers of local self-government bodies, which may not extend beyond the period until the circumstances preventing the formation of local self-government bodies in accordance with federal constitutional laws and this Federal Law are eliminated;
local33-u0d71f405101fe78af6-1.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced

local33-u4ad407e57362e1c24b-1.text: 4) the sources and procedure of financing the temporary exercise by local self-government bodies of another municipality of individual powers of local self-government bodies.
local33-u4ad407e57362e1c24b-1.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced

local33-ue94d9bfb1d412fd810-1.text: 5. The powers of local self-government bodies to adopt the charter of a municipality, amend and supplement it, establish the structure of local self-government bodies, change the territorial boundaries of a municipality and reorganize a municipality may not be temporarily exercised by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, including by entrusting them to local self-government bodies of another municipality (other municipalities).
local33-ue94d9bfb1d412fd810-1.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
